dialog: Well, Hiro, as long as what you wear fits you tight enough, you can swim a lot better without too much dragging you against the water.

dialog: I only learned that from you, Natsumi! Haha!

dialog: Haha! I guess if Natsumi’s coming then I’ll go too!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah...

dialog: Natsumi can do whatever he wants as long as he’s having fun and not overworking himself~!

dialog: Umm, sir! Is it okay if I do it instead of Natsumi this time?

dialog: But we both know how exhausted you are already.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, I’m still fine!

dialog: You’ve been teaching everyone how to swim all day. Not to mention all those extra laps you did right after!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I just don’t wanna see you collapse!

dialog: I can do it too, you know.

name: Keitaro
dialog: I just wanna make sure you’re not getting overworked again.

dialog: There's no way I'm letting you tire yourself out anymore. Not while I can help it, at least.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, I  want you to relax for the rest of the night.

dialog: I’m sure you must be exhausted after that.

dialog: There's no way I'm letting you tire yourself out anymore. Not while I can help it, at least.

name: Keitaro
dialog: But you deserve a break, just like everyone else~!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I was trying to keep an eye on you the whole day to make sure you weren't overworking.

name: Keitaro
dialog: But I’m really happy to see you doing your best to ease up and just have fun with everyone else!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Haha! It’s my pleasure, Natsumi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Why don’t you head back and get changed? I can just get dressed after I finish!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Don’t go to sleep yet, Hiro. I know you’re already planning to, hehe!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, I think what everyone’s trying to say is that they would’ve helped you out too if they found out, Natsumi.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh! I just had an idea, guys!

name: Keitaro
dialog: How about we update my journal together?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah! We’ll put in all the stuff from the sportsfest too! It’s gonna be a lot of fun to put in such a huge update!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Phew! Finally done!

name: Keitaro
dialog: That’s right! Every moment I share with you guys is precious to me! I don’t ever want to forget about it!

name: Keitaro
dialog: That’s why I always bring my camera wherever I go! And this journal Ms. Yuri gave me helps me record all the great memories I share with everyone!

name: Keitaro
dialog: These two are the most precious things to me!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hngh… W-What is that sound…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Pack? Where are we going, sir?

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well, it is a surprise activity after all-

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh! Why don't I start packing your stuff while you take a shower, Taiga? That might help you feel better.

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well, I just thought that’s what you’d want me to do…

name: Keitaro
dialog: But I thought you said you didn’t want to go on this trip-

dialog: R-Right, I’ll do it now!

dialog: Oh, good morning everyone!

dialog: Yeah, he just woke us up too. He didn’t tell us what the activity was, though.  He just asked us to pack some things…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Do you know about it, Natsumi?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I guess it’s really a surprise for us then! I’m excited!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, whatever it is, it’s always fun when we’re together!

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ah…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-It’s alright guys, l-let’s not argue… The scoutmasters are here to announce something.

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-If you need help taking some pictures, Eduard, I brought my camera with me…!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I don't know what Instaglam is, but I do love taking pictures of people! And the beach is a perfect place for great shots!

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ah, I didn’t mean to... I just thought you might want me to take pictures of you.

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well… Scoutmaster Yoshi did give me permission to keep it, as long as I used it productively…

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well if you do change your mind, I’d be happy to help you out, Eduard.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh wow, Lee! It seems like you know a lot about stuff like this!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh I just had an idea, Eduard!

name: Keitaro
dialog: You know what would suit a nice beach getup? A nice tropical flower necklace!

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Wheww… The breeze is nice, huh Taiga? We must be close to the beach.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Umm… You were really quiet the whole hike, Taiga… Is everything alright?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Are you sure? You look like you might not be feeling well…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Y-You can tell me what’s wrong…

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ah I'm sorry, Taiga... I didn't mean to-

name: Keitaro
dialog: R-Right! I’ll be right back!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-I’ll leave you alone then.

name: Keitaro
dialog: R-Right! I’ll be right back!

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Okay…! Let’s just chill here then.

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh, sure Taiga…!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’ll be right back!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah, how about some water, Taiga? You must be dehydrated from the hike!

name: Keitaro
dialog: R-Right! I’ll be right back!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Whew… Taiga’s still his usual stingy self. I’m starting to feel like I haven’t made any progress even after a week of staying with him.

name: Keitaro
dialog: I won’t get to know him better unless I step up my game.

name: Keitaro
dialog: What can I do to get him interested to talk or at least…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, Natsumi! What are you guys up to?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, yes! I was hoping to get one for Taiga. He’s resting over there.

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-It’s not like that anymore, Yoichi! Taiga hasn’t really been ordering me around as much the last few days.

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well... They haven't been forcing me to... I've been volunteering...

name: Keitaro
dialog: Last year…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, that reminds me! I actually wanted to ask you and Natsumi something about that!

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well, I was just curious if either of you know a camper named… Kieran?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, I see…

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Thanks, Natsumi! Good luck, you two!

dialog: So, Kieran was at camp last year… I wonder what else happened with him…? He seemed to have been close to Taiga…

dialog: There has to be more to this story… But I can’t worry about that now!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I should get the water back before Taiga gets impatient…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’m glad you guys are ready to have fun! Are you excited too, Taiga?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Wow! I can’t believe it… The whole trip is a vacation! And I thought there was gonna be an activity today!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah, we get to spend time together just having fun here!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’m really excited to spend some time at the beach with you too, Taiga—

name: Keitaro
dialog: *sigh* I guess I should get changed too...

name: Keitaro
dialog: Whew, there we go!

name: Keitaro
dialog: It’s been a while since I’ve worn these shorts! I never had the chance to go to the beach in the past couple of years.

name: Keitaro
dialog: It’s nice to smell the sea breeze again!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I just hope I can enjoy this day with-

name: Keitaro
dialog: T-Taiga!

name: Keitaro
dialog: *gulp*

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ah! I-I was just uhh…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I can’t help but notice your necklace, Taiga…! It looks so cool on your chest.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Wow… That makes it even better! Where did you get something so neat?

name: Keitaro
dialog: T-That bandana really suits you, Taiga…! It makes your arms look bigger!

name: Keitaro
dialog: And I noticed it matches your trunks too, haha!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Those patterns really suit you, Taiga!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Haha, maybe just add a tail and you’ll look like a really cute kitty!

name: Keitaro
dialog: A tiger…! I meant a tiger!

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ah, to be honest, I can’t help but notice that your swimwear looks so tight on you…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I mean… in a good way of course! The way it fits your body, it really shows off your um… assets.

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-I was just trying to compliment you… because you really do look good in it.

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh… I put it back in my bag… I thought we were gonna go for a swim…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ehehe, w-well, your suits do fit you both really well…

name: Keitaro
dialog: H-Haha… I guess I’m not the only one who thinks you look really good today, Taiga.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Was it just me, or did Taiga get really flustered from everyone’s compliments…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I guess I should keep up whatever I’m doing and I might actually get the chance to have fun with him today!

name: Keitaro
dialog: There you are, Taiga! We weren’t sure where you went.

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well, we wanted to come along too…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, hey guys!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah! It’s nice to take a break like this every once in a while.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Anyway, are you guys about to swim too?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-I’d love to play with you guys!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Y-You can come too, Taiga. We can all play!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Sure! We’d all love to play with you guys!

dialog: Volleyball sounds like a lot of fun, doesn’t it Taiga?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Okay…!

dialog: I got it!

dialog: Here, Taiga!

name: Keitaro
dialog: We can still catch the ball…!

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Whoa!!!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Wahhh!!

dialog: I-I’m sorry! It was an accident!

dialog: I-I can’t, you’re the one on top of me…!

dialog: A-Are you alright, Taiga?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-I’m sorry I was in the way… I didn’t know you were gonna jump right in front of me…

dialog: I-I’m fine, the sand broke my fall.

dialog: T-Taiga, wait…!

name: Keitaro
dialog: *huff* *huff*

dialog: T-Taiga! There you are…!

dialog: I've been looking everywhere for you... The sun's already going down!

name: Keitaro
dialog: B-But—

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Actually I’m not…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I know how annoying it is for you to hear me apologize so much, so I’m not gonna do that.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Haha, I guess we're both hungry, huh?

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Actually I’m not…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I was worried that you could get in trouble with the scoutmasters if you stay here any longer…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, maybe we should go then? It's getting kinda cold here too...

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well… Aren’t you hungry at least?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Haha, I guess we're both hungry, huh?

dialog: But everyone was waiting for you back there, you know…

dialog: We were just starting to have fun playing with you!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I heard Sir Aiden’s making cheeseburgers! Eduard and Lee told me you like them!

name: Keitaro
dialog: But I’m really sorry, though… I know you just-

name: Keitaro

name: Keitaro
dialog: Come on!

dialog: Wah! That’d be amazing, sir!

dialog: Wow… These look delicious…!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Thank you very much, sir!

dialog: Yes, sir!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well… These are your favorite, right? Besides, I’m sure I can’t finish more than two anyway~

dialog: You can have my last one if you want?

dialog: You sure? I’m kinda full already.

dialog: Thanks, Taiga!

dialog: Hmm? What do you mean, Taiga?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well… I wouldn’t worry about my friends! They know how to have fun!

name: Keitaro
dialog: And I’m pretty sure Eduard and Lee had their own activities they wanted to do too. It’s a vacation after all!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Besides, I’d rather spend time here alone with you!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Do you really hate it though?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Haha! Then I guess I'll keep doing it then~

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh! I guess we’re being called back to the campsite!

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ahh, umm…

name: Keitaro
dialog: You guys know I can’t do that… Taiga won’t let me…

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well I thought you would want me in your tent...

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well, the bet we made was for me to stay with Taiga... I think that applies to the beach too...

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well... It would be too cramped if I stayed in you guys' tent.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Just like how it was on our first camping trip?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah, guys… I was actually planning to stay in Taiga’s tent.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Guys, it’s really okay! I’ve already decided!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Eduard, Lee, you two can go ahead and get some dinner! I'll take care of moving all our stuff into the tent!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-I’ll see you guys tomorrow!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Let’s go, Taiga?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Today was really fun, wasn’t it guys?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, you’re going to sleep too, Taiga?

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Wah…! Why are you taking your shirt off?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, r-right…!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Umm…

name: Keitaro
dialog: D-Do you mind if I sleep next to you?

dialog: Eduard and Lee already kinda took over the spot here on my right…

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Okay!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Y-Yes, Taiga?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh! You mean you had fun too?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’ll take that as a compliment then~

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hehehe…

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-What do you mean?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hehe, sure.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Good night, Taiga…

name: Keitaro
dialog: *sigh*

name: Keitaro
dialog: Whew…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ughh… What’s going on…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh no… Is there an emergency?

dialog: Ah, Natsumi..! Why would Scoutmaster Yoshi wake us all up this early?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yoichi, you can’t be left alone here..!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hiro?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Wake up, Hiro. It’s time to go! We’re going on a trip!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Aww… You must be really tired from yesterday, huh?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’ll go prepare your things for you. But you have to promise me you’ll wake up and get dressed, okay?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Wow! The beach?!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’m so excited! Imagine all the activities we can do there!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ahh~ This is so exciting!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I can’t help it, Hiro! I’ve never taken pictures of the ocean before! I can’t even remember the last time I went to the beach!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hey, guys! What about Yoichi?!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah, there he is..!

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Where is he going…? He’s headed in a different direction!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I should follow him!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Y-Yoichi, wait up!

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well… the group is heading in the opposite direction…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Don’t tell me you’re planning to go back to camp?

dialog: You deserve a belly rub!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I guess you were just surprised seeing me the first time, huh?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hehe... I don't mind her being sweet like this~

dialog: Why is she here though, Yoichi?

dialog: S-Scoutmaster Yoshi… Are you sure it’s okay for Yoichi to wander off alone in the woods like that…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Y-Yes, sir!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, I saw Yoichi heading somewhere else…

name: Keitaro
dialog: So, I went ahead and followed him…

name: Keitaro
dialog: It’s okay. I was just worried about Yoichi is all.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well… I noticed that Yoichi was gone too…

name: Keitaro
dialog: That’s why I went to look for him…

name: Keitaro
dialog: It’s okay. I was just worried about Yoichi is all.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah, it’s just like Hunter said… You guys were moving so fast that I couldn’t keep up.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Next thing I knew, I was lost.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yoichi wouldn’t do anything like that, I’m sure…

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well… I saw something interesting while we were hiking.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yoichi wouldn’t do anything like that, I’m sure…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Eh?! Nothing like that, Hiro! What makes you say that…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’m not sure about that, Hiro – you and Yoichi actually get along pretty well!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hello, Sir Aiden!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Don’t worry, sir! I’m sure he’ll catch up to us shortly!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh! Can I have two bottles please?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah! The other one’s for Yoichi, sir!

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-What? N-No I’m not, Hiro!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Don’t worry, Natsumi! I’m sure Hiro will be fine! He chows down like this all the time!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah! Scoutmaster Yoshi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Sure thing, Scoutmaster Yoshi! I actually have some water for him too!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Though he sure is taking his time in the woods… Do you think he’s alright?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I see…

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ahh… Well…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah… It’s true that Yoichi has a unique way of dealing with people…

name: Keitaro
dialog: But it’s just like you told me before, Scoutmaster Yoshi. He’s not a bad guy at all once you get to know him!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh… Yoichi did tell me about that… He said Yuki bit someone at camp…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Eh? Why would they do that?!

name: Keitaro
dialog: That’s horrible…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I see…

name: Keitaro
dialog: R-Right! Yes, sir!

name: Keitaro
dialog: This place is amazing!!!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I need to take a picture!!!

name: Keitaro
dialog: What a good shot!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Guys! I can’t wait to take a swim..!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh hey, guys!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Calm down, you two.

name: Keitaro
dialog: We’re here to have fun together!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I can’t believe it! This was a surprise vacation all along?!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I already told you guys, we all did this together!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Alright! Let’s go get changed then!

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ah! I’m sorry, Yoichi! W-What were you saying?

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-What?! I-It’s not like that…! I-I was just looking at… umm…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Not that I’m complaining but… your swimsuit looks really small on you… I can see almost everything…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I don’t think I’d know what to do if they let you…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Free sample?

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Okay then…

name: Keitaro
dialog: *opens mouth* Aaah….

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hotdog~!

name: Keitaro
dialog: H-Hey…! I was just trying to play along…

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-And you offered it to me, didn’t you?!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Umm… W-Well… if you say so…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I guess… Umm…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yes! Stuff it in my mouth please!

name: Keitaro
dialog: H-Hey! Come on! You offered, didn’t you?!

name: Keitaro
dialog: H-Hey! Stop messing with me, Yoichi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: *sigh* Now, I’m the dog?

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ahh…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh! Natsumi! Hunter!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Taiga...!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I agree, Taiga. You do look good in those trunks!

name: Keitaro
dialog: It’s a good start, though! I hope we can have fun with him on this vacation!

name: Keitaro
dialog: WAH!

dialog: Calm down, Ms. Yuri. You might pass out again...

dialog: Hey, no fair! Where did you get that water gun?!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Whoa! I almost forgot how good Natsumi is at swimming.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Wow! Natsumi, you’re so cool!!!

name: Keitaro
dialog: It always amazes me to see Natsumi swim! He’s like a pro!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, Seto! Felix! Come join us! The water’s great!

name: Keitaro
dialog: They’re really having fun, aren’t they?

name: Keitaro

name: Keitaro
dialog: I wouldn’t know what I’d do if I never see you again…

dialog: Hunter…!

dialog: I knew that you meant so much more to me than just a friend…

name: Keitaro
dialog: All this time, I’ve been holding back telling you that-

dialog: I really like you too, Hunter!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I really do, Hunter…

dialog: I know I only met you at this camp this summer, but I’ve liked everything about you…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I've never felt so connected to someone before…

dialog: You were only starting to really open up to me, but then I took things too fast with you and mistook your feelings of friendship with me…

name: Keitaro
dialog: As much as I wanted to be more than that… I realized that I should have given us time to grow and get to know each other better…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I hoped that even as friends, I could show you just how much I like you…

name: Keitaro
dialog: But now… you’re right in front of me… telling me the things I only wished I could hear.

name: Keitaro
dialog: That's why I hope you don't mind me not holding back this time...

name: Keitaro
dialog: *yawn*

dialog: …Natsumi. Where is he?

dialog: Oh, alright, Natsumi…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, what’s up, Natsumi? Still thinking of which badge you wanna go for?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ack! There goes my surprise…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah, I really do~ Haha!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh! How about we earn it together with my camera then, Natsumi?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Great! Where should we start then?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Eh? Where did you get that?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Umm… Okay…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Umm… That actually makes sense, but-

dialog: W-Wait, Natsumi…! You might be taking the guidelines in that book too literally.

name: Keitaro
dialog: We can also try to have fun and do what feels most natural when we take the photo… That’s what I do when I take pictures.

dialog: That’s a great idea, Natsumi!

dialog: …Your hobbies!

dialog: You used to collect bugs when you were younger, right?

dialog: Oh, you kinda mentioned it on our first camping trip~!

dialog: …Your favorite animal! I remember you told me beetles were your favorite insects!

dialog: Oh, you kinda mentioned it on our first camping trip~!

dialog: Of course! Haha! You even told me you’d catch one for me too!

dialog: No, not at all! It’s actually really cool!

dialog: Haha! Guess we've got a subject for our photography badge then!

dialog: But where do we even find a beetle around here?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Alright, Natsumi! Let me just go get my camera! Then we'll head out!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Haha, yeah!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I know, right? That’d be so awkward!

dialog: Imagine telling him it's because we're out here hunting for beetles, Natsumi! Hahaha!

dialog: Is there a specific type of beetle we’re looking for?

dialog: Oh, so your brother's name is Naoto. His name sounds pretty close to yours!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, I see…

dialog: Haha! That’s right, Natsumi~!

dialog: Huh?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Wah!

dialog: Whoa! I didn’t notice that at all! This is... a stag beetle, right?

dialog: Wow… Its horns are so big! Won’t he bite you?

dialog: Haha, I guess beetles like the easygoing Natsumi too~!

dialog: Do you think this photo is good enough for us both to earn the photography badge, though?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Sure thing~!

dialog: We decided to try and earn the photography badge, sir!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Here you go, sir!

dialog: Oh! That’s the one Natsumi took!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, wow! My first ever badge!

dialog: Natsumi, you’ve gotta show me how to pin this onto my uniform later!

dialog: We sure did! Right, Natsumi?

dialog: Oh, haha! I wasn’t gonna say anything! I really don’t mind helping Sir Aiden with cooking dinner~!

dialog: Of course, Natsumi. I don't have anything else to do right now, and I'm not tired yet either.

dialog: Well, you did tell me you were trying to find some balance this morning~ So, I understand.

dialog: Besides, we just had a really relaxing time taking photos in the woods together.

dialog: Now, let’s go and help Sir Aiden out!

dialog: Oh, what are you cooking, sir?

dialog: I’ve got the firewood, sir!

dialog: Hehe~ Let’s get this campfire started!

dialog: Haha! I have to admit, though, I kinda got carried away taking so many photos!

dialog: Sure, Hunter! They’re in my camera bag! I can show them to you guys tomorrow when the sun's up!

dialog: Oh… Are you sure you don’t wanna talk some more?

dialog: R-Right! See you later, Taiga!

dialog: Well, maybe Taiga is just adjusting to us being friends!

dialog: I’m just glad that Taiga said that – I think we can really get to be friends now!

dialog: Yes! We just have to forget about the past! Taiga deserves a second chance, after all!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Alright!

dialog: Yeah, summer weather's really weird, huh Hunter?

dialog: Yeah~ We can do that first thing in the morning! They're all just in my camera bag anyway~

dialog: Is that why you're still in swimwear, sir?

dialog: Come on, Natsumi! It’ll be okay! Scoutmaster Yoshi is gonna be there to keep watch!

dialog: Oh! I should take pictures too! Let me just get my camera!

dialog: Hmm… I can’t find my camera bag. Do you see it over there, Natsumi?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oops, you’re right about that, Natsumi. And besides, we’ll be swimming anyway! What was I thinking? Haha!

dialog: Let’s just get changed and catch up with everyone!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ahh~! The evening breeze is so nice!

dialog: Oh, Scoutmaster Yoshi! I was about to. I was just enjoying the evening breeze for a minute!

name: Keitaro
dialog: It's just been really warm tonight. And I've been watching these calm waves for a while.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Haha, looks like you really prepared for this, sir. As usual!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah, it’s no problem at all, sir. I was just there to help you however I could.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, yes, sir. It’s been really fun hanging out with him!

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh…? W-What do you mean, Scoutmaster Yoshi?

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ah! I don’t think I’m capable of following in your footsteps, Scoutmaster Yoshi… But I’m really honored to hear that from you.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Thank you, Scoutmaster Yoshi… I don’t think I deserve all this praise, though...

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, he's just by the seaside over there, trying to take in the breeze too, sir. He looked a little concerned earlier, so I decided to stick by and do the same.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Alright, sir!

dialog: Hey there, Natsumi! Aren’t you gonna join in?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh...

dialog: Are you still worried about us getting in trouble for night swimming…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-Is that why you’re hiding here?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, you can tell me what you’re thinking, and I’ll listen…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well… we’ve always followed Scoutmaster Yoshi because we know he has his reasons.

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’m sure he just wants to spend time with us and show that he can have fun too…

name: Keitaro
dialog: It’s kind of like how you hung out with us instead of doing chores, when you learned to relax a little.

name: Keitaro
dialog: But I do get why you feel that way, though...

dialog: When I first joined camp, I always thought of Scoutmaster Yoshi as someone who always stuck to the rules no matter what.

name: Keitaro
dialog: But as the days went by, I slowly realized there was more to him than a leader we needed to follow. He was a person who had his own flaws too…

name: Keitaro
dialog: And that’s perfectly fine! In fact, I respect him much more because of it!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Natsumi…?

dialog: Only you can answer that, Natsumi…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’m sure you have your reasons, Natsumi… You probably just don’t know what they are yet…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’m not sure either, Natsumi…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I don’t think there’s any point in thinking about it, Natsumi.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Look. You may not have the answers now, but that doesn’t mean you’re not trying hard enough…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Some things just take time to figure out… You shouldn’t be so hard on yourself.

name: Keitaro
dialog: What you’re feeling right now is normal…

name: Keitaro
dialog: But I want you to realize that these moments are all a part of learning more about yourself.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Of course, Natsumi. I’ll always be here for you to help you out.

name: Keitaro
dialog: That’s right! We just keep at it together!

name: Keitaro
dialog: If you want, you could always take your mind off things by helping me write in my journal.

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh, we were just enjoying the breeze, sir!

dialog: O-Oh, not really, no…

name: Keitaro
dialog: It’s nothing like that at all, guys!

dialog: A-Ah, sure thing! I can come and help right away!

dialog: I’ll see you guys later, okay?

dialog: Oh! I just figured we’d finish faster if we took this down together.

dialog: Well, don’t worry! I’m sure today’s activity won’t be so bad!

dialog: Want me to help you take the tent down, Taiga?

dialog: Ahehehe…

dialog: We were having a great time yesterday and I hope that one small thing from last night won’t ruin your day…

dialog: W-What do you mean?

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Alright!

dialog: It’s good to see you’re in a better mood now, Taiga!

dialog: A-Ah, I’m sorry, I wasn’t trying to do anything like that…

dialog: Wanna go and swim there later?

dialog: Ehehe, sorry I’m too lame for you.

dialog: It’s really beautiful, huh Taiga?

dialog: Hehe, yeah… It kind of reminds me of you, actually.

dialog: A-Ah, no, not at all! I-I was just saying that it’s big and powerful, b-but it’s also peaceful and relaxing to look at~!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ehehe, sorry I’m too lame for you.

dialog: A-Ack…! I didn’t mean to! I promise I was listening though!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Whew… All set up!

dialog: Maybe you guys can take a dip to freshen up!

dialog: Haha, Eduard and Lee sure are fun people to be around. I get why you’re friends with them.

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ahh, actually they didn’t. I think they already know by now that I’ll choose to hang out with you.

dialog: Well, they’re probably busy with their own stuff anyway. I’m fine staying here with you, though!

dialog: I know you hate crowds. Do you wanna go somewhere relaxing?

dialog: A-Ah, well—

dialog: Aww, Taiga...

dialog: Wahhh… It’s so cool!

dialog: *sigh* Let’s just follow Scoutmaster Yoshi back to the campsite...

dialog: Alright…

dialog: Even today, he was chatting with me normally, and agreed to come to the top of the falls with me.

dialog: I’ll be right back, okay? I just need some fresh air…

dialog: O-Oh, I see… That’s too bad…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh no…

dialog: O-Oh…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I hope you don’t mind if I sit here…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Umm, Taiga… I wanted to thank you…

name: Keitaro
dialog: My camera… I was able to get it back… Sir Aiden told me how you went and got it for me…

name: Keitaro
dialog: D-Don’t worry… Sir Aiden told me he could fix it.

name: Keitaro
dialog: I don’t think it’s completely your fault though…

dialog: Scoutmaster Yoshi has been testing your patience since we got to the beach…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Y-Yeah…  Whenever he tries to mention anything from last year, you get upset…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Taiga… Why are you always so angry at Scoutmaster Yoshi?

name: Keitaro
dialog: B-But then, what is-

name: Keitaro
dialog: B-But I don’t think that’s the whole story!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’m sure you had your reasons that they didn’t understand…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Why does the past make you so upset, Taiga?

name: Keitaro

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’m sure you had your reasons that they didn’t understand…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I just want to know how you really felt about what happened back then...

name: Keitaro
dialog: For you to be hurt this badly, I can't imagine how horrible everything was for you..

dialog: That looks good too, Hunter! I think Ms. Yuri would approve any of these drafts!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Haha! Looks like you’re really enjoying yourself, Hunter!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Say, Hunter. I’ve been thinking about what you told me yesterday…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I know you probably haven’t considered this, but…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I could honestly see you attending an art school after the summer!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I mean… with your passion and skill, I know you’d be successful if you really choose to pursue it!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I know so!

name: Keitaro
dialog: But isn't this what makes you really happy?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’m sure your parents will support you if they see how much you love art!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Have you at least tried convincing them that art is probably what will make you really happy…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: *sigh* I wish your parents were more supportive…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I mean… they should know by now that art is something that’ll make you really happy.

name: Keitaro
dialog: *sigh* Your parents are so closed-minded…

name: Keitaro
dialog: They should know by now that art is something that’ll make you really happy.

name: Keitaro
dialog: But I think it’s still worth a shot to try and convince them.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Maybe you could show them just how much your art has improved with the fundraising campaign!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Since we’re making official posters and brochures that’ll be mass-produced for the public, I think it’s the perfect time to show them that art is a successful path for you to follow!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yup! Hunter here was actually the one who drafted them all. I just gave him some suggestions here and there.

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh, Hunter! Maybe we can ask advice from Ms. Yuri… about what we were talking about?

name: Keitaro
dialog: You know… you possibly going to an art school?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Who knows? She might actually be able to help us find a way to convince your parents! She’s our camp counselor, after all!

name: Keitaro
dialog: And besides, you’ve only heard my opinion. The more people you hear this from, the better!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Don’t worry, Hunter! I’ll be with you every step of the way!

name: Keitaro
dialog: *holds Hunter’s hand*

name: Keitaro
dialog: N-No, we’re not flirting with each other, Ms. Yuri! W-We’re just—

name: Keitaro
dialog: S-Scoutmaster Yoshi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah… We were waiting for her feedback, but we think… something might have distracted her a little.

name: Keitaro
dialog: What can I help you with, sir?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh yes, sir! I’ve been writing all of my different experiences from the camp in it!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’m really loving being able to put stories down with the pictures I take!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Eh?! You really wanna read my journal, Scoutmaster Yoshi?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-I’d love to show you!! I’ve been recording everything, ever since the day I got the journal!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Although, is it alright if I add my latest entries first?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Of course, Scoutmaster Yoshi! I’m really excited for you to read it!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Right! Thanks again, Scoutmaster Yoshi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ah… Sorry I’m late, guys.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah, he was just interested in reviewing the journal Ms. Yuri gave me, Hunter. Nothing too serious.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Anyway, is there anything I can help with?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, okay, Ms. Yuri!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hmm…

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Wah!

name: Keitaro
dialog: U-Uhh… I… don’t know! I just tried turning it on, Ms. Yuri…

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh no! Did I break it, Ms. Yuri?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah… I’m really sorry, Ms. Yuri.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Maybe we can have someone repair it…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh! I’ll go and fetch him, Ms. Yuri! I kinda want to make up for not being here while you guys worked on the brochure.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yes, Ms. Yuri! We’ll be right back~

name: Keitaro
dialog: Okay! Sir Aiden should be here somewhere…

name: Keitaro
dialog: That explains why it smells so good here! I’m getting hungry just from the smell.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Maybe we can grab a snack along the way~

name: Keitaro
dialog: What’s with the boxes, Hiro?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah, right!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, we were looking for Sir Aiden… The printer broke in the office, and we wanted to ask him if he could help us fix it.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Wow, that’s exactly the kind of snack I’ve been craving!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hello, Sir Aiden.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, well… it’s the printer in the office.

name: Keitaro
dialog: When I tried turning it on earlier, it broke down all of a sudden…

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh, we see. Thanks for your time, Sir Aiden.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, thanks, Sir Aiden! We’ll make sure to go and ask Scoutmaster Yoshi next!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Alright! I’ll try out the frog-shaped ones!

name: Keitaro
dialog: *munch munch*

name: Keitaro
dialog: These are delicious..!!

name: Keitaro
dialog: *munch munch*

name: Keitaro
dialog: If the frog and bunny ones are this good, I bet the others are just as tasty too!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hehe sorry, Hiro! We couldn’t help it!

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Wha…! Are you serious, Sir Aiden?!

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ah, right! Sorry we got distracted!

name: Keitaro
dialog: But thanks again for the cookies, guys!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah, those cookies really hit the spot!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Anyway, should we go look for Scoutmaster Yoshi now? Maybe he can help us with the printer.

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh, you’re right…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hello, Scoutmaster Yoshi, Yoichi! What are you guys doing?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Scoutmaster Yoshi, is Yoichi really the person best suited for this job…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah, we did, Scoutmaster Yoshi. But Sir Aiden told us he doesn’t know all that much about computers either…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Maybe we should go ask our friends…? I bet there’s at least one person who knows something about computers…

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh! Seto, Natsumi and Lee!

name: Keitaro
dialog: They’re probably the smartest guys here in camp! Why didn’t we think of asking them before?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hey, Natsumi! What are you guys up to?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, we were thinking if you could—

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-What…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: We were gonna ask if you guys knew anything about computers…? The printer in the office kinda broke, and none of us knows how to fix it.

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-Well… I really just turned on the power after not using it for a long time.

name: Keitaro
dialog: U-Umm… the what…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Haha, I guess we’ll just let him fix this problem himself.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Bye, guys!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh wow! That’s really cool! It’s working fine again~

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Okay!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh! Yeah, Lee helped us fix it! Here’s a sample we tried to print, Mr. Yuri!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Alright, Ms. Yuri!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Alright! We should start printing! This is really going to take a lot of our time!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, you’ve actually changed as well, Eduard. You’ve become so much more approachable!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-I haven’t really talked to him since you asked me for that favor… I don’t think I’ve seen him around either… so I haven't really had the chance to do so…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, at least we finished everything! I actually feel really fulfilled!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Okay, Ms. Yuri~ Let’s go, Hunter!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, I was thinking of finishing my journal now since Scoutmaster Yoshi wanted to take a peek at it!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Okay, Hunter!~ Let’s go grab my—

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hmm…? Is that Taiga?

name: Keitaro
dialog: H-Hey, Taiga! Wait up!

name: Keitaro
dialog: M-My journal!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Taiga, no!

name: Keitaro
dialog: T-Taiga, please don’t do this…! C-Can’t we just talk it out? We’re friends, remember?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Taiga… You’re the one who shut them out. You shut all of us out! P-Please, just put that down and let’s talk about this-

name: Keitaro
dialog: But isn't that what you want too?! That's why you came back here in the first place, isn't it?! The truth is you want to be here just as much as I do!

name: Keitaro
dialog: NOOO!!! MY JOURNAL!!!!

name: Keitaro
dialog: No, Hunter! Wait…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-I know, Hunter…

name: Keitaro
dialog: But just look at him… Taiga’s already this desperate…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Let’s just leave, Hunter…

name: Keitaro
dialog: *sigh*

name: Keitaro
dialog: I really don’t think hurting Taiga or getting him kicked out of camp will do us any good now…

name: Keitaro
dialog: If you guys had seen the way he looked, you’d understand…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Please don’t get me wrong, guys… I’m really angry and upset about what Taiga did…

name: Keitaro
dialog: *sigh*

name: Keitaro
dialog: I think I need some time alone to think about this.  I’m gonna go outside and get some fresh air.

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’ll just head back to my cabin…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Umm… Well…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I hate to say it, but… yeah, I am really upset…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I can’t pretend to know what you’re going through because… maybe I really was wrong the whole time…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I tried so hard to change you… But maybe that was just a waste of time…

name: Keitaro
dialog: But… I really want to understand why you had to burn my journal… Especially when you knew how important it was to me.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Do you really hate me that much…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: *sigh*

name: Keitaro
dialog: I still forgive you for what you did… We all have our own monsters inside us, anyways…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I guess… everybody has a reason for the things they do…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I try to think about what I would do if I were in your shoes, and if I would act the same way…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I just really want to understand people more, so that I can see the way they see…

name: Keitaro
dialog: You might think that I’m just pretending to be nice… but… who would I be fooling? We’re the only ones here…

name: Keitaro
dialog: T-Taiga…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Can you tell me what happened to you...?

name: Keitaro
dialog: M-Maybe if you told me the truth, I could really help you...

name: Keitaro
dialog: Taiga…

name: Keitaro
dialog: It’s alright, Taiga… I still forgive you. There’s no reason to hate you, even now. It wouldn’t do either of us any good…

name: Keitaro
dialog: It’s alright… You don’t have to say you’re sorry, Taiga…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hi, everyone… I’m back.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah, I’m fine… Thank you, guys.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yup! I’m alright – today was just tiring, and so many things happened.

name: Keitaro
dialog: It really sucks that my journal was burnt up like that but… there’s nothing we can do about it now!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Besides, we have plenty of time left at the camp for me to take new pictures and start a new journal again!

name: Keitaro
dialog: T-Thank you, everyone… *sniff*

name: Keitaro
dialog: *sigh*

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah, I guess I woke up earlier than usual today.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah…! I’m alright, Natsumi… What happened stinks, but we can’t really do anything about it.

name: Keitaro
dialog: A special announcement, huh? I wonder what it could be.

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ah, no, Natsumi…! I’m really fine!

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Of course, Natsumi… Thank you.

name: Keitaro
dialog: S-Sure, Natsumi. I don’t mind.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Can’t we just join other groups, Natsumi…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I can’t really think of anything right now, Natsumi…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I don’t really mind any activity, Natsumi.

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’ll leave it up to you, Natsumi. What do you think we should do?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh? What do you have in mind, Seto?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Y-You don’t know?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hmm… Maybe we should go ask around? I’m sure someone will be able to-

name: Keitaro
dialog: We should at least hear out what he has to say.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hmm… a poster, huh? I think Hunter’s group is already making that one.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah, but it does sound like a lot of fun, though! I’m kinda excited to see what we can come up with for the camp!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Alright, Natsumi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: What’s with the boxes, Hiro?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, that sounds really cool!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah! Just the idea of filming a video’s got me really excited.

name: Keitaro
dialog: That’s a really good idea, Natsumi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Haha, I’ll definitely let Seto and Lee know, Hiro.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Looks like everyone is pretty serious about their activity, huh?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Eh? Is that Eduard? What is he doing in here?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Umm, hey guys! How’s it going?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, right! Ms. Yuri mentioned something about a creative activity earlier.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hold on… Those drawings on the floor… you’re throwing all of those away?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah, Hunter! These are amazing! It’s a shame you’re just gonna throw all these away…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Uhh… We’d love to help, but we’re actually working on our activity right now!

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ahh, well, we’re actually doing something similar to this, Hunter.

name: Keitaro
dialog: We’re gonna do advertisements… but in a digital format.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, it’s actually why we’re looking for Scoutmaster Yoshi in the first place, Eduard. We wanted to ask if the idea was okay before we did anything else.

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Anyway! Thanks for the help, Eduard…! We’ll go to them now!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Thank you, Hunter! Good luck with the activities, you guys!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Looks like Eduard was right. He is with Yoichi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Scoutmaster Yoshi, is Yoichi really the person best suited for this job…?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yep! I was paying attention to what everyone said too, in case it would help with our filming.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Okay, Natsumi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, Felix! Did you need something?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Are you planning on helping us too? I was surprised we didn’t see you with Seto earlier, actually.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ummm… I don’t think they have the money for that, Felix.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ahaha… I think you misunderstood, Felix. The camp isn’t really as well funded as you think. There isn’t really any way for them to do something risky like that.

name: Keitaro
dialog: That’s why we have to do all these activities! So we can raise funds and promote the camp for next year!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Eh? Are you going somewhere, Felix?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Sure! Bye, Felix!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hmmm… I wonder what Felix’s idea is?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, right! Let’s go!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Not only that, he also gave us permission to use whatever facility we have at the camp!

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Ahh… mine is an instant camera, Natsumi…

name: Keitaro
dialog: It won’t be able to record videos, unfortunately…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Maybe we should ask the scoutmasters if they have a video camera? They did say we could use the camp's facilities...

name: Keitaro
dialog: Aww… We can’t just give up on this, can we?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Really? He’s done film-making before?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I’ll come with you, Natsumi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-I’m the cameraman?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Haha, okay, I guess….

name: Keitaro
dialog: I have to say, Lee… you’re leading us a lot better than I thought.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh sure, Natsumi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Huh. Where is everyone?

name: Keitaro
dialog: We probably finished a little earlier than usual, huh?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Whew…! I can’t believe we did so much today!

name: Keitaro
dialog: You know, I’m really excited to try that camera out tomorrow too~! Haha!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah... There was really no use sulking over what happened yesterday, anyway.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah, thank you, Natsumi.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah… I guess I just needed a distraction from what happened yesterday.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah, thank you, Natsumi.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well… you were a big help, Natsumi.

name: Keitaro
dialog: You spent the whole day trying to cheer me up, and I really appreciate it.

name: Keitaro
dialog: You know I’m happy when I’m with you, Natsumi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: It’s all because of you, Natsumi…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I noticed you were trying all day to cheer me up and keep me from thinking too much about what happened yesterday.

name: Keitaro
dialog: If it wasn’t for you, I wouldn’t have had fun today at all… So, thank you so much for that!

name: Keitaro
dialog: You know I’m happy when I’m with you, Natsumi!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Anyway! I guess I’m pretty worn out now.

name: Keitaro
dialog: I probably used too much of my brain on all that storyboarding… It wasn’t as easy as it looked.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah, well… I usually just write in my journal in times like these, but…

name: Keitaro
dialog: N-Natsumi? Are you okay?

name: Keitaro
dialog: It’s alright, Natsumi! I’m good, really!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I was just asking if you wanted to join me in the showers, and we can chill here in the cabin after.

name: Keitaro
dialog: You have chores today?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ahehe, w-well, okay, Natsumi! Mind if I go ahead then?

name: Keitaro
dialog: If anyone asks for me at dinner, just tell them I turned in early, alright?

name: Keitaro
dialog: *yawn*

name: Keitaro
dialog: Nnn… You’re up early, Taiga…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Hehe, you’re right about that.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, I just noticed. Where are Eduard and Lee?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Aww, that’s great!

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-What? Why me?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ack… B-But they talk like that with you too, right?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-I really don’t wanna take all the credit, Taiga. You helped them too!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I mean… You were their friend for so long, and even if things weren’t perfect, you three still enjoyed each other’s company! Just like real friends do!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, you started it~

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ahehe…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, right! Why don’t we go out and see what we can find?

name: Keitaro
dialog: It looks like no one's doing their activities in the campgrounds right now.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh! Good morning, Sir Goro!

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Actually, sir, we don’t have a specific activity yet… But we did go around and help everyone with theirs yesterday!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Do you need help with anything, Sir Goro? Taiga and I are available!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Of course, sir! We’d be happy to!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yes, sir!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I never expected Sir Goro to ask us for help like this. He really has been softening up the last few days!

name: Keitaro
dialog: T-Taiga! Shh!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Y-Yes, sir!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Let’s go, Taiga!

name: Keitaro
dialog: U-Umm, sir…? I was just looking at this shopping list and there’s a lot here.

name: Keitaro
dialog: If you don’t mind me asking, what are you going to do in city hall, sir?

name: Keitaro
dialog: That’s true… I guess I never thought of it like that…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Don't you want to do the fun activities too, sir?

name: Keitaro
dialog: T-That makes sense…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Although… I think everyone is thankful for the work you do, and aren’t intimidated anymore, sir!

name: Keitaro
dialog: After all, you’ve already given us things like the beach and waterfall trip this summer!

name: Keitaro
dialog: All of us behaving and listening just means that we respect you!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I can handle the baking supplies, Sir Goro!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I noticed the list didn’t specify which brands to get, and I’m pretty familiar with the stuff that Sir Aiden and Hiro use in the kitchen. So, I think it’s best that I do it!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yes, sir!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Let’s see… I already have two dozen eggs… three bags of sugar…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Next on my list… five bags of flour.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Wow... This is a lot for some tiny cookies...

name: Keitaro
dialog: I guess it makes sense since we're trying to sell a lot of them.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Now, if I remember correctly from yesterday, Sir Aiden and Hiro used almond flour for their recipe…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh! There it is!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Man… Does it really need to be that high up?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Nnngh…! I can’t reach it…!

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh…!

name: Keitaro
dialog: F-Five please!

name: Keitaro
dialog: T-Thank you…!

name: Keitaro
dialog: T-That’d be all…! Thanks… Uhh.. Jungkook!

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh…! I thought that was your name… It’s on your tag…

name: Keitaro
dialog: Nice to meet you too, Haruki! I'm Keitaro!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ah, no, I'm actually buying them for our camp! I'm a scout at Camp Buddy!

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh, yes!

name: Keitaro
dialog: W-What?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-I'm really confused...

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-I'm not a stalker, I swear! I'm just into photography!

name: Keitaro
dialog: U-Umm...

name: Keitaro
dialog: I-It's alright...! I would probably react the same way if people followed me around.

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh, yes, definitely! That's actually why we're here today - we're gathering a bunch of supplies for a fundraiser we're running!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Everyone is participating in different ways, from making cookies and posters, to going door to door!

name: Keitaro
dialog: R-Really?! We're actually looking for recruits next summer, too! You can apply if you want!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I'm sure you'd have a great time!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Awesome! We'd love to see you at camp!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Thank you again for the help, Haruki!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Well, that was interesting...

name: Keitaro
dialog: Ack! I almost forgot, there's still flavorings to get too!

name: Keitaro
dialog: I'd better get the rest of the list before Taiga and Sir Goro finish!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, Taiga! Thanks for holding the line!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Looks like you’ve made a friend, huh Taiga?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah… I talked to one a while ago too…

name: Keitaro
dialog: I can imagine how tough that can get.

name: Keitaro
dialog: You should, we’d love to have you! I-If you’re not too busy working, that is.

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Of course, sir! We’d be happy to!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Sir Goro sure has mellowed out since the sportsfest, hasn’t he?

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah, it is! I hope it goes well!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Right!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, what about your other interests, Taiga?

name: Keitaro
dialog: I know you like crafting, but I haven’t really seen you do any other hobbies.

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh…!

name: Keitaro
dialog: R-Really? T-That’s interesting…!

name: Keitaro
dialog: Y-Yeah, I remember…! Y-You got a little upset when you saw us holding it…

name: Keitaro
dialog: *gulp*

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah, I get what you mean.

name: Keitaro
dialog: And now that I think about it, it’s something I never would’ve expected you to be interested in.

name: Keitaro
dialog: A-Although, I haven’t seen you write at all while we’ve been at camp.

name: Keitaro
dialog: That makes sense, camp has been so busy lately!

name: Keitaro
dialog: H-Hello! It’s nice to meet you.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Yeah, I just enrolled this term with a friend.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Oh, we were just sent out to get some supplies for a fundraising activity.

name: Keitaro
dialog: O-Oh, Sir Goro was with us, but he had a meeting to catch.

name: Keitaro
dialog: Y-Yeah, I guess it did…!

name: Keitaro
dialog: We’re actually running a campaign to get more recruits for next year, as well as donations for the camp!

name: Keitaro
