dialog: We’re going to have a badge-earning activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have here a list of possible badges you can earn! Each of the badges corresponds to certain tasks or good deeds you have to do in order for you to earn them!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, yes! These badges are carefully hand-crafted, definitely one of a kind!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You campers don’t have to worry about the category of the tasks since I’ve made sure we’ve got a badge for each of your varying interests!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There’s no failing in this activity! I just want you all to discover yourselves better and be rewarded for the effort you exert!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What’s amazing is you get to keep the badges that you earn even after your program here in Camp Buddy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir...!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Campers! Take your time deciding which of these special badges you want to earn! Your choices have to be based on what individually defines you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Your scoutmasters will be waiting for each of you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Dismissed!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! Please don’t mind Yuri!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmm? May I ask why Yoichi is carrying you? Are you hurt?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah~ I’m glad to hear that there was nothing to worry about, Keitaro. I just assumed the worst when I saw Yoichi carrying you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And how helpful of you, Yoichi! You were there when Keitaro needed you just like a good scout would be!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I am so proud to see you behaving so responsibly and chivalrous! For that, your efforts should be rewarded!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A muscle badge! To honor your exceptional strength and outstandingly masculine physique!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve been holding onto this badge for you for a while now, but you’ve always been so disinterested in the activities to earn it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m glad you’re finally starting to participate in them now!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Maybe Keitaro here is a good influence on you, after all~

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-What is…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Gah! Good heavens!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Why would you take these photos, Keitaro...?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: N-No, Yuri…! We can’t do that! These badges are yet to be earned by the other campers who are still working on their activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-And besides, it would be highly inappropriate to reward this kind of... ermm... content...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: B-But... having this kind of-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh*... Well... I suppose, disregarding the theme of this photograph, this may prove to be... somewhat artistic.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess, by some standard of expression, you really have earned this badge, Keitaro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And as for that photograph, Yuri…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *snatches the photo from Yuri*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can’t let you have this, Yuri.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m in charge of this activity, remember? So, everything related will be discharged to my possession.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: T-That’s preposterous! I wouldn’t do something like that!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuri! You’ve already badgered these campers long enough! It’s time for you to calm down.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro won’t be giving you anything, Yuri. Come along now!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good! Come closer, and let me demonstrate how to do it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah! Yoichi, Keitaro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I thought you two were going to relax while everyone else finished with their activities?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sorry if we confused you two! Natsumi here is trying to earn his CPR Badge.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ehem! Allow me to explain, Yoichi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: When someone is saved from drowning, they often have water in their lungs and can’t breathe properly!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In order to save them, you often have to perform mouth-to-mouth resuscitation!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Close, Yoichi! It’s when place your mouth on the victim's while pinching their nose shut to push air into their lungs.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sure, I’d be happy to teach you two!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: How about we let you partner with Keitaro here for this activity. That is, if you’re not as comfortable to doing it with us?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That sounds like a yes to me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll let you try it out for yourself first, Yoichi! Why don’t you lie on the ground, Keitaro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Perfect! Now Yoichi, go ahead and position yourself over him!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Perfect! Now, pinch Keitaro’s nose close, and put your mouth over his, Yoichi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s it! Now give Keitaro a breath of air!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, that was good for your first try, Yoichi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Were you able to observe, Natsumi?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Great! Then let’s try it together as well! I'll lay on the ground and you can perform CPR on me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Come over here as well, Keitaro, Yoichi! We’ll show you both a few techniques to improve your resuscitation!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And perfect! Great job, you two! You really got the hang of it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even still, I think you did quite well too, Yoichi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m proud to say that I believe you three are now capable of saving someone with this skill now!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Having said that, you’ve all earned this badge!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course! You three earned it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I agree with Natsumi, Yoichi! It’s so great to see you enjoying yourself with camp activities!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Maybe next time we have a badge-earning activity, you can earn even more!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha! That’s the spirit, Yoichi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway! It’s getting late and I need to go and make sure all of the other campers have at least finished with their activities!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Why don’t the three of you head back to your tent and relax?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure it won’t be long before we’re called to dinner!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course not, Yoichi! We’re having BBQ tonight!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It was my pleasure, Keitaro! See you boys at dinner!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good evening, Keitaro! Aren’t you gonna join them for a swim?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, I was just enjoying the breeze myself! It’s a beautiful night out, after all.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! Before I forget, I wanted to thank you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You somehow managed to make Yoichi participate in the activity today.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I always seem to have difficulty getting him to come and do them with everyone else…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In fact, I can definitely say Yoichi has improved tremendously ever since this term started.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I noticed that he’s been spending a lot of time with you and his fellow scouts. I think you’ve all been a great influence on him!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, I still believe that he sees you in a special way! I've never seen him open up to someone else like that before...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: To be honest, I'd love it if he was that straightforward and honest with me! What's your secret?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I see..

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* As for me, I’m pretty sure he’s still holding a grudge over what happened last year…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes… it really was unfortunate that I had to do that… The two of them are quite close, as you can tell…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi may seem like an independent guy, but he’s not really as strong as you believe him to be.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi alone can’t take care of Yuki. His outgoing demeanor makes it easy for him to forget how to properly take care of a sensitive pet like her.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I make sure to go and feed and exercise Yuki some when Yoichi isn’t around myself to make sure she’s properly taken care of.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes. But please don’t tell him that… I wouldn’t want him to think that he’s not doing enough for Yuki.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmm? What is it, Keitaro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahh… It’s because Yoichi had such a tough time growing up…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuki was the only family he had when I first took Yoichi in… So, the least I can do is make things a little better for him here in Camp Buddy…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah! Don’t worry about it, Keitaro. I just blurt things out sometimes! You’re one of the few people I can talk about things like this with, after all.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Not only do you have a way with words, but you’re also a great listener too! Maybe one day you could become a scoutmaster like me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll gladly pass the Camp Buddy torch to you when the time comes!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I really do mean it, Keitaro! You’ve helped me sort out my frustrations before, and now you’re helping your fellow campers too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You truly are a model scout!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course, you do!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I think I’ve taken enough of your time! Go and have fun with your friends!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir? What’s going on here?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro… Why would you do this?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I never thought you, of all people, would do something this immature…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We let you bring your camera with you, trusting you would only use it for something meaningful.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have no choice but to confiscate it until this issue is resolved.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t want to hear any excuses right now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’d like all of you to go back to your respective tents and stand by until further notice... I’ll go and sort things out with Sir Goro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir! Don’t you think you’re being too rash with this decision—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Those two headed into the forest! We have to follow them..!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What if they get lost there?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll… go talk to him…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir, I’m really concerned about Keitaro and Hiro… Can we at least start a search for them before we leave this place?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s already late, and if we don’t hurry they could be stranded in the woods for the night.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m not sure those boys are properly equipped to handle a night out there…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even still, sir! We can’t just let two scouts go missing, especially after the incident last year!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t you think that two missing scouts will only add to the damaged reputation of the camp?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can’t take this anymore! You may refuse to see how serious this is, but didn’t you just hear what I said?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We have two missing scouts! Is that not clear enough for you?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whether or not you believe they’re a bad influence doesn’t matter – their safety is much more important.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m going to search for them. I don’t need your approval to do what I know is right!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No, sir! You’re the one who doesn’t understand!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir? What’s going on here?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro… Why would you do this?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I never thought you, of all people, would do something this immature…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We let you bring your camera with you, trusting you would only use it for something meaningful.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have no choice but to confiscate it until this issue is resolved.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t want to hear any excuses right now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’d like all of you to go back to your respective tents and stand by until further notice... I’ll go and sort things out with Sir Goro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro, I can explain. Last night’s swimming was completely under my supervision and—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: B-But sir… Everyone’s here, safe and sound! Isn’t that what matters? We were all just enjoying our time and—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir, the night swimming I initiated with the scouts was fully under control! I had no problems while supervising them at all!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I did it so the boys could really make the most of their time at the beach!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-It was just an innocent prank… you know how boys can be…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know… Keitaro is quite the model scout… but what if this escalates into the exact same situation as last year…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: R-Right...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, I’m counting on you, Yuri… Thanks…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Natsumi! Please wake the scouts up and tell them to get changed. Our activity's all prepared, and we can start immediately!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, and good morning, Keitaro! You're quite the early bird this morning too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I suppose that’s one less scout to wake up now, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good! That’s the Natsumi I know!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright! Looks like everyone’s here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have an announcement for all of you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As I was saying! I’ve gathered you all this morning for a surprise activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know we told you guys that this trip was supposed to be a vacation but I guarantee that this activity is fun and filled with excitement!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re going to have a badge-earning activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have here a list of possible badges you can earn! Each of the badges corresponds to certain tasks or good deeds you have to do in order for you to earn them!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, yes! These badges are carefully hand-crafted, definitely one of a kind!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You campers don’t have to worry about the category of the tasks since I’ve made sure we’ve got a badge for each of your varying interests!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There’s no failing in this activity! I just want you all to discover yourselves better and be rewarded for the effort you exert!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What’s amazing is you get to keep the badges that you earn even after your program here in Camp Buddy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir...!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Campers! Take your time deciding which of these special badges you want to earn! Your choices have to be based on what individually defines you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Your scoutmasters will be waiting for each of you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Dismissed!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh! Welcome back, boys! What badge were you trying to earn?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, of course! I’m not surprised at all!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’d actually made the photography badge with you in mind, Keitaro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Although, I am a bit surprised that you decided to join Keitaro on this activity, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I see! Then, let’s see what kind of photos you boys were able to take!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, wow! The quality of these pictures is fantastic!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But this has to be the best one of the bunch!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whoa! Now I didn’t expect that!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It looks you followed all the guidelines from the Camp Buddy Badge Earning Manual, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The angle, lighting and especially the focus on this photo is exactly how it was described in the rulebook!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now that’s an even bigger surprise, haha! I was so sure you stuck to the rules like usual on this one!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Either way, I can definitely say that you boys earned this badge!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You boys did a great job!  Thank you for participating in the activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Congratulations! You two are the first to complete the badge-earning activity today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I hope you two had fun while doing it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I think everyone else should be finished with their activities by now! I’ll just go and check up on them!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden is already cooking dinner as well, so you boys are free to relax until then!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Excellent idea, Natsumi! I’m actually in a bit of a rush to conclude the activity because Aiden is expecting me to help him tonight.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I knew I could count on you, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now, if you don’t mind, I’ll take my leave now and make sure everyone’s back in time for dinner! See you boys later!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey, campers!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I hope you guys still have some spare energy left! ‘Cuz we’re gonna have a little activity tonight for a job well done these past two days!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, well I wanted to invite you boys for a little night swimming! The waves are calm and the sky is so starry and clear!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And I just thought it’d be nice to have a little late-night fun!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, it’ll be our little secret! Besides, it’s just the few of us~!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Natsumi, if you’re worried about safety, please don’t. I will personally keep my eye on all of you while you guys have fun!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And besides, Aiden and Yuri said they’d be stalling Sir Goro for the time being~

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This is going to be fun, so come on! I’ll wait for you boys outside!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good evening, Keitaro! Aren’t you gonna join us for the swim?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s exactly why I figured this was the perfect time for it. I made sure to check the tide schedule and the weather before inviting you all out.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course! Like I said a while ago, I really wanted to spend time with you boys!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know this might sound a little strange, but I am reminded a lot of my own experiences here from Camp Buddy by you and your friends.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I've felt something reignite in me as a scoutmaster ever since we had that talk before the sportsfest.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, I really want to make sure I thank you for that.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, that’s right! You’ve been one of the few people I can trust with these kinds of things.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And speaking of, I've actually noticed that you and Natsumi have gotten much closer recently as well.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s honestly really surprising to see him so relaxed and simply enjoying his time with everyone. He was never like that in any of the previous terms...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: For the longest time, Natsumi has only really been focused on doing his best as a scout and always working tirelessly to impress everyone here at camp.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sometimes it really concerns me why he tries so hard... but as his scoutmaster, I have to support that kind of high-achieving character not just because it's productive...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But also because it seems to be what makes his experience here in camp complete!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah! Don’t worry about it, Keitaro. I just blurt things out sometimes! You’re one of the few people I can talk about things like this with, after all.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Not only do you have a way with words, but you’re also a great listener too – Maybe one day you could become a scoutmaster like me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll gladly pass the Camp Buddy torch to you when the time comes!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I really do mean it, Keitaro! You’ve helped me sort out my frustrations before, and now you’re helping your fellow campers too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You truly are a model scout!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course, you do!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can't just let your efforts go unnoticed when you've done so much for both Natsumi and me.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Speaking of which, where is Natsumi right now, Keitaro? I'd thought he'd be with you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, maybe you can fetch him for me. I'm sure a good night's swim will help clear his head of all his troubles.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I'll see you two in the water, alright? I'll just go check on Hiro and Yoichi to make sure they're not playing too rough.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! There you are, you two!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I was getting worried you two might’ve wandered off!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, the weather has gotten a bit colder, so I decided to cut our night swimming short and let you all get back to your tents before anyone catches a cold!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, you two looked like you had a relaxing time over here, at least! That’s what matters!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thanks again for letting me spend time with you, boys!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I’m fine, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Understood, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, everything is in order, sir! I’ll supervise the scouts extra strictly today to make sure nothing unplanned happens.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-You have nothing to worry about, sir! I’ve been personally seeing to his improvements!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even yesterday, I made sure that he and Keitaro engaged in a team-building activity together, which they both succeeded in!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir! You can count on me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Anyway, I’m really thrilled that you decided to take the campers to that spot, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m glad to know that you believe the scouts have earned a trip like this!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: E-Eh? What do you mean, sir?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: T-Thank you, sir! It’s my duty! I’ll keep doing my best to not let you down!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Attention!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good morning, campers! Thank you all for getting up and ready so quickly!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re sorry we had to wake you up so early again, but we, your scoutmasters, have prepared yet another special activity today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know that all of you are thinking this was a vacation, but we assure you that this trip is part of it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right! Our trip has been extended by an extra day, and this time to a very special location!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In the past, many scouts of Camp Buddy have visited this place and explored it during their time here, and it holds a special place in all of their hearts, including my own!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The destination is deep in the forest, and once we’ve arrived there, we will camp for the night!  As soon as we’re finished with the disassembly of the tents, we’ll head out immediately!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guarantee that none of you will be disappointed, so get excited, campers! Pack your things, and Sir Aiden will be there to assist you if needed!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Dismissed!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, campers! We’ve arrived at our destination, the Buddy Falls!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This place has been a traditional camping spot for everyone at Camp Buddy since it was discovered, and we’re glad to be taking you all here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s said that many buddies who have spent time here end up forming bonds for life, and that they never forget the experiences they share here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And as promised, this is an extension of our vacation, so we’ll be camping out here overnight! You can all swim in the pond below, or just enjoy the scenery!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now, I believe Sir Goro would like to explain a few rules.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank you, sir! Once we’re unpacked and the tents are set up, we can all begin to have fun! Let’s do our best to get set up quickly, campers!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello, boys!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, I couldn't help but overhear you two talking—are you interested in hiking up the falls?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I was going to take Hunter up there with me. If you guys are interested, you can come along.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s settled then! I’ll take you both up there!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Taiga, you should come along too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you sure? You really can’t miss out on opportunities like this! You're the first ones in the new generation of campers to come here, so you don't want to miss this once-in-a-lifetime chance!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Who knows? Maybe you’ll get to experience the life-changing event and strengthen your bond with your friends~!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s such a shame though, it would be such a great addition to your photo collection!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Excellent! Come along then, scouts! We’ve got a little bit of a climb ahead of us!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And here we are! The top of the falls!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It definitely is! You can see far off into the distance!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As you can see, there’s the mountains far to the north of here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Next to it is the large flat greenery where we had our first camping trip this term!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There's even a river that snakes through it! Isn't that amazing?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, I knew you boys would love it! This view hasn’t changed a bit over the years!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As a matter of fact, something very special happened to me here a long time ago, when I was a scout just like you guys!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Looking at how beautiful it is, it makes you start to think that maybe that rumor about magical properties is true, huh?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah… I wish we had brought last year’s batch here too… Maybe things would’ve turned out differently…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Certainly, Hunter! Just make sure to stay within the railings!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! I just had the most wonderful idea!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro, may I borrow your camera for a second?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright! How about I take a picture of you two with the view in the background?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Our goal here is to make the greatest memory after all, right?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro! You don't mind letting Taiga keep one of your pictures, right? He can always have it as a reminder of this special moment!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Come on, isn’t that the hip thing nowadays? What do you call that? A selfie?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Since you two have been getting along so well, it’ll be a nice souvenir of this breathtaking view!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Taiga! That’s not how a scout should act! I’m just trying to help you open up to those around you more!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We both know you had a rough start this term, especially with Keitaro. It's about time we fixed that!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Can't you hear yourself right now? You've been so full of spite recently, Taiga! Maybe if you try and see what I’m doing for you, everything will be much better.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If you just give me a chance to help you move on from your past, we can make things work-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ngh!!!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I apologize, Keitaro, I-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Watch your mouth, Taiga! I'm only doing all these things for your sake!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You have no reason to be so hostile towards me when I've shown you nothing but patience and understanding!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Taiga, you know I did that to give you another chance to make things right! I'm doing everything I can to make sure that happens!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Your stubborn attitude has gone too far! If you're going to keep pushing me away, then I don't know what to do with you anymore!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I apologize about your camera, Keitaro. Aiden and I will make sure to retrieve it for you right away.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please don’t worry about him. I’ll handle him later…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hunter! I’m sorry to cut your work short, but we need to go back to the campsite for now…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now please follow me, you two.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah… And I was trying to be a good scoutmaster, taking extra care of him…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I thought it was my duty to help him recover after that whole incident…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I just don’t get it though, Aiden… Why is he being this stubborn? Doesn’t he realize that I was just trying to help?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Really...? I thought I was being appropriate.... If that won't work, then I don't know how else to deal with Taiga....

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Actually, I was hoping you could keep this between us...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Just trust me for now, Aiden... I'll make sure I deal with all of this properly.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I will, I promise. But for now, we need to retrieve Keitaro's camera before it gets dark…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, Aiden. It should be just below that sign.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry, I’ll set up the ropes over here and-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: TAIGA?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What on earth are you doing down there?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Taiga, we’re coming down! Stay where you are!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: ENOUGH! No back-talking! Aiden is coming to get you, and you WILL stay where you are!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What were you thinking, Taiga?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We made these rules for a reason!! Not only should you not be up here, but you went past the fence without anyone to watch you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You don’t even have any proper safety gear! You could have fallen and gotten injured, or even killed!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This is… Keitaro’s camera?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* You know you could’ve asked us to help you get it, if that’s what you were trying to do.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I still can’t believe you carelessly put yourself in danger, without regarding anyone else!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If Sir Goro were to find out about this, you’d be expelled right away, regardless of your intentions!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well? Do you have anything to say for yourself?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Taiga…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir? What’s going on here?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro… Why would you do this?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I never thought you, of all people, would do something this immature…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We let you bring your camera with you, trusting you would only use it for something meaningful.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have no choice but to confiscate it until this issue is resolved.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t want to hear any excuses right now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’d like all of you to go back to your respective tents and stand by until further notice... I’ll go and sort things out with Sir Goro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir! Don’t you think you’re being too rash with this decision—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re being too harsh, sir…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yoichi! Watch your language!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir Goro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Down, girl! Get away!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I SAID GET AWAY FROM HERE!!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Enough, Yoichi! Control your dog, NOW!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yes, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I… uh...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir! That animal is—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I will take full responsibility for what happened, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But please, let’s not leave without Yoichi…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let me at least try to go look for him. You don’t have to do anything. And I can bring Aiden to help me out.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But can I at least look for him, sir?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir! You can’t–

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t apologize, Yuri… You tried your best to convince your dad, after all…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I just can’t help but worry for Yoichi…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know he’s a very instinctive guy and he knows his way out there in the wild more than anyone else here…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But he’s not the kind of guy who will come back with his tail between his legs…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure that he hasn't come back on purpose… He must be scared of what Sir Goro might do to Yuki if he does…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s why I wanted to search for him myself, I was hoping to convince him to come back here and make him apologize to Sir Goro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Maybe if I could find him, we could settle this once and for all…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But then, if I decide to go out there… Sir Goro might really expel Yoichi.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There would be nowhere else for him to go… I can’t bear to think of what would happen to him…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I was the one who let Keitaro bring that camera, even though it was against the rules…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I allowed Yoichi to keep Yuki, even if she was a threat…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m such a failure, Yuri… Two of my precious campers are in trouble because of me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sorry, Yuri but… I think I may need some space and time to think more about this…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* I knew this was going to happen…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I should’ve gone looking for him when I had the chance…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thanks, Aiden… That will buy us some time.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh! Hello there, scouts! Have you secured your belongings?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmm? What is it? Is something wrong?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you all sure that he’s not just walking around the campsite? Where was the last place you saw him?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-What?! Oh no… W-We can’t afford to have another missing scout!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Could you guys check one more ti—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m really concerned about Keitaro and Yoichi! I know you forbade me from searching for them earlier…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But if we don’t hurry they could be stranded in the woods for the night!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m not sure those boys will be properly equipped to handle a night out there! So, will you allow me to start a search now?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can’t possibly be thinking of leaving them behind, sir! That’s outrageous!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know that Yoichi is quite capable of making his way back to Camp Buddy, but Keitaro isn’t familiar with the area!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even if they are able to regroup, I’m sure the first place they’ll head back to is the beach! What do you think they’ll do when they find out that we’re gone?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The hike is too far to make it from the beach back to camp in the dark. They could really get lost then!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We can’t just let two scouts go missing, especially after the incident last year!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t you think that two missing scouts will only add to the damaged reputation of the camp?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can’t take this anymore! You may refuse to see how serious this is, but didn’t you just hear what I said?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We have two missing scouts! Is that not clear enough for you?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whether or not you believe they’re delinquents doesn’t matter – their safety is much more important.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m going to search for them. I don’t need your approval to do what I know is right!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: D-Don’t lose hope, Aiden! I have faith that Keitaro and Hiro will use what they’ve learned and stay safe in this kind of situation—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! Sir Goro?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ve already searched the entire beach area. I am certain that they have not returned there after they ran off yesterday.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t fret. This field is the only passage that leads to Camp Buddy.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And assuming they’ve set up a camp… they couldn’t be anywhere else but the woods nearby the beach.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: When the sun comes up, they will continue making their way back to camp, and they can only end up either reaching this field or the beach.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now with more people searching, we’re definitely going to find them faster! Let’s split up!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m well aware of the situation, sir! My plan is to form three groups, with each group accompanied by a supervisor to avoid letting anyone else get lost.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The first group will stay here in the fields on the lookout in case Keitaro or Hiro come this way.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Very well then! The two of you will remain here and stay on the lookout.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Next we need a group to head to the beach.  We can’t ignore the possibility that the two of them will have tried to go back where they last saw us.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This will likely be the most difficult task, since the beach is a long hike from here.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s great, Yoichi! But I can’t let you go there alone. Aiden, would you—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: R-Right…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: U-Understood, sir! Aiden, you’ll be coming with me again then!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If we don't find them by sunrise, let's all meet back here in the fields.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, now that we all know what needs to be done, let’s split up and find them! Good luck everyone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah! I think so!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro, Hiro!! If you can hear us, stay where you are! We’re coming for you!!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! Here, Aiden! I think they fell down this hole!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro, Hiro! Are you two alright down there?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hold on, you two! We’re going to fetch you guys!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden, can you climb down?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course! Be careful down there, Aiden!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank goodness, we were able to find you two! Are you both alright?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t mention it, Keitaro. It’s our duty.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry about that, Hiro. What’s important is that the two of you are safe now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, if you two are both okay to walk, we should head back to camp! We can meet up with Sir Goro and the others on the way back!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now, now, Yoichi. Save it for later.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: These two must be exhausted! Come on, let’s get you both back to camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We need to attend to those injuries, get you something to eat, and get you two some proper rest!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Save your strength, Keitaro! We still have some more walking to do!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now all of you follow me this way!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden, Yuri, I’d like you to help me prepare their food and lodging! These two must really be exhausted.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You wanted to see me, sir?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Is... Is this an expulsion notice…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: B-But sir, y-you can’t do that!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Those two are good scouts! L-Let me at least talk to them first!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: C-Could you give them another chance? M-Maybe they were just scared—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I did try to be like you, sir! But did you already forget what happened?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All of the scouts stopped respecting me… because of the way YOU ordered me to act!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s what made most of them leave in the first place!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Just when I thought you finally had a change of heart when you joined the search for Hiro and Keitaro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve always looked up to you, sir. I had always thought that you were someone I should aspire to be like.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But when I look at you now… it’s you who’s changed for the worse, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hiro and Keitaro ran away because you frightened them! I’ve never seen those boys look so afraid during their stay here in this camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You told them they were being expelled! It’s only natural they wanted to get as far away from you as possible!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sorry, sir. But I can’t just sit idly by… I promised myself I’d bring back the Camp Buddy you built.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The Camp Buddy that I grew up with! The one I dreamed of working at!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s the whole reason I became a scoutmaster in the first place!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Respect is something you earn. Fear is something you force.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The scouts don’t respect you, sir. They’re terrified of you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I thought a buddy was always supposed to show a bright smile on his face…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can’t believe those words came from someone who now can’t do anything but frown at every little bad thing that happens!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What happened to you, sir…? Have you really given up on yourself?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You used to tell me that this place is what gave you happiness…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But why can’t I feel that at all from you anymore..?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I… I’ll go talk to them myself.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-How can I calm down when the scout who’s done the most for this camp is about to be expelled?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m going to talk to them myself and find out what really happened!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Alright…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey! You two! What are you two doing out this late at night? You should both be in bed.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That's weird. It's so unlike you to speak so nervously, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: My best scout better not be up to no good!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As your scoutmaster, I must do- *hic*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I must do my best to… *hic*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Uhh… What was I talking about…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh… I didn’t know you could talk… You’re so adorable.  *hic*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Has anybody seen my hat? Did you take my hat, Natsumi?! Is that why you’re looking so suspicious?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What?! I stole my own hat?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A burger?! Where?! I could use a burger right now!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aww~ Did Aiden cook for me again? He’s just the sweetest guy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All the other staff already quit this camp except for him, you know?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I sure hope he doesn’t leave me too! I’d be *hic*… so sad if he does.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And just between you and me, I’ve always liked how Aiden serves me his buns.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: HAHAHAA… HA!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, Yuri… And judging from what we heard… I take it things didn’t go so well…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Why was Hunter inside with you and Sir Goro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s true… And I think it’s all because of Keitaro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Those two are always looking out for each other… It’s no wonder Hunter would go as far as to stand up for his friend...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This is all my fault…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If I had only kept to Sir Goro's simple instruction, this issue wouldn’t have blown itself out of proportion.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It just frustrates me that the scout who’s done the most for this camp is about to be expelled… And I can’t do anything about it…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m going to try to talk to Sir Goro myself and make him decide otherwise!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, I can’t just sit around here when something this terrible is about to happen! I’m a scoutmaster, and even my scouts know better than to just wait for Sir Goro to change his mind!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro can have Keitaro packing his bags any moment… do we even have any time left to spare?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Alright…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey! You two! What are you two doing out this late at night? You should both be in bed.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That's weird. It's so unlike you to speak so nervously, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: My best scout better not be up to no good!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As your scoutmaster, I must do- *hic*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I must do my best to… *hic*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Uhh… What was I talking about…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh… I didn’t know you could talk… You’re so adorable.  *hic*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Has anybody seen my hat? Did you take my hat, Natsumi?! Is that why you’re looking so suspicious?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What?! I stole my own hat?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A burger?! Where?! I could use a burger right now!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aww~ Did Aiden cook for me again? He’s just the sweetest guy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All the other staff already quit this camp except for him, you know?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I sure hope he doesn’t leave me too! I’d be *hic*… so sad if he does.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And just between you and me, I’ve always liked how Aiden serves me his buns.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: HAHAHAA… HA!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir? What’s going on here?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro… Why would you do this?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I never thought you, of all people, would do something this immature…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We let you bring your camera with you, trusting you would only use it for something meaningful.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have no choice but to confiscate it until this issue is resolved.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t want to hear any excuses right now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’d like all of you to go back to your respective tents and stand by until further notice... I’ll go and sort things out with Sir Goro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah, sir what Natsumi meant was—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can explain, sir...! Last night’s swimming was completely under my supervision and—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: B-But sir… Everyone’s here, safe and sound! Isn’t that what matters? We were all just enjoying our time and—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This isn’t your fault, Natsumi…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please excuse me for a moment… We can talk about this later back at camp…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The rest of you, please pack your things and get ready to leave.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Understood…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* Just when I thought everything was going to be fine after the sportsfest.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro… I know you couldn’t have done such a thing… Especially not after hearing you reason out to Sir Goro like that.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This meeting is your chance to prove you aren't responsible for that photo.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You won’t be doing it alone. I’ll try to reason out with Sir Goro as much as I can, okay?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everyone! Please head back to your respective cabins, now!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir, the night swimming I initiated with the scouts was fully under control! I had no problems while supervising them at all!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I did it so the boys could really make the most of their time at the beach!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This is absurd, sir! Aren’t you being unreasonable?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aren’t you at least going to give Keitaro a chance to prove himself?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We haven’t even talked to the other campers to find out what really happened!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Damn it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* It’s just so frustrating how he isn't even taking the time to see things through properly!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can’t believe that, even after this whole mess, you still look up to him with such respect, Keitaro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And Keitaro has a point too... With Sir Goro's anger getting the best of him like this, none of us can really reason with him right now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, Yuri…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* I’m really sorry, Keitaro… I didn’t expect things to turn out like this…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I played a big part in all this myself because of the rules I didn't follow. We’re in this together, Keitaro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m just relieved that Natsumi didn’t catch as much fire for this as we did…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’ve had a rough day already. Please take as much time to rest as you need while things settle down.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That is an order, Keitaro. Please let me fulfill my responsibility as your scoutmaster and do what I can to try and resolve this matter.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good. Now, head to your cabin and rest.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There you are, Natsumi…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We're not having the best day today, huh?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess Keitaro was telling the truth when he told me you were keeping away from everyone else.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He was getting really worried about you, you know…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes. In fact, he wanted to talk and sort things out with you himself…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I figured things were still a little tense between you two after what happened today, so I came looking for you instead.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please don’t blame yourself, Natsumi. You were just trying to do the right thing by defending Keitaro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I hope you understand that Sir Goro felt disrespected by what happened, and had every right to be upset.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: On top of the photo, I crossed the line and broke the curfew by inviting you all to swim at night.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He planned the whole trip to show how much he appreciated Camp Buddy raising model scouts again... and I let him down...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I should’ve listened to you the night before. I could see you were troubled about the whole decision to swim at night from the moment I said it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I didn’t teach you boys to break the rules. And as your superior, I should’ve made a good example of myself.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Natsumi…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I think it's my fault that you're so confused...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: From the moment you joined camp, I knew just how much you looked up to me and dedicated yourself to proving you were the most outstanding scout here.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: When I noticed how much you enjoyed achievement back then, I made sure I always gave you chances to perform your very best.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And I think that's what made you see things in black or white…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: For the longest time, I taught and trained you to see things as they were without fully understanding what was under the surface…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I didn’t actually teach you that some rules are meant to be broken, especially if they’re for a better cause.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know it doesn’t apply to our situation right now. Despite my intentions, I still broke the rules, even though I shouldn’t have…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But it can help you with the way you think things through from now on.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You must understand that no one can truly be ‘right’ all the time. Everyone, even the people who are in charge, even your scoutmasters are bound to make mistakes.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: …And that’s why you should know when to truly stand up for the greater good.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Just like how you stood up to me last night and to Sir Goro this morning.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Though I must admit, it took me this long to realize how complacent I've become as a scoutmaster, to you especially.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I've become so confident in you following my footsteps that I never thought you needed my guidance.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And for me to go against the values I’ve taught you... it only makes sense why you're this bothered.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s why I’m not disappointed in you at all… I’m the one who let you down…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh… he tried to talk to you about this as well?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You know, Keitaro really is one of a kind.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Despite almost being expelled, he still tried to understand Sir Goro... and he also put you first because he was worried about you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Unfortunately, yes. That is his current decision.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He might have made that call out of anger, though... so there’s still a chance of talking him out of it once he’s calmed down.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No, Natsumi. I promised Keitaro I'd fulfill my duty as a scoutmaster, so I’ll be the one to try and negotiate with Sir Goro again.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: However, I can't guarantee anything...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s best that you scouts stay put for a while and let the fire burn out for now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This is beyond anything you boys should handle. So, please let us scoutmasters handle this issue amongst ourselves.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s probably best that you head back to your friends for now… I’m sure Keitaro must be worried about you, after all.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Just explain to them why you needed some time alone. They’ll understand.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now, if you’ll excuse me, I need to try and compose myself before I go try and convince Sir Goro again.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course, Natsumi. It’s my pleasure.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, sir… I’ve been thinking about what you said earlier… And I wanted to apologize for raising my voice.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You have every reason to be angry at how things have turned out to be.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I shouldn’t have disobeyed the rules and broken your trust in the first place.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I understand.

name: Yoshinori
