name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, certainly! I’d love to see an up-to-date version!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank you for being so willing to share, Keitaro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, it looks like Yoichi has run out of patience – you guys had better go ahead.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Have fun and good luck with your activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahh, there you guys are! How’s the information gathering coming along?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I think Keitaro here just wanted you to actively participate too, Yoichi.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m really touched by this, Yoi-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hahaha…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m not sure who has which nickname…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: U-Umm… I’m not sure I caught all of that correctly. Did you say something about an adult website?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah! Did you look through my life savings…?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, yes! This is perfect! Thank you so much for both of your hard work.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Judging by this report, you both gathered quite a bit of info! I’ll review it and make sure to include everything in our activity in the morning.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In the meantime, why don’t you two take the rest of the day off? I’ll take things from here for today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re both dismissed! I’ll see you both in the office tomorrow for the continuation of our activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re right, sir. With minimal funds, we’ll be struggling with our monthly bills and we may not be able to provide a variety of activities for our campers in the future.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden, it doesn’t work like that… Investing in a place like Camp Buddy means a lot of money.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: How about we focus instead on getting more recruits for the next summer while we look for probable investors?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure if we gather enough enrollees, the funds will allow us to run the camp for another year. We can keep it running like that until we find an investor.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have an idea, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: How about we overhaul the current camp setup?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We can improve our existing facilities and conceptualize new activities, and on top of that, we make a full-blown ad campaign to generate publicity for Camp Buddy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We don’t have to use up all our reserved funds! I was going to suggest that we have some sort of fundraising campaign!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We could get the community involved to help out the camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Wait, sir! You shouldn’t have to shoulder this burden alone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everyone needs to do their part too! After all, we're a family here, remember?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We just need to do our best and get everyone to work as a team.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We can go door to door! Our scouts can participate in these activities as well! Together, we’ll get people to support the camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right, Yuri! We can make some flyers like we used to do! If I remember correctly, most of our enrollees this year only joined the camp thanks to those old flyers!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s a great idea, sir! I can begin upgrading some of the camp’s facilities in the meantime!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can leave all the supervision work to me! You don’t have to worry about this at all, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahem. Attention, campers! We have an exciting activity for you today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This activity is especially for your fun and leisure, so I hope you all enjoy working with us today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Wait! Yoichi, y-you should help too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I don’t know if we should concern-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* You’re right…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, campers! Listen up. We've gathered you here today because we need your help!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Most of you aren't aware of it, and I didn't want to burden you with it... but...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I regret to inform you all that Camp Buddy is in a tight situation... But after discussing it with your scoutmasters and our camp president, we've come up with a solution!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We are all a big family here and every family should deal with their problems openly and together.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thus, we’ll be asking for all of your help to get the camp back on its feet!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ve decided to hold a fundraising activity and an advertisement campaign for all of you to participate in!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We'll all be doing this to promote the camp better and hopefully gather more recruits for next year!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ll need all of you to participate in a variety of activities, ranging from making flyers and brochures, baking cookies, and going door to door around the local community. What do you all say?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I am truly touched by all of your devotion to the camp, and your willingness to help us in our time of need!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’ve all grown to be such wonderful scouts, always smiling and working through difficult times!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You must all think of Camp Buddy as a second home just like I have!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Why, I remember when I was your ages-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh. Right!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As I was saying earlier, there are a few different activities we will be performing to get ready for our fundraiser!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll be in charge of getting the word out to the public – we will be going door to door to promote Camp Buddy, handing out flyers to promote our camp and gather potential enrollees for next year!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All of you are free to volunteer for any of the different programs you want to work with.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Also, if you come up with an idea of your own that could help, don’t hesitate to speak to us! We’d love to hear them!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, everyone please think about which activities you want to do, and come to the appropriate scoutmaster to get started!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Dismissed!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello, boys! Have you two decided what you’re going to be doing to help?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, before you go, can I have a word with Keitaro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Actually, this is unrelated to the activity today.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I just happened to be chatting with Yuri, and she mentioned that she gave you a journal, correct?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s great! I wish I would have thought about that when I was a scout!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I apologize if this is imposing on you, but do you mind if I could read your journal at some point?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’d love to see your thoughts on all of the camp’s activities so far, and maybe use them to make next year even better!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I was thinking it could be useful as some sort of feedback on my performance as a scoutmaster! I really want to grow more as a leader!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That's right! I’m sure it’ll be really helpful when planning for next year’s activities!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, certainly! I’d love to see an up-to-date version!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank you for being so willing to share, Keitaro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, I won’t keep you any longer! You should go catch up with Aiden and Hiro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That won’t do, Yoichi! You need to be more polite if you want people to help you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ll be talking to strangers, so you have to give them a good impression from the start!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Then that would be robbing, Yoichi. You can’t steal from people.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Come on. Let’s try again.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi really is doing his best though, Hiro! He just has to adjust his attitude slightly and he’ll be a great help!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, Yoichi! I want you to try saying this line: “Good morning, sir/ma’am! We’re from the adventure summer camp, Camp Buddy!”

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi! Mind your language! Profanity won’t do!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, let’s just move back to something easier… You can leave the talking to me… All you have to do is look presentable, so that grumpy face won’t do!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now, now, Yoichi! Remember Buddy Law number three?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* This is going to be a long day…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: By the way, what brings you two here? Aren’t you two supposed to be helping Aiden with the bake sale?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sounds great! I bet those will be a hit! You guys must be here to ask Yoichi then?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi is very fond of dogs! He even has a cute dog named Yuki!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now, now Yoichi! They just needed to know for their activity, so be nice!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Come on then. Let’s let them get back to work, and we’ll keep at our own activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We still have plenty to do! You might not be ready for public interactions yet!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah~! There you are, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, you didn’t tell me we’d be having visitors, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha! It looks like I know now where Natsumi got his resourceful and helpful sides from!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In any case, I assume this equipment you borrowed is all for the fundraising activity you asked me about yesterday, Natsumi?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, it's both, actually!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re having a campaign to advertise the camp in the hopes of gaining more recruits for the next summer terms!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We also want to raise some funds along the way to help us improve the camp overall!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, it’s a good thing we have all the scouts to help us make everything happen!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Though, I have to admit, we do need more helping hands around the camp.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ve actually considered taking in some volunteers but we’re not sure that’s possible since we require very well-rounded people who can handle all kinds of tasks.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, most definitely! In fact, you should know that Natsumi here is our best scout as well!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, this is great news! We could really use your help around here for the rest of the summer term, Mr. Naoto!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! You’re right about that, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let me report to him about this immediately! And I’ll see if he approves of Mr. Naoto’s offer to volunteer!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In the meantime, you two should head inside the camp while I hold a meeting with Sir Goro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, just call me Yoshi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now, if you don’t mind, Natsumi. Please assist your brother inside and show him around while I head to the office.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have spoken to Sir Goro about Naoto’s volunteer work here at Camp Buddy, and I’m pleased to announce that his stay here for the rest of the term has been approved!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He will be assisting us – both scouts and scoutmasters – with general tasks and the maintenance of the camp, just in time for the busy week of our campaign!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure we’ll be able to manage things even smoother and achieve greater results now that Naoto is here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, not an official scoutmaster, Natsumi. He’s just here as a volunteer, just like originally agreed upon!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, regular work should start for you tomorrow, Naoto! Although, I know you’ve helped out a lot of the other campers today.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank you again for showing interest and so much commitment to the camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know you’ve had a long day today travelling back to retrieve all your things. You can put them in your room now and get some rest for the night!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No problem! If you’ll excuse me, I’ll go and take my leave.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: About your uniform, do you still have it? Or do you need us to provide you another one?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Excellent. It’s a good thing you brought them.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, moving on to the actual activity-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahh! Taiga, Keitaro! Perfect timing!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Look who decided to visit us today! It’s one of the scouts from last year, Kieran!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Kieran here has volunteered to work with us for the fundraiser! Isn’t that great?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right! Every bit of help goes a long way!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s truly heartwarming to see a past camper come back and help the camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Also, if I remember correctly, you and Kieran are friends, right, Taiga?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This will be a great opportunity for you to reconnect with an old acquaintance while making memories with all of your new friends!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Either way, we’re excited to have you back here, Kieran! We look forward to spending a productive time with you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, Taiga and Keitaro, you two were on your way here to find an activity today, correct? I have the perfect one for you two that Kieran can join as well!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It involves a lot of labor, so I hope you boys don’t mind that. It should keep you all occupied for the rest of the fundraiser.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, I'll explain later, Keitaro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Why don’t you and Taiga help Kieran get moved into your cabin first while I prepare the activity?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure you all have a lot of catching up to do, haha!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And once you guys are finished unpacking, you can meet me at the campgrounds, and we’ll get started!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: See you boys later!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! There you guys are!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I was on my way to pick you up for our activity. Were you able to get Kieran settled in?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, great!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m actually glad an old friend of yours is back, Taiga!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I mean… I can’t blame him for not finishing the term after the whole mess last year.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If I remember correctly, you two enrolled at the same time too, so I feel bad that he was discouraged from returning this term.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But, nevertheless, I’m glad you’re reunited again! Things just keep getting better here, huh?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Looking sharp, Kieran! Good to see your uniform still fits well!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, since we’re all here, I’ll fill you guys in on what we’re doing today.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Remember those old cabins near the camp fence? They haven’t been touched for a while now and are in very bad shape.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ve kept them off limits since they’re all broken down, for safety reasons.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m planning on giving them a good overhaul so that they’ll be ready for next year’s new recruits!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: They all need a thorough cleaning, some wood repairs, and nice, new furnishing too.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: By the time you boys are done working with me, you’ll all be expert carpenters, haha!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know it’s a lot of work… but I don’t think I will be able to pull it off by myself, on top of going door to door with Yoichi…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Taiga’s always been great at crafts, so I thought this kind of activity would be right up you guys' alley! What do you think?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Excellent! I love the enthusiasm! Now come along, boys! There’s a lot of work in store for us, so the sooner we get started, the better!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, I warned you boys that it was in rough shape!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, as you all know, the camp has been declining in membership for years now, and with less campers, we’ve needed less cabins.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As we’ve closed off the cabins, some of the more delinquent scouts from last year have taken to use them as ‘hideouts.’

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Which explains all of this uhh… destruction and vandalism…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s the spirit, Kieran! I’m glad you’re looking at this so positively!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You three will make a great team!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, before we can properly assess the damage to the structure, this place is going to need a thorough cleaning.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We should start by getting rid of all the debris and cobwebs. As soon as that’s done, we can examine which parts need repairs.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I prepared some cleaning materials for us here that we can use. It should be enough to—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, sir! Do you need anything from me?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-WHAT!?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* It must be Yoichi… I left him in charge of putting up posters today…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I really apologize about that, sir. I’ll go see Yoichi right away.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I told him to stay close by to the camp… I didn’t think he’d find anywhere risky to stick those posters…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If you boys don’t mind, I’ll leave you here to complete this task while I handle him.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank you! I’m counting on you all to get this done today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll try to come back as soon as I can, but if you run into any problems, please let Yuri or Sir Goro know – they should both be here today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, I’ll take my leave then! Good luck boys!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whew… I made it back before you guys left!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, I might as well have…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I went all around town looking for Yoichi and ended up cleaning up his mess along the way…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I had to apologize to two property owners, got hit with a cane by a very angry old lady, and I even begged local police to forgive Yoichi for all the unintentional vandalism…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* It was very irresponsible of me, I know… but I honestly thought he understood all of my instructions.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He was perfectly well behaved yesterday when we were doing the simulations.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I might end up giving him a different task at this rate.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway… it looks like you guys made significant progress with the cabin! I’m proud of you all for handling it without supervision.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I do apologize for not being able to join the cleaning… Yoichi’s circumstances really caught me off guard.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I promise I’ll make it up to you guys tomorrow.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank you. Now, why don’t you all call it a day? I’ll take it from here and put away the equipment.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, you three deserve it! Let’s meet up again tomorrow, then?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah~! Good morning, you two! I was actually about to come get you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro is here to assess our progress from yesterday! I also just finished showing him our projected itinerary for our activity around town!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, I wouldn’t have been able to make the itinerary if it wasn’t for Yoichi and Keitaro’s hard work yesterday!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Actually, since we now have a scheme to follow, I think we’re ready to go out into town today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: R-Right now?! E-Err…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Alright…! Here goes… Umm…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ehem…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah…! I apologize! There’s so much to say that I’m not sure where to start…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-You’re right, sir…! I’m sorry again!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Understood! We’ll work on that right away!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh and that reminds me as well! Have you updated your journal yet, Keitaro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir! I actually asked Keitaro if I could borrow it yesterday. I thought it might be a good reference in assessing my progress as a scoutmaster.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi! You shouldn’t raise your voice at Sir Goro like that! We don’t want to anger him again!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: R-Really…?! T-This is the first time I’ve ever heard you excited about an activity! You even apologized too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, like Sir Goro said, we need to practice our improvisation skills! I was totally caught off guard by his request earlier after all!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: M-Maybe we can start with some simple interactions – we need to have a good impression on our patrons! What do you guys think?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I like your determination! Alright! Show me what you’ve got!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Pretend I’m an old lady—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s fine~ I’m used to it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As I was saying, pretend I’m an old lady and try to convince me to donate to Camp Buddy.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course not! Come on, Yoichi! Let’s take this seriously! I thought you were excited for this activity?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, the best way to practice is to make it as realistic as possible!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s simulate a scenario!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You have to pretend-knock first, for me to come get the door!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Just do it, Yoichi! Come on. I’m already in character!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: “Yesh…? What can I do for you, lad…?”

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can do it, Yoichi! Just act casually and be yourself.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-What…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That won’t do, Yoichi! You need to be more polite if you want people to help you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Then that would be robbing, Yoichi. You can’t steal from people.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Be kind and approachable! Remember, you’re trying to give them a good first impression!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s try again. Take two.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: “Yesh…? What can I do for you, lad…?”

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi! Mind your language! Profanity won’t do!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* This is harder than I thought.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I agree! Why don’t you give it a try, Keitaro? Yoichi could probably learn a thing or two from you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s start at the beginning! Take three!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: “Yesh…? What can I do for you, young lad…?”

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmm… Sir Goro is right… I think we’re going to need a lot of practice…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess asking for a donation is too imposing to start with… How about we try simulating a cookie-sale scenario instead?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let me get a sample box from Aiden first. Wait right here for me, alright?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, I got us some cookie boxes! We can use these as props for the cookie-selling improv!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This will be a lot of work, boys, but if we manage to get it right, we’ll be able to go out into the town tomorrow!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good work today, boys! I’m positive that we’re ready for tomorrow thanks to all of these simulations!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll try to work on some of the points that need improvements!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In the meantime, you guys can relax for the rest of the day again! Go get some dinner. I’m sure you two are starving!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, hello boys!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah, I took the truck into town and bought some early this morning!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I figured to make it up to you guys yesterday, I would get a head start on our activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry about him! Sir Goro offered to tag along to make sure there’s not a repeat of what happened yesterday.  I’ll be focusing on you boys now!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good to hear that you boys are eager! We actually still have a few more things to clean up before repairs.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure you all noticed the vandalisms on the wall, so we’re going to work on removing all of them!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s very observant of you, Taiga! Yes, they are!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: They’re not quite ready for us yet, though – I still need to cut them into their proper sizes.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, I tried cleaning the walls with water and soap a while ago, but that didn’t work.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We might have to use a stronger cleaning agent for them.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Natsumi cleaned up some graffiti on the fence last year, so he might have an idea of how to remove them!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I want to ask you guys to get the cleaning solution from him, while I work on the wood.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In addition, Aiden dug up the old bed-frame plans for me from the camp records, but I wasn’t able to grab them from him this morning.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If you boys could get those two items, it would be a great help!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmm… Good idea, Taiga! That will help me finish faster.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Great! See you boys later!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi, I already told you…. we’re measuring and cutting the wood…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, have you boys retrieved the supplies?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Great! Way to think a step ahead, you two!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: While you boys were gone, Taiga and I have been measuring and cutting these boards as well.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We finished right before you both arrived! Taiga is quite talented at this!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Indeed, he is! He really made my work faster!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That being said, I think we’re about ready to start the next steps!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re going to start removing the graffiti, repairing holes, and fixing the ceiling!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi… I had to get rid of some of the good wood because of that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If you really want to help, then wipe the walls with us.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Wait, Yoichi…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* I thought he wanted to help…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s true, haha!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, I was thinking of changing our plans a little.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Originally, we were going to clean up the walls first, but by the time we’re through, it’ll be too dark to work on the exterior repairs.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’ll be better if we go up and fix the holes on the roof while it’s still daytime.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ll patch up any of the missing shingles before moving back inside!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright!  Follow me, boys!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, the ladder is all set up! I’ll go ahead and bring the tools and materials to the roof!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You boys follow me, but be careful and don’t slip!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, yeah! I remember back when we were scouts, we’d secretly climb up our cabin roof and watch the sunset to relax.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We had to be careful though, if Sir Goro found out, we would get in trouble!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well… I wasn’t exactly a model scout back then. Let’s just say I’ve learned a lot over the years!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, there you boys are! Did you have any trouble climbing?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh no, this was actually caused by a tree falling onto the roof.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And don’t worry, boys, it’s not as bad as it seems! We just have to remove the damaged pieces and lay down the new planks!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Once we’re done with that, we’ll get started on the shingles! You boys ready to work?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Great work, everyone! We managed to get this task done just before sundown.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess we can take care of the broken windows tomorrow along with building the beds.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll try to cut up some wood based on the blueprints before then.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If you boys still have energy, we can still work on the interior.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s the spirit! You boys ready to go down then?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whew, it’s a good thing I installed the light here earlier.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s still probably too dark to work on any major repairs, but we can clean up the walls!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* I’ve been wanting to remove it for a while now, but I’ve never had the time.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You both are correct though, we don’t want any new scouts to see, so let’s get rid of it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good, I will take care of the ones inside the bathroom and leave you three here to work together.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Make sure you remove every trace of them! Also, don't forget to wear your masks!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Excellent! I’m counting on you three!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey there! I just finished cleaning up the bathroom!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whoa! The walls are so spick and span! Great job, everyone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You boys have worked so hard today, so why don’t we call it an evening? You all must be hungry!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I also told Aiden to give you guys ice cream for dessert, as a little reward for all the hard work today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: See you all tomorrow then! Enjoy your meal and get a good night’s rest!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Very good, Yoichi! But next time add a bit more enthusiasm to it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We just need to gather our supplies, and we’ll be on our way, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir! Thank you very much!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You heard that, Keitaro and Yoichi! I’ll need your help again today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Nothing too tedious! I just need you two to get the cookies and pamphlets from Aiden and Yuri then load those into a wagon!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Actually, Yoichi, I passed by her this morning. Weren’t you the one who left her those treats?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… the treats are still there… She must not have eaten them…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I understand what Keitaro is trying to say, Yoichi. Perhaps it’s best if we get someone to check on her just to make sure she’s really alright.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden has some healthcare experience… Maybe he knows a little about animals as well.  What do you think?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Understood, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right! Let me go and fetch Aiden!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So? Is there something wrong with Yuki?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You think we should take her to the vet, Aiden?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No need for that, Yoichi. You can leave Yuki to us!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Besides, we’re supposed to go out later today, right? You two can proceed with the tasks I’ve assigned while Aiden and I get Yuki checked up!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And you can count on us to make sure she won’t be hurt at all too! There’s totally nothing you should worry about!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And you can count on us to make sure she won’t be hurt at all too! There’s totally nothing you should worry about!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s correct!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ready to go now, Aiden?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good! Now, you boys try to have fun with your assignments, alright? We’ll take good care of Yuki!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You ready to go, Aiden?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Great! It’s gonna be a long drive to the city.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, I have Keitaro to thank for that. He’s taught Yoichi how to think and listen before he acts!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… it was only speculation, wasn’t it? I just thought that it would be better to break the news to him when we’re a hundred percent certain.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m worried about what you said a while ago, though… about her symptoms being exactly the opposite of what you expected…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I see… Then it must mean that something else is going on with her…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re right. Let’s go!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re sorry it took us long... The traffic was so crazy in the capital that I had to take a lot of detours…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And it looks like we didn’t make it in time for our scheduled door-to-door excursion today either.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She’s right here, Yoichi~!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, the doctor gave us tons of information about Yuki. I couldn’t even follow some of it… It’s a good thing Aiden was there!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But there’s one main point to all of this – to make a long story short…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuki here is pregnant.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right! I was surprised too, Yoichi! But with her being in the woods all day, she must have found a friend, haha.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, that’s a factor.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Adding to that, the recent events back at the beach must’ve been causing her mood swings.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s not to mention how she’s not been seeing Yoichi regularly for nearly a year now…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Actually, I just finished talking to Sir Goro about that a little while ago before we caught up with you two!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re gonna be thrilled with this, Yoichi, because…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He’s agreed to let Yuki stay inside Camp Buddy again!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, it was tough, but I was able to convince him!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The one stipulation is that we have to keep an eye on Yuki while she’s at camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I will do my best to look after her, but I’ll need you two’s help to make sure she stays safe as well.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’ll need to make sure she is well taken care of and has everything she needs. She also needs company from everyone, especially you, Yoichi.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m really happy to hear those words from you, Yoichi! Thank you very much as well for trusting me again.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yoichi… that’s the first time you’ve ever hugged me! I-I don’t know what to say…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, that’s right! Get plenty of rest tonight boys, we have a lot of work to do to catch up on our activity tomorrow!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, and before I forget – we’ve moved Yuki's doghouse near the shed! Just tie her up there for tonight once you’re done playing with her for today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And, Yoichi… I know I don’t need to say this, but please take good care of Yuki!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: See you both tomorrow!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wow! It smells like a bakery in here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are the cookies ready?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, I see! You boys are working really hard!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wow, these look fantastic! You’ve made so many different shapes!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Mmm! They come in different flavors too! I expected no less from our chef!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, Aiden! Yoichi and I will be going to town today to spread the news about the camp.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I stopped by to see if we could get some snacks for the road!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yoichi! We’ve been over this. We’re not robbing people!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re going to give them some information about the camp, an open invitation and a small envelope they can use to donate to us!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You already know why we’re doing this as well!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, thank you, Aiden! You’re the best!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Come on, Yoichi! We have what we need, so let’s get going!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, what is it Hiro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, that’s a great idea, Hiro! You’re really using your noodle for this fundraiser!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But what will you all do while we’re gone? Weren’t you going to sell cookies too?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ll be happy to help you sell, Aiden! How much should we charge per box?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That sounds reasonable to me! Now come on, Yoichi, let’s carry these boxes!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ve got some sales to make!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good morning, scouts!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, yes! Like I said yesterday, I went ahead and prepared the planks we needed!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Since we’re almost done here, I figured we might have time to work on the beddings, so I made sure there’s enough wood for that!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes! Aiden helped me cut all these this morning.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, these are the materials we’ll need to assemble the beds! All we have to do is set them all up.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah… The weather report said it’ll be scorching today, so I hope you guys are prepared.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: E-Ehem… Anyway, thanks for the help, Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes! Most of the pieces are already cut into their proper sizes!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The overall frame is ready to be assembled and just needs to be nailed together.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I actually designed these beds myself! Here, I made each of you a copy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro had the scouts engaged in woodworking back in my day, so I’m happy I put that into practice!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha! Anyway, since there are four bunk beds per cabin, we can split the work evenly.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll start with the first bed, and you boys can work as a team on the next one!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Think you guys can handle it?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Excellent! Just let me know if you have any questions! I’ll be right over here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What’s going on? Everything alright?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, I see. Great work being prepared, you two! And Kieran, make sure you’re extra cautious around these tools.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Will you be able to continue work?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, this is truly a great example of the Buddy Law!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Always being ready for anything, helping a buddy in need, and showing a bright smile on your face!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, anyways, since everything’s alright, let’s all get back to work!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It was a lot of work, but it’s worth it! Good job, everyone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, yes… It’s not like anyone else from the camp will barge in here-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: O-Oh… Hello, Yuri.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yuri! That’s enough…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: GAH! O-Okay, you’re done here, Yuri…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ll take the food and you can leave.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank you for the food, Yuri.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* You just can’t calm her down when she acts like that.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I apologize about that. You all know how she can be when she sees male skin.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… she was already wild since I met her so… yes.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In fact, she is pretty mild right now… compared to the past where she would uhh…. what was the term…? ‘Ship’ any pair of males that she saw.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But as troublesome as she can get, there’s nobody else who can make me laugh out loud like she can.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess without her, my life would be a little less colorful.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now that I think about it… Yuri has given me a lot of advice in the past.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even though she acts crazy sometimes, she knows when things get serious and handles them like a real, responsible scoutmaster.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Anyway, why don’t we eat the meal she brought us? Looks like Aiden really went all out making it, after all!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yep! I made sure to tell Aiden to make you boys’ favorites, since I knew we were going to finish this cabin by the end of today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I honestly thought it would take us all week, but I guess with how productive we’ve been the past couple of days, we’re going at a fast pace!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Indeed! The others nearby will need just as many renovations as this one!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Once we have all three of these completed, we’ll be able to house more campers than ever!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s the spirit, boys! For now, let’s enjoy our meal and get a full rest tonight!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s going to be a busy week!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, now we move on to “How to Properly Care for a Maternal Dog”.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Bullet number one! When a dog is pregnant, it requires maximum attention and care!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Furthermore, dogs tend to eat more when they are pregnant due to their offspring sharing the nutrients that their mother—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-What? H-How did that happen..?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway! It seems like everyone has been well informed of the precautions and how to care for Yuki over here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hahaha! Well, I think it’s time for us to resume our fundraiser activities! We’re supposed to go out into the town today after all!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Did you guys gather everything like I asked yesterday?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s great! Let’s retrieve it and head outside then!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahh~!  It’s so nice to see Yoichi being so gallant and responsible!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, by helping Keitaro with this activity, you’re helping the camp too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, I drafted us a route we can follow for our first day excursion~! We should be able to cover most of the nearby houses in one run this way!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you ready, scouts?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry, Keitaro! We can just politely excuse ourselves from anyone who’s rude anyway.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m just placing these posters! We want to make sure they’re visible for anyone passing by!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Make sure not to post them on private property though! That would be vandalism!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh~  I think I see our first house over there!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry. I’ll take this first one! You guys stand back and see how an expert does it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *ehem*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-Hello! We’re an organization called Camp Bu—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: L-Like I said, there will be houses like this where someone is cranky… We can’t do anything about them but move on!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, I’m pretty sure she made up her mind. She doesn’t want anything that we’re offering.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But when she heard the word 'organization', she slammed the door on me… I’m not sure she’ll listen to us…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yoichi… I didn’t… know you could act like that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: B-But wouldn’t we be deceiving those people using… erm… cuteness?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well... If you put it that way…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can’t help but remember that old lady’s face when you were doing that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She swooned at Yoichi’s puppy act… I would’ve given in if I was in her shoes too…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: N-Now, now. We should only use that kind of act if we encounter a customer like that again.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-We don’t want the camp to have that kind of brand associated with it, Yoichi…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I see our next target now. Are you ready, Keitaro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right! Just say the lines we’ve practiced before and you’ll be fine!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whoa… I-Is that real…?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Indeed… I’m quite impressed, Keitaro. You’ve outdone yourself this time.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We already reached beyond our quota for the fundraising! All that’s left is to sell these cookies and inform some more people about the camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s stop here for a second – I need to put some posters up!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You guys can take a short break.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you boys interested in buying some of our cookies? They’re homemade and filled with lots of love!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We actually have some free samples here! Why don’t you try them?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And, if you’re interested in joining, Camp Buddy is always taking in new scouts! We’ll gladly welcome you all as a part of our family anytime!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We won’t deny that our camp has gone through some tough times… The media blew an incident way out of proportion, and really damaged our camp’s reputation…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But the true Camp Buddy is full of fun and adventure, unlike what they say in the news. We’ll definitely prove that to you if you join!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I actually have some pre-registration forms with me you can fill up to reserve yourselves a spot for the next batch!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re welcome! I’ll look forward to seeing you all soon~

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha! I have my secret weapon too, you see!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, we still have a long day ahead! Let’s go sell the remaining cookies and try to get more people to pre-register for next summer!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, scouts! It’s good to hear that you’re fired up, because we’re just getting started~

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s gonna be a long week!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know, Aiden. By the looks of things, the entire staff was outside yesterday, leaving the camp almost completely unattended.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes. And that essentially means expanding the camp and more staff. I’ll try to relay that to Sir Goro later today.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, I’m sure he does. Now, if anyone needs me, I’ll be helping Yoichi practice for our door-to-door activity outside.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, hello, Natsumi. We were just discussing some potential work opportunities for next year’s term!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t think that’s needed, sir! We can definitely count on Natsumi here to guide his group safely.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll have to take my leave as well, you two. Yoichi’s already waiting for me for our door-to-door activities.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ll talk some other time, Naoto! And let me know if there’s anything I can help you with, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Attention!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re about to embark on our exciting outdoor adventure!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But to add a little challenge to this activity, we'll be separating all of you into groups of five!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I will be putting our best scout, Natsumi, in charge of our newest members!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuri and I will watch over each of your performances closely, in order to test your understanding of the second buddy law!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Natsumi! Is your team ready?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We hope that all of you did some extra research on the basics of survival in the wild as well.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Before we reach our destination, we will be passing through the forest first. So, to avoid getting lost, always stick together scouts!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Make sure to use this opportunity to improve your coordination as a team!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That will be all for your briefing!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let's move on, shall we?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Scouts! Follow me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! There you are!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s a good thing that everyone’s here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The rest of the scouts are already at the prairie.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Apparently, your team was the last one to arrive.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I am seriously surprised that, among all the scouts, Natsumi’s team is the last to arrive!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Responsible answer, Natsumi.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As penalty for being last, I will ask an important survival question!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro, you were separated longest from your group!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Would you mind answering this question: “What’s the first thing you should do in the occasion you get lost in the woods?”

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well said!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A compass is an item of critical importance when in areas without significant landmarks.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can point your compass in the direction of the city or wherever you're embarking from, and remember the direction the compass's pointer points in.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All you have to do is turn around until the compass points in the correct direction, and then follow your way back.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well said!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: First things first! Find a source of food and water in order to stay hydrated and full of energy when you look for a way back!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In most given survival situations, you can last up to three days without water..

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But, by the end of the second day, you're not going to be in very good shape.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Find water before then.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well said!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Being lost in the woods is a terrible thing!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: One might tend to panic and wander around in circles!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Not only will you not be going anywhere, but you’ll also be wasting precious energy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Engraving symbols on the trees that you pass by is a great way to mark your tracks!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well said!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It is always a wise decision to stay where you are!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As soon as you realize you may be lost, stop, stay calm and stay put.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The further you walk, the longer it will take for rescuers to find you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If you don't know where you are, walking any further has at least a 75 percent chance of heading in the wrong direction.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Either way, I’m impressed with your answer, Keitaro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good job! Your group may now proceed to the prairie!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright! Is everybody here?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I will give you all ten minutes to rest before we start setting up our tents!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don't wander off too far!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Dismissed!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Attention!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We all need to start setting up our tents before the sun sets completely!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I need someone who can take care of the campfire while we set up the tents.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Any volunteers?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good! I knew I could count on you, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I'll leave you in charge, okay?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright! Is everybody here?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We know all of you are hungry from today's activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, who's up for roasted marshmallows?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes! Just like always!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whoa!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Looks like we’re gonna have an improved version of a campfire treat for tonight, thanks to Hiro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In any case, this was very resourceful of you, Hiro! Good job!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everyone, please enjoy the dinner!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro! Aren’t you tired yet?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, I see.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuri told me about what happened earlier with you and Taiga. I apologize on his behalf.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I hope you don’t get upset over the things Taiga has said to you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That's the spirit!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m amazed by how positive you can be!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You're really something else, Keitaro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, you should head over to your tent and sleep as well. It’s getting pretty late.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah... Youth.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh. Who could be calling at this time of the night?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes... I see...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello, everyone! The day isn’t over quite yet!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuri wants you all to gather at the mess hall. She has prepared a special little surprise for everyone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Great! Don’t make her wait too long!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’ll be fun, sir! Aiden and I are already dressed too.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Howdy, partner! You guys enjoying the party?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yoichi! Aiden told me which movie that nickname was from by the way!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: P-Please stop calling me that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s great to see you boys enjoying this party! We originally planned just a normal feast, but Yuri was so insistent on it being a costume party.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She really went all out, getting these costumes for us! It’s really fun seeing everyone dressed up like this~

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Huh? What do you mean, Aiden? I’m always having fun!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aww, have I really been so stressed? I guess I’ve just been so worried about the camp…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Right! You’ve all done so wonderfully that you’ve more than earned this celebration!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thanks to the posters, the door-to-door and online advertising, we have received a large number of inquiries and pre-registrations on the camp's website!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In fact, we are expecting to recruit more than a hundred scouts for next year’s summer!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And since the cookies were such a hit, Aiden has decided to keep business running for the time being!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But now, I’d like to let our camp president, Sir Goro, say a few words.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello, everyone! The day isn’t over quite yet!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuri wants you all to gather at the mess hall. She has prepared a special little surprise for everyone here in Camp Buddy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Great! Don’t make her wait too long!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’ll be fun, sir! Aiden and I are already dressed too.

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t misunderstand, Natsumi. I’m very impressed by your dedication as usual.

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Your availability is not even an issue either. I’m pretty sure I don't have to worry too much about the small details.

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This exact thing  was missing from the staff who left us after last year’s incident and when the other branches of our camp closed down.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But it is also the reason that the camp is back on its feet now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s something that even I cannot put into words. I believe it’s for you to figure out and learn on your own, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Time really flew by, didn’t it? I can’t believe we’re almost at the end of this year’s term!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What’s the matter, Kieran? You seem troubled.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What for?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please don’t worry about that, Kieran! No matter what your reasons were, you still helped us out in our time of need!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve seen just how much effort and care you put into our cause here, so I’d be happy to help with your concerns!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’ve always been a part of Camp Buddy, and as your scoutmaster and a friend, I want you to know that I’m here to listen.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmm… That does seem complicated… I know how it feels to be in that position…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes… I’m sure you remember the whole incident last year, when the camp was in such a terrible state.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ever since then, Camp Buddy has been at risk of closing forever, and I’ve never felt so lost before.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As someone who grew up with this place and worked hard to keep it alive, I thought I was going to lose my purpose.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I was at a crossroad just like you… I had to decide between accepting that Camp Buddy was over, or trying to save it, knowing that there was a chance I would just fail again.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I will admit, I considered giving up since I was afraid that if I fought so hard, I might end up disappointing everyone at camp, or worse, putting them through something they don’t deserve.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: After losing so much, I didn’t want to make things worse than they already were.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I didn’t, Kieran. I took a chance, not knowing what’s ahead of me and trusting that things will turn out for the better.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: After all, it wasn’t fair to myself or to everyone that counted on me to expect that it would fail…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That would mean I had given up hope.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… it really depends on your situation, but the most important thing is to follow your heart.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Think about it this way, Kieran…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t you believe there’s much more to lose by not taking a risk at all?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: By doing nothing, you’ll only be left wondering about what could’ve been.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… I think it’s good to understand that in life, there will always be decisions to make that could lead to either failure or success.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Just like here at Camp Buddy... Almost everyone thought that we were done for after such a hard fall.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yet here we are, slowly getting back on our feet! We just have to learn from our mistakes.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: …It also reminds me of your good friend Taiga. We both know how hard he worked to redeem himself from all the trouble he caused back then.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Although, he's had a tough time this year as well... He had issues with plenty of the campers, even with me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A huge reason for all these misunderstandings was a lack of communication and patience with each other.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But look at him now, and he’s more mature than he ever was. He has finally let go of his anger and, most importantly, learned from his past mistakes…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: …A-Are you alright, Kieran?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-Huh?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Wait… You mean the camper that showed up and said he was beat up by Taiga-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So he was just trying to defend himself… And everyone else was just made to believe it was his fault…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everything makes sense now…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That must be why you left camp early… You must’ve been so afraid…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Kieran… As unfortunate as this truth is… it’s already in the past.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But it’s never too late to make things right…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can only give you advice, Kieran, and it’s up to you how you take it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In the end, it’s still your choice to make.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s unfortunate to see you go, Kieran, but I respect your decision.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everyone here at camp truly appreciates all the help you’ve given us for the fundraiser. It’s been a pleasure working with you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We hope you enjoyed your time here as well.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And if you happen to change your mind, remember Camp Buddy always welcomes you with open arms!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you sure you don’t want me to call everyone to see you off?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I understand.

dialog: I’ll take your things and get the car ready. Let me at least give you a ride home, alright?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, alright. Well, I’m here to give Yuki her daily vitamins as well.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: For taking care of Yoichi.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know I struggle to understand him sometimes, but for you, it just seems to come so naturally.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: For the longest time, Yoichi felt abandoned and only ever seemed to trust Yuki.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But then you came along and softened his heart! That’s something I’d always hoped to achieve!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You have truly done an amazing thing with him, Keitaro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’d say he already sees you as a part of his family now too, Keitaro. You and Yuki are both extremely special to him.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As a child, Yoichi was quite the rascal, even more mischievous than he is today, if you can believe.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I found him in the streets one day, all grimy and begging for food…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Little did I know that he was trying to distract me, and Yuki was sneaking up behind me to snag my wallet!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I managed to catch the two of them in the act, but instead of ratting him out, I decided to invite him to come stay at Camp Buddy.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Seeing how helpless Yoichi was then… I knew I couldn’t turn my back on him. Especially knowing that I could really help him.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi kept rejecting my offer until I convinced him that not only could he get in serious trouble, he was also putting his dog in danger living the way that he did.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In his eyes, I saw just how much he loved his dog, and I believe that was the main reason he agreed. Ever since then, he’s been here in camp with Yuki and me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s no problem, Keitaro. I’m sure there are still a lot of things about Yoichi you are curious about.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I can see how much you respect his privacy by not forcing him to tell you about his past all at once.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… if I was in your shoes, I would be really curious too.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But here’s what I can tell you – Yoichi trusts you enough to have opened up and told you what you know so far.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And knowing he sees you as such an important person in his life, I believe you will know everything there is to know about him soon enough.

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know I’ve told you this several times already, but thank you for everything you’ve done for Yoichi!

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

dialog: How about this? I can let Yuki tag along with us inside the office too! Would you like that, Yoichi?

dialog: Alright! It’s decided then! Let’s head to the office!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We also have a large number of emails, too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha! Well, I wouldn’t mind hiring someone else – especially if they’re as reliable as Aiden!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! Come in!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course it was, Hunter! Those posters your group made really had people curious and excited!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And I think Natsumi’s tour video was on the ‘Trending List’ in social media! I think that drew in a lot of attention too.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Actually, some of the letters are asking if we plan on continuing cookies sales every year!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess all of your hard work with those sweet treats really drew people in, Hiro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Absolutely! I’m really considering hiring new scoutmasters for next semester too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: On the contrary, Hiro, Yoichi here has actually helped us check some letters already! He eventually lost interest after an hour though, haha!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sure thing, boys! We could use a few more helping hands anyway!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I knew I could count on my best campers!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Great work today, everyone! Thanks to all of you, we managed to finish checking all these pre-registration forms! It looks like we’ll have quite the full summer semester next season!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As a little reward for all your help today, why don’t we head over to the mess hall? I’ll have Aiden scoop us all some ice cream!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, everyone. Let’s go!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good morning, boys! Are you both ready to go?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s no problem, Hiro! I’m just doing my job as your scoutmaster, after all!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s get going – it’s gonna be a long ride!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We made it, you two! We’re at the hospital!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes! I actually already went inside and talked to the receptionist.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It looks like Hiro’s mother is on the 3rd floor in room 69. The nurses will take you both up there when you get inside!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, no, I don’t want to get in the way of your visit! Besides, Yuri had a few errands she wanted me to run while I was getting the documents I needed.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Apparently, there are a few new books she wants me to pick up for her… they’re under the “Hardcore Yaoi” category in the stores…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m not sure what that means, so I’ll just have to go and ask around till I find what she was looking for!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Right! I almost forgot – here, I went ahead and grabbed Hiro’s cell phone from the office for the day.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You boys can give me a call once you’re done, or if something happens and you need me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good evening, Mrs. Akiba.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, it’s my pleasure! But I would like to give my deepest gratitude to your son as well!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He and Keitaro have contributed a lot to the camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: O-Oh, Mrs. Akiba? Are you alright?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please don’t force yourself, ma’am! Your health is our utmost priority!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: How about we let Mrs. Akiba take her rest now? You two must’ve drained her with all your stories!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And it’s almost sundown too… We’ll be on the road until evening at this rate.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright then! We will be taking our leave now, Mrs. Akiba!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: On behalf of the scoutmasters and the scouts of Camp Buddy, I express our sincere wishes for your speedy recovery!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright. Let’s get moving, boys!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello! And good morning, everyone! Thank you so much for taking the time to assemble this morning.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And all on time too! You guys have really grown since your first days here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It makes me so proud to see all of you believing in our cause and becoming better scouts for the sake of the ca—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We, your scoutmasters, have gathered here today to deliver the status of our camp to you, our scouts, with full transparency!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As mentioned at our party the other day, the fundraising campaign was a complete success thanks to everyone’s hardwork.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Evidence of our success has been overwhelming the camp mailbox and website as some of you might know.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Pre-registration forms, inquiries, and even some fan mail has been swarming us left and right! I’m proud to say that Camp buddy will only continue to prosper from here on!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And we know you all might be wondering how we will be managing the much busier Camp Buddy by then, but don’t worry!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We already have plans in motion to increase our workforce! And we’ll begin by welcoming none other than Aiden Flynn as one of our new official scoutmasters!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As you may know, Aiden has been our all-around helper the past few years~ But starting next term, he will be working with us full-time!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Based on his track record, as well as his unwavering passion to serve the camp, we have all decided that he is more than qualified for this position.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You may all address him as Scoutmaster Aiden from now on!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But that’s not all, campers. We also have one more addition to make to Camp Buddy’s official roster of staff!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: His selflessness, diligence, and outstanding work ethic were essential to this fundraising campaign’s success!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Working so hard without expecting anything in return throughout the campaign, he is undeniably a pillar of all Camp Buddy’s activities.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We would like to officially announce that starting next term, Mr. Naoto Hamasaki will be joining Camp Buddy as an official scoutmaster!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Naoto here has exemplified all of Camp Buddy’s ideals and vision from the moment he was recruited as a volunteer for the campaign.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And we’re glad to have him as a permanent addition to our official staff!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s a pleasure to have you, Naoto! We’ve put a lot of thought into your recruitment!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: T-Taiga? What are you doing out here?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Is that…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *picks up the dirty journal*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What’s going on, Taiga…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re obviously not okay, Taiga… I’m not going to leave you here knowing that.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You know… it’s okay to cry, Taiga…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I used to think that I shouldn’t cry either, because I was afraid of how everyone would see me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A lot of people were looking up to and counting on me, I didn’t want them to think that I was weak.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, I kept all of my problems to myself for the longest time… Doing my best to fix them by myself without anyone’s help.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But someone once told me that crying does not make anyone less of a person…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It just shows that you have a heart that feels emotions, and that is what makes us alive and human.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve known you for over a year, Taiga… You’re more than just a scout to me...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You might be a strong person, but you have your limits too, just like everyone else…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So please don’t carry that burden alone anymore… You’ve already endured enough.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Taiga…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, Keitaro! What brings you here?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuki…? I haven’t actually… her breakfast is still an hour away. Why?  Did something happen?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Does Yoichi know that she’s missing?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can leave that to me, sir! I’ll take Keitaro with me to help with the search!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No, it’s alright, Aiden! Yuki can’t have gone too far. The two of us and Yoichi should be able to find her.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro, let’s go!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This is bad… It’s definitely going to rain soon. Are you sure Yoichi headed this way, Keitaro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That makes sense… We couldn’t find Yuki anywhere in the camp. It’s no wonder Yoichi would look for her here in the woods…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I just hope they’re both alright….

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Those are…. puppies…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuki must have given birth already!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And there’s Yoichi over there…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yoichi… P-Please listen. Nobody wanted this to happen—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And we can’t leave you like this… What about the puppies? They might get sick if we stay here any longer-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Keitaro, please take the puppies and bring them back to camp… Put them somewhere warm and safe.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can leave him to me… Please follow my orders immediately.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi… Please, calm down… I only want to help you…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi… Please, listen to me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi… I would never do that to you…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You know I loved Yuki as much as you did…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can’t stand to see you suffering like this…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please, don’t hold back… I know you must be so devastated…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You have every right to be hurt and angry…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi… I’m so sorry… If there was any way to change this, I would do it without hesitation…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But we have to accept the truth… Yuki has left us for a better place now…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re right, Yoichi… You don’t deserve this… No one does…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But please remember that you’ll never be alone… We’re all here for you. Always…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, we just finished burying Yuki… I did everything I could to calm him down…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He asked me to leave him alone for now, but I believe he needs you to go and see him.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He’s at the pier…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: K-Keitaro, I know this may sound strange, but… since we all got caught in the rain earlier, maybe you could help convince Yoichi to change into some new clothes?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I… I can’t really bear to see him in a state any worse than he’s in now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I leave Yoichi in your hands, Keitaro. I hope you’ll be able to help him see that everything will be alright…

dialog: Wake up, scouts! It’s time for-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whoa! You’re all up already!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, not exactly an activity. More like a farewell party for everyone since this is our last day.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Then please get dressed! Everyone else is already gathered at the mess hall!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll see you boys there!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good morning, everyone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As you all know, today is the last day of the summer camp!  That also means that we don't really know if we'll see each other again next year.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We have never really held any farewell events like this in the past, but things have changed now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We scoutmasters wanted to say something to all of you, our precious scouts.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir, if you will?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It's unfortunate to know we'll all be parting ways tomorrow with no guarantee that we'll see each other again...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But what truly matters most is that we create the greatest memories we can possibly make here and now!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, campers! Please enjoy your final day here at Camp Buddy!

dialog: Oh, Keitaro! What’s up?

dialog: Ah… About that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… Naoto talked to me yesterday about him getting into an argument with Natsumi over him becoming a scoutmaster.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He has decided to turn down the scoutmaster position we gave him and left the camp this morning.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know this news is upsetting… And I’m really disappointed that I didn’t foresee something like this would happen. Especially over this particular matter.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I tried talking to Natsumi about it this morning and invited him to join us for this party, but he asked me to allow him to skip this event.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I didn’t want to force him, so I let him take his time…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If you think that would be best, then please do, Keitaro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah, sir. I haven’t seen you this excited in a long time.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sorry, but I’m not following. Who is this William Clermont?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you sure this is the same person, sir?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh! You mean Felix?

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can understand Mr. Clermont entrusting his son to us! But what I’m not sure of is why he would want to visit us.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess you could say that, Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What’s wrong with that, sir? It sounds like it went well to me.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s not worry about it too much, sir. Maybe he’s tired, just like you said. He’s a pretty busy man after all.

dialog: I can’t help but feel a little sad too, knowing that it’s not certain that all of us will meet one another in the near future.

dialog: It’s a pleasure to meet you, Mr. Clermont. I am one of the head scoutmasters, Yoshinori Nagira.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, not at all! Anyone is welcome to visit Camp Buddy and have a look around!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Though I wish I could’ve prepared a proper welcome!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, thank you so much for handling it, boys!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank you for the compliments, sir! But I can’t take all the credit – these boys have worked hard to be excellent scouts on their own!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, is there anything you’d like to know more about the camp? I’m happy to give you any information you might need!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, well… since the camp term is about to end, we’re coming up with new and better activities for next year’s curriculum.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll admit that I’m not very up to date on what the new generation finds 'fun,' so I thought I’d get some ideas from them directly!

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

dialog: Haha! That’s great!

name: Yoshinori

dialog: As you all know, today is the last day of the summer camp!  That also means that we don't really know if we'll see each other again next year.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir, if you will?
