dialog: Your ride’s here… but your face is telling me you’re not ready to leave…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You must be thinking about Yoichi…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It will take time, but I know he can pull through this!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You don’t have to worry about him. We’ll definitely take care of him here.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The pleasure is mine! I will miss having you and all the other campers around here.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please don’t let this overtake all of the great things you have done for the camp throughout the summer.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’ve done everything you can to help everyone here, especially Yoichi.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, please try and face tomorrow with a smile! Buddy Law number three!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! You should go ahead now, Keitaro! You don’t want to be left behind!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Scouts! It’s time to wake up!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I want you all to be ready in fifteen minutes!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll be waiting for everyone outside. So get moving!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Attention, everyone! There has been a change in plans.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Our trailblazing and scouting activities have been cancelled for today.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: For those who have not changed into their trekking gear and packed up their things, please do so immediately.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We will be heading back to Camp Buddy, shortly.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sorry everyone, but this is an urgent matter. I hope you all understand.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro, I-I… You’re here already!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir Goro, I can explain!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: R-Right…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: B-But…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But they’re good boys! They won’t be anything like the previous ones! I swear!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If you could just give me one last chance. Please. They are really different this time!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But… I promised to keep them, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But, sir! Please let me have another chance. I want to make up for my shortcomings as a scoutmaster.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thanks for helping me file these papers, Yoichi.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I didn’t bribe you…! I offered you a treat because you’ve been so helpful these last few days!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, alright. Let’s head to the mess hall and-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, one second, Yoichi. Let me just get this.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, Keitaro! What can I do for you—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yoichi…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Err… I’m right here, Yoichi.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What did he say?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, that’s great! We can save that ice-cream treat for when he gets here then!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Maybe you should go and get the puppies? I’m sure Keitaro would love to see them!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aww, Yoichi… Look how much you’ve changed.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hahaha, I’m sure Keitaro wanted to visit someone special, not just the camp~

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sometimes, Yoichi even brings the puppy box into his cabin just so he can sleep beside them.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, Keitaro, how have things been outside the camp? Have you been doing well with school?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmm… That reminds me. I’ve been suggesting to Sir Goro that we enroll Yoichi in a school nearby…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: School isn’t that bad, Yoichi! It’s for your future!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That sounds like a great idea! All of us here are qualified to educate him! I’m sure Yuri and Sir Goro will be able to help teach him too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry, Yoichi! It’s definitely possible! I can manage the paperwork to get your education here fully credited!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I will make sure to make it an exciting and educational experience. I promise!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right! There are so many enrollees that we may have to build some new cabins and facilities! Luckily, Mr. Clermont’s sponsorship will help with that!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It is! Sir Goro couldn’t believe how well everything worked out – he’s actually with Yuri to negotiate with some construction companies now!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway~ I won’t steal too much of your time together! Keitaro, you must be tired from school and the ride over here.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Why don’t you both go and rest in your old cabin for a while? We’ll take care of the puppies so you two can spend some time together!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Have fun today, you two!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Is everything ready, Keitaro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No problem, Keitaro! It’s my pleasure!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wake up, everyone! Get up, get up!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I was busy preparing a special surprise for all of you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As your scoutmaster, I vowed to provide you all with endless amount of “fun” activities where you’ll also learn plenty of important things!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I am a leader that supports recreation and entertainment amongst all my campers! You’ll never have a dull day with me around!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And it’s my job as a scoutmaster—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hahaha! A grump in the morning as always, Yoichi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I want you all to get changed into your uniforms in preparation for our exciting activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll see all of you outside for our morning assembly!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright! Looks like everyone’s here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Follow me, campers! This way!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Tada!!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Our very own obstacle course! Isn’t this exciting?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve been working on this since the start of this year’s summer! I was able to finish this up thanks to the extra help I got yesterday!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have arranged a series of activities for all of you to do today! This is going to be so much fun!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: First off, we’ll be starting with track and field as scheduled and then—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Leave him be, Natsumi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A buddy shall never force another to do something against his will!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now, let’s begin our activities! Nothing can possibly ruin this day!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ll cancel today’s activities for now! Everyone please head back to the cabin in an orderly fashion!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m fine, Natsumi… Please join the others back in the cabin.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Attention, scouts!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Due to unforeseen weather conditions, we were forced to cancel our outdoor activities today for everyone’s safety.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But fear not! For we, your diligent scoutmasters, have decided to let you all have indoor activities instead!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Isn’t this fun?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have tons of indoor activities for you all to enjoy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Come on! Let’s turn those frowns upside down!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Who’s up for arts and crafts?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No, I’m pretty sure that’s not the case.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Lightning probably hit one of the circuits outside…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Do you mind checking it out for us, Aiden?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh. Aiden, one more thing.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Be careful, alright?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t know… all of my plans today are ruined… I can’t even think straight anymore.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Maybe your dad was right... maybe I’m no good at this job at all…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess you’re right…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, everyone! I’m sorry to say this, but we’ll have to postpone all activities until the power comes back!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please head back to your cabins for the time being!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* Am I having the worst luck or what?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, Keitaro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You must be concerned with the power outage.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Power should be back first thing in the morning. I had Aiden work it out for us!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh… I appreciate your sincerity, Keitaro. I’m doing fine.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Troubled? Me?! Nonsense! Everything is going a-okay! You don’t have to worry about anything!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, Keitaro? What is it?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh… You did…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s alright, Keitaro. Thank you for your honesty.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Rest assured it’s not something you should be worried about.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: However, I think it’s better if you hear it directly from me.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Come, sit here with me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The camp president, Mr. Goro is just concerned about the bad reputation that the camp already has.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m glad you’re taking interest in the history of our camp, Keitaro... But… It is not the most flattering story in my case...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… I guess it’s about time I should tell you all about it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* I wasn’t… entirely lucky during my first few years as a scoutmaster.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: More so, I should say that I wasn’t able to do my best in terms of handling my subordinates…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: An unfortunate event took place last year in this camp… It wasn’t my best performance as a scoutmaster…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m talking about destruction of property, vandalism, and violence…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… Let’s just say that the campers last year had a hard time getting along with each other.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: They were always fighting, making trouble and they heeded no authority…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I wanted to try to make them all get along with each other…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, I've organized a huge team building activity for them…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I thought a friendly competition would get them to interact with one another nicely.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Turns out it was the opposite of what I expected…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The winning team refused to share their prize to each member… While the losing team did not exhibit any sportsmanship…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: They ended up seriously hurting each other…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It didn’t stop there. It had gotten worse with each passing day.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everyone just started hating and blaming each other.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No one took the activities seriously and instead spent their time on delinquency.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I only have myself to blame… I’m the leader. I should have been more responsible.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even with all those years of my experience, I was not able to execute my tasks properly.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sorry, Keitaro. But it’s not.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The effects of last year’s incident were so big that… negative rumors about the camp have spread all throughout the city.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I ruined the good name of Camp Buddy…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Most of the campers were either injured or bullied, forcing them to be sent back home…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All of the staff and other scoutmasters resigned too because of that fiasco.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* You must be wondering why I’m not fired yet.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s all thanks to Yuri. She’s a very close friend of mine.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She was kind enough to ask her dad to give me this one last chance to run the camp.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro agreed on the condition that Yuri would accompany me to complete the program for the last batch this summer.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: After that… Camp Buddy will be closed for good.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… there is something…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If only I could prove to him that I can do better as a scoutmaster, maybe Sir Goro would reconsider closing the camp.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But… it’s very irresponsible of me to burden you and everyone with this matter. This duty is mine alone to carry!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, Keitaro… I wish it was really that easy…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Scouts today are just not as interested as they used to anymore…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hehe… You’re one optimistic boy, Keitaro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This camp could really use a person like you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even with just a week of your stay here, you have made a lot of progress with the people around you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Your unwavering determination to create special bonds is what this place needs.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You remind me a lot of how I used to be.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But… I really am on a stump lately… I don’t know what I should do…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m feeling anxious about Sir Goro staying here to observe my progress. One small mistake from me could be the end of this camp…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I need to do something to make him think that this camp is really worth continuing.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m really embarrassed to ask you this but… Do you have any ideas, Keitaro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You mean… Do what I did back then? Isn’t that kind of… risky?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And what if the other campers don’t participate…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well… No, I don’t.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: B-But… It’s not just about that… I don’t know if I’m able to do my part so far.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Really…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hahaha! That’s the buddy law number three!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re right, Keitaro! I cannot just sulk here and hope everything to go well.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All of you are counting on me to have a great and memorable summer in this camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I will give my best no matter what happens from now on!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuri was right about you. You really are something!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Not at all, Hunter!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please go ahead and have your dinner, Keitaro. Your friends are waiting!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yuri! H-How long have you been there?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess I just haven’t been able to vent all my frustrations lately…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I was reminded why I wanted this job in the first place. I guess I have Keitaro to thank for that.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: His presence enough reaffirms why I should get back up on my feet.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Come on… Don’t tease me like that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thanks, Yuri…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright! Now that Keitaro is awake, I’d like you all to listen to an important announcement!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure you all had a long rest after that intense storm and that dreadful power outage!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, I’ve decided to give you all a very special activity today to have your blood pumping and running again!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We will be having a teambuilding activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A friendly competition to see which teams best exhibit Camp Buddy teamwork!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve already made up my mind!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All thanks to Keitaro here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve provided you all with new uniforms for this activity! So, please get changed as soon as possible!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll meet you all in the obstacle course within thirty minutes!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: ATTENTION!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Attention, everyone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Today is a wonderful day! A perfect day to have a very special activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: To commemorate the completion of our new and improved obstacle course, we’ll be having our Camp Buddy Sportsfest!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You will all be separated into teams of five and compete with other teams according to your cabin designations!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There won’t be any prize for this competition, so I’d like you all to take this opportunity to have fun with your buddies instead!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And last but not the least… Our president and owner of Camp Buddy, Goro Nomoru, is here with us today for this wonderful event!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, we’re expecting all of you to have a fair and orderly competition! Show us what you’ve learned, and work together as a team!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Your coach, Aiden Flynn here will be the overseer for this contest of physical prowess!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He will give you all a short briefing regarding this competition!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: May I have everyone’s attention please?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This has been a spectacular day for all of us!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As your scoutmaster, I couldn’t be prouder of each and every one of you for exhibiting teamwork and sportsmanship.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This special activity would not have been possible without all of your cooperation!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I understand… Thanks, Yuri.

dialog: *gulp*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, Keitaro! I wanted to thank you formally for your idea to hold another sportsfest this year! I can tell our president was relieved by how it all turned out.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hahaha! Why thank you so much!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, I’m really sorry if Yuri insisted that all of you scouts assist with the cleanup. If she'd only let me. I would’ve taken care of this myself.

dialog: That’d be great, Natsumi! I didn’t think anyone would volunteer to do such a grueling task!

dialog: A-And please go wash your hands. Your uniform’s already covered in stains!

dialog: You seem to be acting rather odd today… Did something happen between you and Keitaro?

name: Natsumi
dialog: I noticed you were pretty quiet last night as well.

dialog: Are you sure? You know you can tell me!

name: Natsumi
dialog: I’m like your big brother here, right?

dialog: Then let’s hear it!

dialog: Oh… Why is that? From what I’ve seen, you’ve been doing so well with him these past few days.

dialog: Is there something that’s made you more withdrawn around him in particular?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well, to be fair, this is your first time in a circle of friends. So, I think it’s only normal to feel that way.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Hunter, you know that Keitaro's sincere with all of his words and actions. I’m sure that whatever he's said or done is just his way of show how much he likes you!

dialog: Just be yourself, Hunter. You don’t have to be shy with any of us! And especially not with Keitaro!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Try and be more comfortable around him. It lets Keitaro know that you appreciate what he does for you.

name: Natsumi

dialog: You don’t have to think twice about showing who you really are! We’ll always be here no matter what!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Oh, I thought you weren’t interested, Yoichi~ These are “lame” activities, after all.

dialog: Oh, well you can get whatever badge you want as long as you participate, Yoichi.

dialog: Yeah! I think Hunter is just saying that maybe Keitaro can earn a badge that better represents himself.

dialog: Isn’t that right, Hunter?

dialog: Hmm… I see a limited-edition swim badge on here! Maybe I could go and try to earn that one!

dialog: The rulebook did state that the photo should be well lit and at a proper angle, after all.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well maybe we could at least try to get an interesting action shot! Like a beetle in flight!

name: Natsumi
dialog: But then again… beetles usually fly at dusk in search of mates, and we don't have time for that now.

name: Natsumi
dialog: O-Oh…! Did I go overboard again?

name: Natsumi
dialog: *sigh* I keep getting carried away by my own standards...

name: Natsumi
dialog: *sigh* I keep getting carried away by my own standards...{fast}

name: Natsumi
dialog: You’re right, Keitaro. If I see it that way, I could enjoy this a lot better!

name: Natsumi
dialog: You’re totally right about that, Keitaro.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ah, you’re right about that, Keitaro…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I know, Keitaro. I’m sorry…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I’m sorry again for acting that way. I was just reminded by how my brother would do things whenever we did stuff like this together…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Yeah, actually he was the one who got me interested in bug-hunting in the first place!

name: Natsumi
dialog: He knew exactly where to hunt and he’d always find really rare ones too! I was always so amazed by him...

name: Natsumi
dialog: I guess I was just trying to impress you like my older brother did with me back then.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ah, well, that's because we were, Keitaro. When we were younger, my parents always said nothing could tear Naoto and me apart.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Not really, Keitaro. Naoto is the life of the party wherever he goes. And unlike me, he excels in everything he wants to do very quickly as well.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Growing up, I always wanted to be as well rounded as he was.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ah, he's just gotten so busy with his own life… He moved out a long time ago to study in the city. And that was way before I even started attending Camp Buddy.

name: Natsumi
dialog: You’re probably right about just enjoying this beetle hunt! I mean, my brother and I never had rulebooks or anything when we did this before!

name: Natsumi
dialog: *gasp*

name: Natsumi
dialog: K-Keitaro…!

name: Natsumi
dialog: D-Don’t move a muscle.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well, just look what I found on your shoulder!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Haha, this little guy fell from the tree tops! Luckily, he landed right on you, Keitaro!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Yep! A male one too! The one we saw on our first camping trip was a female.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Oh, not at all, Keitaro! They’re actually mostly harmless~

name: Natsumi
dialog: They only use their jaws to wrestle with other male beetles over territory or females during breeding season~

name: Natsumi
dialog: I still can’t believe the subject for our photo literally fell out of the sky, Keitaro!

name: Natsumi
dialog: I guess things do come naturally when you’re having fun, huh?

name: Natsumi
dialog: I definitely think so! But, just to be sure, why don’t we take a few extra shots?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Scoutmaster Yoshi! We’re done with our activity!

name: Natsumi
dialog: The photography badge was one of the badges I didn't have yet, sir. I figured this would be the perfect time to try and earn it with someone as experienced as Keitaro!

name: Natsumi
dialog: O-Oh, this is actually the first photo I took for the activity, sir.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ah, not this time, sir…!

name: Natsumi
dialog: And it’s a limited edition one too!  Thank you so much, Scoutmaster Yoshi!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Of course! You might need your own sash soon too, Keitaro!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Y-Yeah…!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Oh, if you want, sir, I can go and help Sir Aiden cook! I’m sure he could use a hand with all the prepwork!

name: Natsumi
dialog: I don’t mind covering for you, sir!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Yes, sir! I won’t let you down!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Keitaro, I know what you're gonna say, but I promise I’m not feeling tired at all this time!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Eh? You’re gonna help too, Keitaro?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Phew… I was so worried you’d think I was overworking again.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Alright!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Reporting for duty, sir!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Yes, sir! Keitaro and I were hoping could help you a little with preparing dinner!

name: Natsumi
dialog: I can help you with the cutting, sir!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Keitaro, there’s some firewood Scoutmaster Yoshi and I gathered this morning around the scoutmaster's tent. You can just use those!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Oh, not at all, sir! I got to relax doing the badge-earning activity today, so I’m not too tired at all.

name: Natsumi
dialog: A-Ah, really, sir…? I hope that’s not a bad thing…

name: Natsumi
dialog: W-Well, it’s nothing compared to all the tasks you’re in charge of here at camp, sir!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ah…! It's just I get so inspired seeing you fulfill your duties all the time no matter how hard it gets, sir.

name: Natsumi
dialog: You're my role model when it comes to hard work!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Yes, sir! Sometimes, I just can’t help but wonder how you can stay motivated for so long and work so hard…!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ah…

name: Natsumi
dialog: R-Right…!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Haha, I do see Hunter scribbling sometimes in the corner. I actually thought he was just writing then.

name: Natsumi
dialog: W-Wait! Yoichi actually tried to join an activity?

name: Natsumi
dialog: After all these camps terms, this is actually the first time I’ve ever seen you earn a badge!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well, I already have most of the badges, Hiro…  So I wanted to earn something new! And I've never really tried photography before.

name: Natsumi
dialog: It’s a good thing Keitaro was there to guide me!

name: Natsumi
dialog: And it’s almost curfew too. We should probably head to the tents and get some rest!

name: Natsumi
dialog: It’s true that it seems odd that Taiga would change his attitude so drastically…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I guess Keitaro’s right! There’s no reason to harbor any more bad feelings if Taiga really is sorry for what he did.

name: Natsumi
dialog: At any rate, it's already curfew for us. We should head inside the tent before the scoutmasters catch us.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Y-Yoichi…! Why are you stripping down?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Guys, we can't go outside. It’s already way past curfew, and we can't just disobey one of the few rules Sir Goro set for us here.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well, it’s for our own safety, Yoichi! We can’t compromise our health or have campers suddenly missing at night.

name: Natsumi
dialog: If you’re really that bored, we can just write in Keitaro’s journal together just like the other night!

name: Natsumi
dialog: How about we take a look at all the photos Keitaro’s  taken for the vacation so far? That should be interesting!

name: Natsumi
dialog: H-Hold on, Scoutmaster Yoshi… Didn’t Sir Goro tell us night swimming wasn’t allowed?

name: Natsumi
dialog: A-And it’s way past curfew as well…

name: Natsumi
dialog: A-Are you sure about this, Scoutmaster Yoshi? W-We might get in a lot of trouble!

name: Natsumi
dialog: *sigh* Alright… Let’s go get prepared, I guess.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Umm… no, Keitaro. But I’m sure it’s just in here somewhere.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Besides, it might not be a good idea to bring that out.

name: Natsumi
dialog: I mean we’re already bending the rules a little too much now. The flashes from your camera might catch Sir Goro’s attention and get us all in trouble.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ah, it’s alright, Keitaro. I’m not really in the mood to swim for tonight.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Actually, yeah…

name: Natsumi
dialog: …I’m kinda scared Sir Goro might see us at any moment.

name: Natsumi
dialog: H-Haha… You really know how to read me, Keitaro…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ah...

name: Natsumi
dialog: I just wonder why Scoutmaster Yoshi would break the few simple rules Sir Goro set over something like this…

name: Natsumi
dialog: …up to the point that he made the other scoutmasters stall Sir Goro for him.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Doesn’t it bother you that Scoutmaster Yoshi is the one who always tells us to follow the rules, but decides to break them now?

name: Natsumi
dialog: I see…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I’m so sorry, Keitaro… But I’m just so confused right now…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I mean, over the past few days of this vacation, there were so many times I needed to readjust myself…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I was overthinking… I was trying to follow rules too much… and now, I’m making a big deal over something so simple…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I feel like I’m going in circles because there’s no way I can keep things balanced…

name: Natsumi
dialog: And I know it’s even more frustrating for you and everyone else to have to keep telling me to relax or not overthink things…

name: Natsumi
dialog: It’s really made me think about why I work this hard and why I’m so strict with myself in the first place….

name: Natsumi
dialog: It’s really made me think about why I work this hard and why I’m so strict with myself in the first place….{fast}

name: Natsumi
dialog: Keitaro…

name: Natsumi
dialog: It’s something I have to figure out on my own, huh…?

name: Natsumi
dialog: *sigh*

name: Natsumi
dialog: I don’t know how you never get tired of dealing with me, Keitaro…

name: Natsumi
dialog: But, I really appreciate you listening to me and trying to give me advice…

name: Natsumi
dialog: And I’m sure I’ll figure it out as long as I keep trying, just like you said…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I think that’s a good idea, Keitaro.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Sure thing!

name: Natsumi
dialog: A-Ah, yeah…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Good morning, Keitaro!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ms. Yuri told us there was some kind of announcement! Isn’t that exciting?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Do you have any idea what the announcement’s about, Keitaro?

name: Natsumi
dialog: A-Ah, that’s Scoutmaster Yoshi! Sorry, everyone, let’s pay attention for a moment!

name: Natsumi
dialog: I actually have no idea… All the past terms I’ve been here, we’ve never done anything like this.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Maybe Yoichi knows? He’s been here longer than me.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well, Scoutmaster Yoshi did order us to take down the tents… It’s only natural that Keitaro would help disassemble the one he stayed in!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Y-You guys might get mad at me for saying this, but I actually think Keitaro’s plan is working now…

name: Natsumi
dialog: When I reported to Scoutmaster Yoshi for my badge activity yesterday, he mentioned that Keitaro and Taiga earned their badges together!

name: Natsumi
dialog: That’s right! Scoutmaster Yoshi has everything under control!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Haha, you guys should think positively like Hunter!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Anyway, let’s take down our tent and get packed up! We have an exciting adventure coming up~!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Yoichi, Hiro, I’ll leave the tent to you two! Hunter and I will take care of our bags!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well, you’re the strongest of us right? I thought you’d be able to handle the toughest work!

name: Natsumi
dialog: There’s even a huge pond at the bottom of it! I hope we’re permitted to swim there! It’ll be nice to take a break from salt water!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Now, now, let’s not get carried away, you two! We’ll have to be careful around those rocks! I’m sure they’re slippery, and we could hurt ourselves!

name: Natsumi
dialog: And I don’t think the scoutmasters would allow something like that in the first place.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Not even a minute in and you’re already planning to break the rules, Yoichi! Haven’t you been listening?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well, the fact that we’re reliving a moment our scoutmasters have been through when they were just scouts is already cool!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Y-Yoichi! Stop provoking Taiga…!

name: Natsumi
dialog: I don’t know, but I honestly think that could be a true story!

name: Natsumi
dialog: The scoutmasters did say they made special memories here, so maybe it’s how they have so many lasting friendships with each other?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Yoichi! Where are you taking Hiro?! We were supposed to set up our tents first!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Aww, that’s really helpful of you, Hunter~

name: Natsumi
dialog: Tell you what, once we finish setting up, I’ll ask Scoutmaster Yoshi to help you find the perfect scenery for your drawing! I’m sure he knows the best view around here!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Alright then, we’ll be going ahead, everyone! See you later, Keitaro! …And friends!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Are you not upset with him at all, Keitaro?

name: Natsumi
dialog: W-Well, let’s try not to dwell too much on Taiga right now… There’s nothing we can do about it, after all…

name: Natsumi
dialog: What about your camera though, Keitaro? Do you think it’ll be alright?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well, you mentioned that the scoutmasters would be going to retrieve it, right? I’m sure they can recover it. Sir Aiden will be able to fix anything that’s broken too!

name: Natsumi
dialog: H-Hey! That was a very immature prank, Yoichi!

name: Natsumi
dialog: This is a very inappropriate topic for a sausage dinner!

name: Natsumi
dialog: N-Not you too, Seto!

name: Natsumi
dialog: W-We shouldn’t be laughing… *chuckles*… a-at this…

name: Natsumi
dialog: It’s about the picture you took, Keitaro.

name: Natsumi
dialog: I-I’m actually surprised by this Keitaro… Though I can’t help but laugh…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I guess we should go after them and make sure they don’t get into trouble with that photo.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Now, now, Yoichi. Let’s not show this around everywhere.

name: Natsumi
dialog: I’m serious, you guys! If Sir Goro finds out about this, we’ll all get into a lot of trouble!

name: Natsumi
dialog: A-Ah! S-Sir Goro!

name: Natsumi
dialog: O-Oh! It’s nothing, sir!

name: Natsumi
dialog: A-Ah, Sir Goro, i-it’s not what you think! I was just about to dispose of-

name: Natsumi
dialog: Y-Yes, sir…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Keitaro…? Are you alright?

name: Natsumi
dialog: We’re sorry about what happened, Keitaro…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Really? But I’m sure I saw it here this morning.

name: Natsumi
dialog: It can’t be… Did one of you three take the picture?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well… We all obviously believe that Keitaro didn’t take that picture… And it seems so out of character for him to do something so mischievous…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Yoichi... tell us honestly, were you the one who did it? We all know that you have the reputation of being a prankster after all...

name: Natsumi
dialog: M-Me?! I would never do such a thing…! Especially against the scoutmasters!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Y-You’re right, Keitaro… I’m sorry, everyone. I shouldn’t have jumped to conclusions…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ah! Scoutmaster Yuri!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Y-Yes ma’am! We’ll be out there right away!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ahh… Everything is a mess… How did it all turn out like this…?

name: Natsumi
dialog: H-Hiro… Please calm down…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I have to agree with Hiro, Keitaro…

name: Natsumi
dialog: There wouldn’t be much of a reason for Yoichi to freak out like he did unless he was guilty…  And it’s not unlike him to pull a prank like that…

name: Natsumi
dialog: There wouldn’t be much of a reason for Yoichi to freak out like he did unless he was guilty…  And it’s not unlike him to pull a prank like that…{fast}

name: Natsumi
dialog: Really? Who do you think could have done something like that to Keitaro?

name: Natsumi
dialog: B-But didn’t Taiga say just yesterday that he’s friends with us now? Why would he do it?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Hmmm… You might have a point, Hunter.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Taiga has stirred up trouble before… But I had hoped he’d moved past all of that…

name: Natsumi
dialog: You’re right, Hunter… I doubt the scoutmasters would be able to judge this situation properly.

name: Natsumi
dialog: It’s best that we follow their orders for now and wait for them to calm down.

name: Natsumi
dialog: For now, we need to get packed up and take down this tent as soon as possible before they get any angrier at us.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Hiro! Sorry for interrupting, but could you please help me out with the cleanup? We can’t afford to get scolded again if we leave this place dirty.

name: Natsumi
dialog: It’s already sunset and Yoichi hasn’t come back yet…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I don’t think the scoutmasters would do something like that, Hunter!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Huh…? Weren’t you just talking with him an hour ago?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Maybe he’s with the scoutmasters…? You know… to talk about what happened before?

name: Natsumi
dialog: We thought that Sir Goro might be talking with him…

name: Natsumi
dialog: T-Taiga’s right! Let’s not make the situation any worse, Hiro!

name: Natsumi
dialog: A-Ah… What should we do, Hiro…?

name: Natsumi
dialog: H-Hiro… Thinking like that isn’t going to help anything…

name: Natsumi
dialog: We haven’t even heard why they’re doing this in the first place… Let’s at least give them a chance to explain themselves, alright?

name: Natsumi
dialog: If I could, I’d like to offer my assistance in searching for them!

name: Natsumi
dialog: That’s all the more reason why we would like to help the search… It’s already dangerous outside…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Shh, Hiro!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Thank you for convincing Sir Goro to let us help with the search, Ms. Yuri.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Affirmative, Scoutmaster Yuri!

name: Natsumi
dialog: H-Here, Hunter… Have some water.

name: Natsumi
dialog: They are not troublemakers, sir… They’re our friends… We know they’d never do something like that, especially to you, sir.

name: Natsumi
dialog: C-Calm down, Yoichi... We won't accomplish anything if we just stay here arguing...

name: Natsumi
dialog: Hunter and I would like to volunteer for that group, sir.

name: Natsumi
dialog: You can count on me, sir! I’ll make sure we don’t move until all the groups are together again!

name: Natsumi
dialog: F-Finally! I’m glad that you two are okay! We were so worried!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Are you two injured at all?

name: Natsumi
dialog: We’ll help prepare the cabin, sir!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Keitaro, Hiro! There you two are!

name: Natsumi
dialog: D-Did Sir Goro punish you two…?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Whew, that’s good news at least…

name: Natsumi
dialog: W-well… We don’t have any concrete evidence… But we all discussed it, and we all agree that there was no way Keitaro could have taken that photo.

name: Natsumi
dialog: I don’t think it’ll make a difference if we tell him that we think someone else took the picture though. At least not without any solid evidence…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Hiro… Are you sure about this? If we don’t do anything, you and Keitaro will be expelled for sure…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Keitaro is such a selfless person…

name: Natsumi
dialog: T-Turd…? You mean Taiga???

name: Natsumi
dialog: But how do we get any kind of clues? We’re already too far from the crime scene…

name: Natsumi
dialog: That’s true… Sir Goro was really embarrassed by that photo… He probably won’t want it to ever be seen again.

name: Natsumi
dialog: But on the bright side, I didn’t see the scoutmasters dispose or destroy that picture, so I’m sure they’ve kept it safe and hidden somewhere.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well, yes…

name: Natsumi
dialog: You see, I was cleaning the scoutmaster’s office one day when I stumbled across the drawer…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Since I wanted the whole place to be cleaned, I went in and organized it!

name: Natsumi
dialog: N-No! That’s not it! I would never!

name: Natsumi
dialog: There’s nowhere else I would really think it could be…

name: Natsumi
dialog: W-Wait! You guys can’t be really considering breaking into the scoutmaster’s office!

name: Natsumi
dialog: If we get caught, we’ll be expelled from the camp for sure! Besides, there aren’t many things worse than stealing!

name: Natsumi
dialog: H-Hey, Sir Aiden clearly told us we’re free to take food whenever we’re hungry...!

name: Natsumi
dialog: A-Anyway! Even if we did try and break in, the doors will be locked at night. Scoutmaster Yuri usually keeps the keys in her bag as well…

name: Natsumi
dialog: No… The only entrance it has is the front door…

name: Natsumi
dialog: A-Although…

name: Natsumi
dialog: N-Nevermind, it’s a bad idea…

name: Natsumi
dialog: N-No… I really don’t want to—

name: Natsumi
dialog: A-Alright, alright… calm down, Yoichi…

name: Natsumi
dialog: T-There’s a low-hanging window right behind the office. The lock on it is broken right now…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Only me, Sir Aiden and Scoutmaster Yoshi know about this…  Sir Aiden said that he’ll fix it, but he hasn’t been able to work on it yet…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I already feel bad about getting involved in this…

name: Natsumi
dialog: N-No way! Not in a million years! Absolutely not!

name: Natsumi
dialog: I’ve already said way more than I should about the office! I’m now being complicit in a crime against my scoutmasters!

name: Natsumi
dialog: If they find out, I could lose my best scout reputation! I’ve had it for three years now!

name: Natsumi
dialog: B-Besides… I won’t fit through the window anyways!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Any of you can definitely fit through that window, I can just tell the three of you where the picture is stored exactly!

name: Natsumi
dialog: I can’t believe we’re doing this…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I can’t wear my ‘Good Noodle’ badge in good conscience now…

name: Natsumi
dialog: You’re right… I guess if we’re gonna do it for Keitaro’s sake…

name: Natsumi
dialog: The scoutmasters have been extra tense all day… if they find us out here we’ll get punished for sure!

name: Natsumi
dialog: I can’t stand the thought of it… It gives me the chills…!

name: Natsumi
dialog: The scoutmasters keep the confiscated items in the left drawer of the big desk in the room… You really can’t miss it.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Please hurry, you two…

name: Natsumi
dialog: You two are making a lot of noise!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Guys! Hurry up…!

name: Natsumi
dialog: What is taking them so long…?! They should have been finished by now…

name: Natsumi
dialog: WHAT?! No!! Oh no! I knew this was gonna happen! We’re doomed…

name: Natsumi
dialog: What’s Scoutmaster Yoshi doing here anyway?! He should be asleep by now!

name: Natsumi
dialog: He’s gonna catch us and we’re going to be expelled! He’ll be so disappointed in me!

name: Natsumi
dialog: W-Well, y-you see, Scoutmaster Yoshi, t-there’s a perfectly logical, totally reasonable, 100 percent decent explanation for it!

name: Natsumi
dialog: We were just in our cabin, and then a thing happened, and now we’re out here, and well… yeah?

name: Natsumi
dialog: S-Sir, I... Ahh..

name: Natsumi
dialog: W-What…? You’re wearing it, sir…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Umm…

name: Natsumi
dialog: H-Hunter… I think there’s something wrong with Scoutmaster Yoshi…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I-Intoxicated…?! I didn’t know Scoutmaster Yoshi even drank!

name: Natsumi
dialog: R-Right…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Y-Yeah! We’re afraid it could’ve been a burglar.

name: Natsumi
dialog: U-Umm…

name: Natsumi
dialog: W-What… just happened…?

name: Natsumi
dialog: R-Right…

name: Natsumi
dialog: What took you guys so long?!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Scoutmaster Yoshi was here a while ago! Good thing we managed to brush him off!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Come on, we need to go back to the cabins now! We’ll be in trouble for real this time if another scoutmaster sees us!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Hah… Hah… T-That was too close… I don’t think I’ve ever been so scared in my life before…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I can’t believe we actually did something like that…!

name: Natsumi
dialog: No way! We’ve already crossed too many lines today! If the scoutmasters see lights on this late, we’ll get in trouble for sure!

name: Natsumi
dialog: M-Maybe we should just call it a day for now… I don’t think I can handle any more stress!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Plus Keitaro is sleeping tightly over there… We don’t want him to find out that we did this, right?

name: Natsumi
dialog: R-Right…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Oh, not at all, Keitaro! We just got dressed to have lunch at the mess hall.

name: Natsumi
dialog: You and Hunter were sleeping so peacefully, so we didn’t bother to wake you up.

name: Natsumi
dialog: We were all up quite late waiting for you guys to come back to tell us any news… but we all fell asleep…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well, it looks like it worked at least! Keitaro looks a bit livelier today~!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Wow, Hunter! I didn’t expect you to say something like that!

name: Natsumi
dialog: If that’s the case, maybe you should go get changed and have lunch! We already had ours since you guys were still asleep.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Before you go with Keitaro, Hunter… we wanted to fill you in on what we talked about last night while you two were away…

name: Natsumi
dialog: W-Well… ever since we found out there was a chance Keitaro would leave camp, we couldn’t help but get just as worried about him…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I mean, we've all been having so much fun together that it's hard to imagine the rest of this summer without him...

name: Natsumi
dialog: We’re not sure how since we don’t have any solid evidence to convince Sir Goro yet…

dialog: Good morning, Hunter!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Oh, right!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Yoichi! It’s time to wake up!

name: Natsumi
dialog: If you don’t get up, I’m going to call the scoutmasters!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Yoichi!!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Man… It's so hard to wake you up...

name: Natsumi
dialog: Keitaro, could you give me a hand?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Wow. That was fast!

name: Natsumi
dialog: I think that’s the shortest time it's ever taken to get him up.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Maybe you should be in charge of waking him up next time. Haha!

name: Natsumi
dialog: We should be heading out now, though. Scoutmaster Yoshi woke us up earlier than usual… I wonder if everything is alright.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Huh? What’s going on? If I remember our schedule correctly, we should have another activity this morning.

name: Natsumi
dialog: N-No... That’s not…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I don’t understand… If our schedule was correct we should only be leaving three hours from now…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Did one of the scoutmasters change the schedule?

name: Natsumi
dialog: We shouldn’t involve ourselves in a fight.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Violence never solves anything.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Would you fight them, and, in the process, stoop down to their level as well?

name: Natsumi
dialog: I’m not entirely sure. I guess we can ask the scoutmaster once he’s in a position to say.

name: Natsumi
dialog: This is quite strange. They don’t usually cancel big activities like this unless there’s bad weather.

name: Natsumi
dialog: But, I guess orders are orders…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I really don’t know… I’m sorry…

name: Natsumi
dialog: R-Right! We don’t want to get left behind!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Don’t worry, Keitaro. I’m sure we’ll have another activity to make up for it soon.

name: Natsumi

dialog: Let’s move! Let’s move!

dialog: What are you going to write in there, Keitaro?

dialog: One hundred and forty-five to be precise!

dialog: I’m five badges away from completing the collection book.

dialog: I’m five badges away from completing the collection book.{fast}

dialog: They’re not exactly useful.

dialog: But, having something like an award to look at for your hard work is really fulfilling.

dialog: We’re not necessarily required to collect badges.

dialog: But where’s the fun in that?

dialog: Oh no, of course not! I believe Hunter and the other campers have some badges too!

name: Natsumi
dialog: If I remember correctly, Hunter has already acquired two of his own badges.

name: Natsumi
dialog: I think they were the ‘Bookworm Badge’ and ‘Well-Behaved Badge.’

name: Natsumi

name: Natsumi
dialog: Don’t be so negative, Yoichi! Think of it as a trophy you earned with your hard work!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Isn’t it fulfilling to see all your achievements?

name: Natsumi
dialog: And you know how tight the budget in this camp is… Scoutmaster Yoshi made these badges himself!

name: Natsumi
dialog: It’s really nice of him to do that, you know!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Yoichi! You should at least be grateful that Scoutmaster Yoshi is doing his best to give us awards for the things we put effort into.

name: Natsumi
dialog: See, even Keitaro thinks so!

name: Natsumi

name: Natsumi
dialog: You should learn a thing or two from him, Yoichi.

name: Natsumi
dialog: The scoutmasters are teaching us values that we can carry with us when we grow up, Yoichi.

dialog: Wow! Real mature, Yoichi!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Give it back! Come on!!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Oh! Then you’ll have fun writing up the next one! It was your first outdoor camping trip after all!

dialog: Hiro’s idea to add chocolate and crackers to the marshmallows made it a lot tastier!

name: Natsumi

name: Natsumi
dialog: I’ve learned a lot about camping and survival thanks to Camp Buddy. I’m confident I’ve learned enough for me to survive on my own!

name: Natsumi

name: Natsumi
dialog: Now that we’ve recalled the one important moment of Keitaro’s day, I think he can start writing his entry!

name: Natsumi
dialog: That was fun, wasn’t it?

name: Natsumi
dialog: I have to say, I’m surprised Yoichi stayed until we finished.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Now that everything’s done, let’s all call it a day! It’s closing time anyway.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Let’s head back to our cabin and get some rest.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Just tell us if you ever need someone to help you recall events of the day.

dialog: Hi there, Keitaro.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ah, yes. I’m sorry if I called out of nowhere. I’m not bothering you, am I?

name: Natsumi
dialog: Ah… Well, things are actually a little shaky here at home…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well… my brother moved out yesterday because of an argument we had.

name: Natsumi
dialog: I know… It sounds really bad.

name: Natsumi

name: Natsumi
dialog: My parents….

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well… Ever since my brother and I got back from camp, we’ve been having a lot of misunderstandings and fights.

name: Natsumi
dialog: It looks like we really couldn’t get along anymore after what happened between us.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Our parents would always try to fix things but Naoto’s departure yesterday was the last straw…

name: Natsumi
dialog: They started blaming the camp because it was the last place we were both together before this all started happening.

name: Natsumi
dialog: That’s why they’ve decided it’s best if I don’t enroll again for next summer…

name: Natsumi
dialog: As much as I want to go back and spend time with everyone again, I don’t want to make things worse by disobeying my parents and enrolling without their consent…

name: Natsumi
dialog: I believe I have to fix things with my family first… Especially with my brother.

name: Natsumi
dialog: I’ll be sure to let you know if things do get better over here.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Who knows? Maybe my parents will change their minds once I make up with Naoto.

name: Natsumi
dialog: I’m going to do my best to make that happen… so I can join Camp Buddy again.

name: Natsumi
dialog: I do have a favor to ask, though…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Please don’t let all this change your plans of attending next year’s camp term!

name: Natsumi
dialog: It would be really nice if you could be there with everyone… even if I can’t.

name: Natsumi
dialog: That’d be wonderful, Keitaro. Thank you so much.

name: Natsumi
dialog: I won’t. Like I said, I’ll keep doing my best.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Thanks again, Keitaro…

name: Natsumi
dialog: Is it okay if I come over today?

name: Natsumi

name: Natsumi

name: Natsumi
dialog: So, he kind of brought up my interest in being a scoutmaster to Scoutmaster Yoshi again.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Well… he asked Naoto if I was still interested in being an assistant scoutmaster for the next term!

dialog: To be honest, I’ve actually decided to decline the offer.

dialog: I’ve done a lot of thinking since the term ended… And I understand why Scoutmaster Yoshi couldn’t offer me the position back then.

name: Natsumi
dialog: I realized I wanted to be a scoutmaster for the wrong reasons.

name: Natsumi
dialog: And I proved to myself that there were still so many things I needed to learn. I really wasn’t sure I was ready for it yet.

name: Natsumi
dialog: Don’t get me wrong! I still want to be a scoutmaster someday, but I want to be confident that I’m doing it for the right reasons when that time comes!

name: Natsumi
dialog: Also, one of the biggest reasons I’m turning this down is because of our friends…!

name: Natsumi
dialog: When I come back next term to Camp Buddy, I want to enjoy my time with everyone as a scout!

name: Natsumi
dialog: I don’t want my goals to distract me from what really matters. Spending time with people I love!

name: Natsumi
dialog: But I still plan to help the camp in any way I can, and I know I can do that even if I’m not a scoutmaster!

name: Natsumi
dialog: But let me tell you the biggest reason why I didn’t want to be a scoutmaster yet…

name: Natsumi
dialog: If I became a scoutmaster, that would mean I’ll have less time to spend with you like I usually do.

dialog: Oh hey, I just had an idea! Why don’t we ask the scouts what they want?

name: Aiden
dialog: They can cast their votes, and whichever activity gets the most votes is the one we’ll do!

name: Aiden
dialog: That way, it’s win-win for everyone~

name: Aiden
dialog: I’m more concerned that you even have a collection of luxurious swimwear for guys…

name: Aiden
dialog: That didn’t help at all! The score’s still tied!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha! See?~ My idea’s the best!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha! Well, technically you still are. We’re just doing a few ‘minor’ tweaks to the theme, is all~

name: Aiden
dialog: Come on~ You may not be able to see these boys in your designer underwear…

name: Aiden
dialog: But at least you’ll be able to see some juicy, juicy muscles~

name: Aiden
dialog: Just imagine them, Yuri. All oiled up and shimmering under the hot summer sun!

name: Aiden
dialog: Just watch and learn!

name: Aiden
dialog: Gather up, everyone! We’ll be starting the contest soon!

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright, scouts! Time to get those muscles pumped! Because today we’re gonna have our very own strongman competition!

name: Aiden
dialog: It’s easy. Really, it's just like a weightlifting contest~

name: Aiden
dialog: See all these barrels and boxes beside me?~

name: Aiden
dialog: Everyone's goal is to transfer as many boxes as from here all the way to the main camping grounds!

name: Aiden
dialog: No cheating, alright? Since this is a weightlifting competition, every box and barrel must be carried manually there with no exceptions!

name: Aiden
dialog: Each box will count as two points and every barrel will count as three! Whoever can transfer the most cargo wins!

name: Aiden
dialog: I already thought that through, of course~

name: Aiden
dialog: The reason I say you scouts need to get those muscles pumping… is because I’m not seeing a lot of them on some of you!

name: Aiden
dialog: But with the help of Yuri here, who… surprisingly enough, has a detailed chart of everybody’s physical traits and measurements…

name: Aiden
dialog: …I’ve managed to group you all into balanced pairs based on physical aptitude! You know, to be fair~!

name: Aiden
dialog: And of course I’m giving a special prize for the winning team too! So, y'all better do your best!

name: Aiden
dialog: Relax~ I’ve got this all covered!

name: Aiden
dialog: Now, I want you all to pair up with your partners and plan out your way to winning this contest~ We’ll begin in five minutes!

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright! Looks like all of you are pumped up and ready to go! Let’s get this show on the road!

name: Aiden
dialog: Remember! You’ve all gotta carry as many boxes and barrels to the main camping ground as you can!

name: Aiden
dialog: Okay! On your marks! Get set!

name: Aiden
dialog: Go!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oho~ Looks like we’ve already got our first team here~ That was pretty quick!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha~ And here comes our resident gamer and hyperactive speedster! Quite the pairing, huh guys?

name: Aiden
dialog: Go, Hunter! You can do this! Show Yoichi what you’re made of!

name: Aiden
dialog: Uh-oh! Looks like you guys are the last to arrive!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha! You guys really got some strategy going on here, don’t ya?

name: Aiden
dialog: Looks like everyone’s doing great so far!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hey! You two! Stop!

name: Aiden
dialog: This is a strongman contest! And I specifically said you can only carry, not roll!

name: Aiden
dialog: Sorry, but rules are rules! You two are disqualified!

name: Aiden
dialog: Geez, that guy has some attitude issues. Good thing Gramps didn’t see that!

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright! Time’s up!!

name: Aiden
dialog: Time to tally everyone’s boxes and barrels!

name: Aiden
dialog: Here are our finalists for the strongman competition~! And here we have the top three teams who have moved an amazing amount of cargo across the beach!

name: Aiden
dialog: For Hiro and Seto, you got… two boxes and one barrel! That’s a total of seven points!

name: Aiden
dialog: Good job! But make sure you guys amp up your game next time, alright?

name: Aiden
dialog: That gives Team Hiro a total of eight points then!

name: Aiden
dialog: As for your team, Yoichi and Hunter, let’s see how many points you earned!

name: Aiden
dialog: One, two, three… Okay, so you collected four boxes and three barrels total! That’s a whopping seventeen points for Yoichi and Hunter!

name: Aiden
dialog: Not just yet, bro! We still need to see how many Team Natsumi brought in!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa!  We have twelve boxes over here!

name: Aiden
dialog: That’s a total of twenty-four points, all in all!

name: Aiden
dialog: Not counting Yuri’s extra credit, I guess we have a winner~!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha! Who would’ve thought Team Keitaro would win this one! Congratulations, you two!

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright! Since you guys are the winners, I’ll let you two decide what everyone gets for dinner tonight!

name: Aiden
dialog: It can be anything you want~

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright! Barbecue it is!

name: Aiden
dialog: That’s all for today’s activity! Hope you guys had fun! It was nice to see you all get those muscles up and pumping!

name: Aiden
dialog: Everyone dismissed!

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, it can’t be helped, Yuri. I guess it’s best that our activity has something to do with what the scouts can actually use.

name: Aiden
dialog: Yeah, Yuri! This could still be fun for you~! Imagine all our campers dressed up like tribesmen and castaways!

name: Aiden
dialog: That should be interesting, right?

name: Aiden
dialog: Gotcha, Yoshi!

name: Aiden
dialog: Okay, Yoshi! I’ve gathered everyone now!

name: Aiden
dialog: *sigh* Give it up, Yoshi. Nothing will stop Yuri at this point…

name: Aiden
dialog: Alrighty, everyone’s here!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yoshi, she brought an entire, freakin’ wardrobe of men’s underwear and even set up a stage platform.

name: Aiden
dialog: No one even knows where she got the materials to do it!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hehe… Better prepare buckets for Yuri’s nosebleeds.

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha! Relax, you two. It'll be fun!

name: Aiden
dialog: Keitaro really rocked those trunks! Didn’t know the dude would look so good in one~

name: Aiden
dialog: He looks like he’s having fun at least! That boy really knows how to put on a show!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, yeah! The dude can seriously swim! You didn’t see him at the sportsfest? He’s almost as good as Natsumi!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha! Bet you guys weren’t expecting this!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hahaha! Yuri did say the scoutmasters could join too, right?

name: Aiden
dialog: And, whew~! Is it just me or does it feel really breezy down here~?

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, yeah! They’re definitely “interesting.”

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, bro, you did tell us you ran out of people to team up with. Aren’t you happy you got Yoshi and me to back you up?

name: Aiden
dialog: We can’t blame Yoichi here, Yoshi. Yuri does have a way with saying stuff a little weird…

name: Aiden
dialog: Hahaha! I was thinking the same thing!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hahaha! I guess Gramps’ idea wasn't as boring as I thought.

name: Aiden
dialog: I’m done cooking, Yoshi! I can help you with the--

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh! You’re having Natsumi help instead?

name: Aiden
dialog: I’m done cooking, Yoshi! I can help you with the--

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh! You’re having Natsumi help instead?

name: Aiden
dialog: I’m done cooking, Yoshi! I can help you with the--

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh! You’re having Natsumi help instead?

name: Aiden
dialog: I’m done cooking, Yoshi! I can help you with the--

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh! You’re having Natsumi help instead?

name: Aiden
dialog: Come on, Yoshi. We told the boys they were on vacation, right? Let Natsumi off the hook this time!

name: Aiden
dialog: There you go again, Yoshi. You're always saying Natsumi’s your best scout. Don't you think that might pressure him a little?

name: Aiden
dialog: Now, you’re pressuring Natsumi even more! Hahaha!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, and Natsumi! You can call up your friends for dinner too! The barbecue’s all ready!

name: Aiden
dialog: Did she forget to eat her breakfast again?

name: Aiden
dialog: Yoshi has been working on these extra-special badges just for you guys!

name: Aiden
dialog: Wow, Gramps! That was probably the nicest thing you’ve ever said to Yoshi..

name: Aiden
dialog: Oho, look what we have here~! Yoshi told me you two would be coming by!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yup, that’s my job! I’m going to be testing your physical endurance with some group exercises!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yep! It’s a strength test after all!

name: Aiden
dialog: It’s the perfect ambience to represent the toughness of your physical prowess! …At least that’s what Yoshi said to tell you, haha!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hehehe! You’ll thank me later for your gains after this session, though!

name: Aiden
dialog: Everybody loves a man with a healthy body after all~

name: Aiden
dialog: You never know, maybe you wanna impress someone with a sexy body~

name: Aiden
dialog: Anyway! Since you guys are a pair, we’ll be focusing on group workouts!

name: Aiden
dialog: They’ll require coordination from both of you! Exercises such as sit-ups, wheelbarrow push-ups, partner pistol squats, and more!

name: Aiden
dialog: We’ll start with the three of those! I expect you two to spot each other through all the sets!

name: Aiden
dialog: This is a teamwork activity after all!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hmm… Let’s start with the sit-ups! They’re the simplest!

name: Aiden
dialog: All you need to do is hold your partner’s ankles still while they do their reps and keep count of their total!

name: Aiden
dialog: The two of you should make sure to complete at least fifty each! No time limit!

name: Aiden
dialog: Why don’t you go first then? Keitaro can hold you in place!

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, you did say you were gonna have an easy time with this one. And I agree, considering your build!

name: Aiden
dialog: Think of it as a way to show Keitaro the proper way of doing it too, haha!

name: Aiden
dialog: Make sure you flex hard, alright?

name: Aiden
dialog: And Keitaro, make sure to pay special attention to how he moves his body!

name: Aiden
dialog: Remember our keyword here, ‘SPOT!’

name: Aiden
dialog: And I’ll be taking your camera for a while, okay?

name: Aiden
dialog: Now come on you two, get close!

name: Aiden
dialog: Great! Now let’s get to work!

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright, Keitaro! Now hold that position and keep count!

name: Aiden
dialog: Ready…

name: Aiden
dialog: …Go!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hehehe~ Looks like Keitaro was busy ‘spotting’ something else, eh?

name: Aiden
dialog: Good work, Taiga!

name: Aiden
dialog: Now it’s your turn, Keitaro! You think you can keep up?

name: Aiden
dialog: Wait, are you two okay?

name: Aiden
dialog: How do you both look so red?!

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, you two need to get hydrated before the next exercise!  Here, drink some water!

name: Aiden
dialog: Great workout, you two! Your teamwork was totally spot on!

name: Aiden
dialog: Of course! You two wouldn’t be out of breath like this if you hadn’t worked together!

name: Aiden
dialog: Those exercises make sure that your partner does his share of the work too!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, before we all forget, I was told to give you two this ‘Scoutmaster Seal of Approval’!

name: Aiden
dialog: Here ya go~!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha! That’s a picture of you two doing a workout!

name: Aiden
dialog: Neat, right~? With you two covered in sweat, you can really see the curves and edges of your muscles!

name: Aiden
dialog: Make sure to show this to Yoshi as proof of your hard work!

name: Aiden
dialog: Congrats again, buddies!

name: Aiden
dialog: Now that you’ve passed both tests, you can head back to Yoshi!

name: Aiden
dialog: You just have his ‘mystery challenge’ left and then you’ll get the badge!

name: Aiden
dialog: You’ve beaten my test, but you still have one more to go!

name: Aiden
dialog: You guys can meet up with Yuri in her tent now! She has a special activity planned for you both, hehe~

name: Aiden
dialog: Did she forget to eat her breakfast again?

name: Aiden
dialog: Yoshi has been working on these extra-special badges just for you guys!

name: Aiden
dialog: Wow, Gramps! That probably was the nicest thing you’ve ever said to Yoshi.

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, Yoichi, Keitaro! Hello!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, I’ve actually finished the prep work for that now. I’m just moving these barrels of water over to each of the tents!

name: Aiden
dialog: They’re pretty heavy, but it’s a great workout!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oho~ Working on those muscles, huh little dudes?

name: Aiden
dialog: Why don’t you guys join me? I could use some workout buddies!

name: Aiden
dialog: Awesome~! You two can help me move these barrels!

name: Aiden
dialog: Here, why don’t you try and pick one up, Keitaro?

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright, now make sure to get a firm grip around the base, and then lift with your legs!

name: Aiden
dialog: Wanna explain, Yoichi?

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, yup! It is heavy, but I’ve been building up my muscles for a long time, so I’ve got a lot to lift with!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, it’s alright Keitaro. It was just one! We have extras, anyway.

name: Aiden
dialog: It doesn’t look like lifting them will be a problem for Yoichi, though~ Your muscles are no joke either, bro!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yup! Come on, we can do it together! You and I can both give Keitaro pointers on the way too!

name: Aiden
dialog: Keep going, Keitaro! You’re doing great!

name: Aiden
dialog: Just follow our techniques!

name: Aiden
dialog: Good thing too, ‘cuz there’s a lot more where these came from!

name: Aiden
dialog: That’s the sign of a good workout, Keitaro! You only get that feeling when you’ve really pushed your body!

name: Aiden
dialog: And for that, I want to give you this…

name: Aiden
dialog: Your very own ‘muscle badge’!

name: Aiden
dialog: Why not? You earned it in the best possible way!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, of course! I gotta be sure to make the time to stay in shape!

name: Aiden
dialog: You two should join me more often! I’d love the company!

name: Aiden
dialog: Sure thing, buddy! And don’t worry about keeping up! It takes time to build up muscles, after all.

name: Aiden
dialog: But if you keep at it, you can get as big as Yoichi or even me!

name: Aiden
dialog: Anyway, I bet you boys are hungry after a workout like that!

name: Aiden
dialog: Nope, not tonight! We’re having barbecue for dinner!

name: Aiden
dialog: Not only does it taste good, meat is a source of protein great for building muscles after you work out!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yup! Your body uses the protein in meat to rebuild your torn muscles, making them come back bigger and stronger!

name: Aiden
dialog: Lots of people drink protein shakes, but a good, hearty, meat meal will work too!

name: Aiden
dialog: Anyway, I got everything prepped earlier, but I still need to put it all on the grill to cook.

name: Aiden
dialog: Why don’t you two go and rest those muscles for a little bit? I’ll call you guys when dinner’s ready!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, don’t worry, Yoichi! I’ll be as quick as I can!

name: Aiden
dialog: Thanks for the help, you two! See you soon!

name: Aiden
dialog: Did somebody say my name~?

name: Aiden
dialog: Hehe, yep! Fresh off the grill and ready for eating~ I just need to-

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, it’s alright, Hiro! They’re for eating anyway~

name: Aiden
dialog: Besides, for Yoichi to scarf it down so fast… he must be starving!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oho~ It sounds like we have a little contest brewing here!

name: Aiden
dialog: Would you guys like to settle who the bigger eater is?

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha! What do you say, Yoichi?

name: Aiden
dialog: Well then, let’s make a bet! How about…

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh! I know~ Winner gets to have Keitaro all to himself for the rest of the day!

name: Aiden
dialog: It’s settled then! Let the game begin!

name: Aiden
dialog: *ahem* Ladies and gentlemen, we have here our first annual hotdog eating contest! Hosted by yours truly, Aiden Flynn~

name: Aiden
dialog: It looks like our competition today is gonna be a close match – we have two big eaters here, and both are determined to take home the prize!

name: Aiden
dialog: Let me introduce our first challenger – the Wild Wolf, Yoichi! This man can take as big a sausage as he serves, so you know he’s got a lot of fight in him!

name: Aiden
dialog: And in this corner, we have the Fiery Raccoon, Hiro! He may be small, but he can stick more wieners in his mouth than you’d ever imagine!

name: Aiden
dialog: What? I’m just talking about hotdogs~

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright! On the plates in front of you are 15 hotdogs – the first one to finish all of them will win the grand prize!

name: Aiden
dialog: On your marks…

name: Aiden
dialog: Get set…

name: Aiden
dialog: Go!

name: Aiden
dialog: Wow, Keitaro. Would you look at those two eat! They both sure know their way around a wiener!

name: Aiden
dialog: That’s four hotdogs down each and- DAMN! It looks like Hiro swallowed that one whole! I guess there’s not much for a gag reflex there, huh, Keitaro?

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa! It looks like Yoichi’s fifth hotdog missed and slapped him in the face! Gotta work on your aim, buddy!

name: Aiden
dialog: That’s seven hotdogs each already! I’m amazed at how much these boys can fit in their mouths! What about you, Keitaro?

name: Aiden
dialog: ...And, time! That’s the last hotdog!

name: Aiden
dialog: What’s the verdict, Keitaro?

name: Aiden
dialog: Would you look at that! What a twist ending – it’s a draw!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, no way, bros! You two already look sick. Another hotdog, and you’ll both pop!

name: Aiden
dialog: Anyway, it looks like you’re off the hook, Keitaro~ Neither of them won, so you’re free!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, take your time, you three~ I’m off to serve the rest of these to the other campers!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa, Gramps… I don’t think they’re capable of doing those things…

name: Aiden
dialog: Hiro has been working with me for quite some time now, and I don’t think he would do something like that…

name: Aiden
dialog: You’re the one who’s not listening, Gramps.

name: Aiden
dialog: Be grateful that Yoshi is brave enough to do what you should have done.

name: Aiden
dialog: I can’t believe that you would really risk the safety of two campers just for your own pride…

name: Aiden
dialog: I’m going to help Yoshi. Maybe while we’re gone, you’ll come to your senses.

name: Aiden
dialog: A-Ah! Y-Yes, sir?

name: Aiden
dialog: *sigh*

name: Aiden
dialog: In Yoshi’s defense, I was with him when he was watching the campers.

name: Aiden
dialog: He made sure everyone followed his rules while they were in the water!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yuri’s right! One thing's for sure, though. None of us believe Keitaro did it.

name: Aiden
dialog: I mean, I’ve been hanging out a lot with him! He’s a really nice guy!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yoshi has been working on these extra special badges just for you guys!

name: Aiden
dialog: Wow, Gramps! That was probably the nicest thing you’ve ever said to Yoshi.

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh yeah!

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright, everyone! For those who are interested in earning badges through athletic and physical activities, follow me!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa! You two finished with your activity already?

name: Aiden
dialog: Usually, I'd turn you boys down on that offer, but I really do need a few helping hands with tonight’s dish!

name: Aiden
dialog: Beef and potato stew~! I figured it’d be nice to have something special for tonight!

name: Aiden
dialog: I know, right? Though, I’ve only just started cutting up the meat, and there’s still a lot of the vegetables I haven’t even prepped yet.

name: Aiden
dialog: Hehe, I won’t say no to that~

name: Aiden
dialog: Sure thing, buddy! That’d be really helpful!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hey, are you sure you’re not pushing yourself again with these chores, dude?

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, that doesn’t sound like you at all, Natsumi! But I have kinda noticed you've learned to loosen up a little ever since you and Keitaro started getting close.

name: Aiden
dialog: Of course not!

name: Aiden
dialog: It's just always been kinda strange to me how busy you always are with chores around the camp! You’re basically camp staff by now!

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, that’s because it’s my job! They hired me for that!

name: Aiden
dialog: Your job as a scout is to enjoy your stay here with us~

name: Aiden
dialog: Oho~ So, I’m a ‘model’ now too?

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, if there's one thing I can say for sure, it's that I love seeing people smile when they enjoy what I've worked hard for!

name: Aiden
dialog: Some people might think I’m just doing this because this is my job, but that’s not it at all!

name: Aiden
dialog: I do it because I love doing it! It makes me and the people around me happy!

name: Aiden
dialog: I think that’s the main reason I enjoy my work here so much!

name: Aiden
dialog: It's gotta be why you do it too, right, Natsumi?

name: Aiden
dialog: Ah, great! Natsumi and I just finished chopping up the veggies~

name: Aiden
dialog: You two can set up the fire while I season the meat!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yep! I’ve double-checked, and we’ve got plenty of food and water for one more night, and it’s all been packed and prepped!

name: Aiden
dialog: Me too! I'm surprised you wanted to go somewhere special like this, Gramps! Are you going soft on us?

name: Aiden
dialog: Hahaha! Yes, sir!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hehe, it still takes my breath away every time I see it!

name: Aiden
dialog: Wow, I can’t believe that Taiga really blew up at you like that… I knew the dude was hotheaded, but not that much…

name: Aiden
dialog: *pats Yoshinori on the shoulder*

name: Aiden
dialog: Yeah, I understand, Yoshi… You were just trying to keep a close eye on him.

name: Aiden
dialog: I know you didn’t mean to make him angry like that or whatever…

name: Aiden
dialog: Well... You might have come off a little strong...

name: Aiden
dialog: Don't you think it's about time you tell Gramps about this? I mean... maybe he'll know what to do.

name: Aiden
dialog: Are you sure that's a good idea? You know Gramps doesn't like secrets...

name: Aiden
dialog: Sure, Yoshi. You know I've always got your back. But you should think about this when we get back to camp.

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, sure! I'll grab the stuff we need!

name: Aiden
dialog: Sheesh… Looks dangerous.

name: Aiden
dialog: Hang on, buddy! We’ll come and get you!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hold still, Taiga… I’ll be right there…

name: Aiden
dialog: Yoshi… He was carrying this when I grabbed him…

name: Aiden
dialog: Come on, Yoshi… We should go too…

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, there you are, Keitaro!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yep! Though it’s not working now… I think the water might have broken it.

name: Aiden
dialog: Don’t worry, though! I’m pretty sure I can fix it when we get back to camp, where I keep my tools for gadgets like these….

name: Aiden
dialog: Well… You should be thanking Taiga. He’s the one who got your camera.

name: Aiden
dialog: Yeah…  the craziest thing happened… We actually wanted to get it before it got dark, but when we got up there, we were surprised to find Taiga already trying to retrieve it!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yeah, the little dude sure is brave… He climbed down the side of the falls by himself without a rope to grab it.

name: Aiden
dialog: Thankfully we were able to get him back up safely, but Yoshi scolded him pretty badly for it… He didn’t seem to take it well, either…

name: Aiden
dialog: Things got pretty heated again between them too…

name: Aiden
dialog: Yoshi’s pretty bummed out now too… I think all this Taiga stuff has him down…

name: Aiden
dialog: *sigh* Anyway, I need to get back to Yoshi and calm him down more after that…

name: Aiden
dialog: In the meantime, maybe you should go and do the same for Taiga… I’m sure he could use a buddy right about now.

name: Aiden
dialog: A-Ah! Y-Yes, sir?

name: Aiden
dialog: *sigh*

name: Aiden
dialog: You know you couldn’t have done anything, Yoshi… Gramps has been keeping his eye on you this whole time…

name: Aiden
dialog: Besides, I think we can still stall Gramps for a little while longer. There's a reason I didn't take his tent down just yet…

name: Aiden
dialog: Really? Keitaro didn’t come talk to me at all – I just saw that the tents were down, and reported it to Yoshi myself!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, man… this is getting worse and worse the longer we stay here…

name: Aiden
dialog: I think we really should go now, Yoshi… I’m sure we can look for them when we get back to camp…

name: Aiden
dialog: W-Whoa!!!

name: Aiden
dialog: *sigh* This has turned into a huge mess…

name: Aiden
dialog: You guys should get ready to leave now, too…

name: Aiden
dialog: W-Whoa, Gramps! Easy! This isn’t Yoshi’s fault!

name: Aiden
dialog: You’re the one who’s not listening, Gramps.

name: Aiden
dialog: Be grateful that Yoshi is brave enough to do what you should have done.

name: Aiden
dialog: I can’t believe that you would really risk the safety of two campers just for your own pride…

name: Aiden
dialog: I’m going to help Yoshi. Maybe while we’re gone, you’ll come to your senses.

name: Aiden
dialog: *sigh* I hope those two are okay…

name: Aiden
dialog: Yoshi, look over there!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa! Don’t tell me you guys have been searching for them too?

name: Aiden
