dialog: Don’t worry, Natsumi! I’m just kidding around!

name: Aiden
dialog: Anyway, how do you all plan to sort this mess out?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh. Alright…

name: Aiden
dialog: Hmm… Let me see if I can still remember anything…

name: Aiden
dialog: Hnghh… Five more minutes, Yoshi…

name: Aiden
dialog: S-Seven what…?

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa! We’re already late for today’s breakfast! Gramps is gonna be so mad about this!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hehe, it’s alright.

name: Aiden
dialog: I’ll be off now!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoops!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hey! I worked really ‘hard’ the night before that! It was too hot to wear anything in that tent!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, right! Haha! Now going back to that morning…

name: Aiden
dialog: Hmm… The campfire has already burned out. We’re gonna need some fresh firewood before I can get started with cooking!

name: Aiden
dialog: Sure, Yoshi! Thanks for the help!

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright, I should start prepping the ingredients while I’m at it.

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa, Taiga! Slow down! You’re up early! What’s up?

name: Aiden
dialog: Is there anything I can help you with?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, sorry buddy. I’m still prepping the ingredients!

name: Aiden
dialog: It’ll be done soon, though!

name: Aiden
dialog: Why don't you go ahead and wake everyone up?

name: Aiden
dialog: I should be done by then!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hmm... He seems to be in a hurry.

name: Aiden
dialog: I guess he’s probably really hungry.

name: Aiden
dialog: I should get some breakfast prepped quick!

name: Aiden
dialog: E-Eh…? What’s that…?

name: Aiden
dialog: A bag…?

name: Aiden
dialog: What’s this doing out here…?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, well. I guess I should just give it to Yoshi to find out who it belongs to.

name: Aiden
dialog: Someone must’ve left it outside by mistake.

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh thanks, Yoshi!

name: Aiden
dialog: By the way, Yoshi! Someone left this bag out here…  I’m not sure who it belongs to though!

name: Aiden
dialog: Either way, can you take care of it? I’m sure someone will be looking for it sooner or later.

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright! I’ll just call everyone when it’s time for breakfast!

name: Aiden
dialog: And that’s about it…

name: Aiden
dialog: I really don’t know what happened after that since I was already focused on cooking breakfast.

name: Aiden
dialog: I don’t think so… He wasn’t carrying anything as far as I remember!

name: Aiden
dialog: I’m sorry I couldn’t give you the answers you needed… That’s really everything I can remember…

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright! If you boys don’t mind then, I’ll get back to work!

name: Aiden
dialog: Good luck with your investigation! Seeya!

name: Aiden
dialog: Almost!

name: Aiden
dialog: Did you take care of the bag I gave you?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, no need for that! I already asked Taiga to do that a little while ago!

name: Aiden
dialog: W-What?! So that means nobody’s awake yet?!

name: Aiden
dialog: Jeez, they must be really tired from last night!

name: Aiden
dialog: Well since breakfast is already done... could you go and wake them up for me?

name: Aiden
dialog: Rise and shine, Keitar- Oh! You’re already awake. Just in time for your medicine!

name: Aiden
dialog: It’s alright. You need all the rest you can get.

name: Aiden
dialog: Hmm, your head doesn’t feel as hot, but let’s check your temperature just to be sure!

name: Aiden
dialog: So, how are you feeling today?

name: Aiden
dialog: Well~ That’s good. You gave us quite the scare, passing out from a fever like that!

name: Aiden
dialog: But your friends have been taking good care of you around the clock! Especially Yoichi!

name: Aiden
dialog: It’s crazy – in all my time working here, I’ve never seen Yoichi get close to someone like you!

name: Aiden
dialog: Heck, seeing him be gentle and caring with you like this must mean he cares about you a lot!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, would you look at that! Your fever is all gone!

name: Aiden
dialog: You can stop taking your medicine for now, but you need to eat something! Your body’s gotta repair itself, after all~

name: Aiden
dialog: Breakfast?! Sorry, sport. But it’s already noon! Your friends just finished with their lunch a while ago!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yeah! And after they ate, they started going around asking people what they knew about that picture that made Gramps go nuts!

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, it sounds like Yoichi and your friends really believe you didn't take that picture! So, they must be trying to find some evidence!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hmm… I’m not really sure! They only stopped by the kitchen for a minute, asked me a few questions and then ran off!  I didn’t see where they headed after!

name: Aiden
dialog: Speaking of which! I should head back to the mess hall and check on lunch – feel free to stop by and get something to eat later!

name: Aiden
dialog: It’s about time you start moving around anyway! Seeya!

name: Aiden
dialog: I’m sorry..! It will never happen again!

name: Aiden
dialog: I’m sorry, Yoshi! I’ll be more careful and gentle next time…

name: Aiden
dialog: Ah! Please take it off now so I can wash it immediately!

name: Aiden
dialog: Wahh!! Yuri! Are you alright?! Say something!!

name: Aiden
dialog: O-Okay…

name: Aiden
dialog: *sigh*

name: Aiden
dialog: I hope I don’t get fired for this...

name: Aiden
dialog: W-What? Who?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, why hello, you two! What can I do for ya?

name: Aiden
dialog: E-Eh… Did I say something wrong?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, so it’s your fault, huh?

name: Aiden
dialog: You know what I do to bad boys who mess with my work?

name: Aiden
dialog: *pinches Keitaro’s cheeks*

name: Aiden
dialog: Hahaha! It’s not your fault at all, silly!

name: Aiden
dialog: It’s just an accident! And I should’ve been more careful.

name: Aiden
dialog: Wait a minute… You two don’t look familiar to me at all…

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh! I think I know who you are!

name: Aiden
dialog: YOU MUST BE THE NEWLY HIRED HELPERS!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whew! Finally! I’ve been requesting a helper from Yoshi for quite some time now.

name: Aiden
dialog: You can start by helping me chop some vegetables and fruits for tonight’s menu!

name: Aiden
dialog: What?! Then what are you?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh! Really?

name: Aiden
dialog: Hmm… That’s odd, I thought we weren’t allowed to…

name: Aiden
dialog: N-Nevermind.

name: Aiden
dialog: Anyway, welcome to Camp Buddy!

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, the staff’s and camper’s attire looks the same to me. Whoever designed it is total bonkers.

name: Aiden
dialog: Yep! Aiden Flynn at your service!

name: Aiden
dialog: It’s a pleasure to meet you both, Hiro, Keitaro!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oho~ Sir Aiden, eh?

name: Aiden
dialog: I like the sound of that! Hahaha!

name: Aiden
dialog: You look troubled. Is something… bothering you?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, you mean this?

name: Aiden
dialog: Hey, hey, hey! Don’t judge me! Kitchen work is super hard, you know?

name: Aiden
dialog: Buying the ingredients, doing all the prep work, cooking multiple dishes, then serving it on time.

name: Aiden
dialog: Imagine, doing all that work while you are in a cramped kitchen.

name: Aiden
dialog: You don’t know how hot it gets in there, especially this summer season.

name: Aiden
dialog: You think so? Hehe!

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, if you understand, you must know your way around the kitchen.

name: Aiden
dialog: That’s awesome! Where did you learn how to cook?

name: Aiden
dialog: Yeah, it was me.

name: Aiden
dialog: You’re too kind! I always try my best to serve everyone the best dish I can cook!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh! It all makes sense now!

name: Aiden
dialog: No wonder Yoshi asked me to cook a lot of food yesterday. It was for your welcome party!

name: Aiden
dialog: I’m sorry if I failed to properly greet you two yesterday. After cooking, I was too tired and the next thing I knew I dozed off inside the storage room.

name: Aiden
dialog: Hey, I just had an idea! Hiro, you can come over every morning and help me with cooking if you want! I can teach you some of the recipes I know!

name: Aiden
dialog: And let me have a taste of your cooking as well!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hahaha! You’re lucky to have a friend who knows how to cook, Keitaro!

name: Aiden
dialog: Anyway! I’ve got to clean up that mess! I need to get a mop and a bucket!

name: Aiden
dialog: I’m dead if Yoshi comes back here to see the floor still full of spilled chicken soup.

name: Aiden
dialog: If you guys want to get some lunch, just go over the counter and scoop yourselves anything you want!

name: Aiden
dialog: Don’t mention it! Seeya!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa there, my little chef! What was that all about?!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, I was just cleaning the toilets and fixing that leak in your cabin’s bathroom!

name: Aiden
dialog: Speaking of which, what’s going on here?

name: Aiden
dialog: Your face and that pillow that you’ve murdered say otherwise.

name: Aiden
dialog: I’ve never seen you this angry before! Come on, you can tell big bro what’s going on!

name: Aiden
dialog: Let me guess… This is about Keitaro?

name: Aiden
dialog: Having a lover’s quarrel or something?

name: Aiden
dialog: Hey, hey, hey. Isn’t Natsumi your friend too? You should know that he’s not trying to compete with you for Keitaro’s attention!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa, lil’ bro. Chill. No one’s taking Keitaro away from you, you know that. Maybe you’re just overthinking this?

name: Aiden
dialog: Sheesh, Hiro. That sounds rough…

name: Aiden
dialog: Have you tried telling him how you really feel, though? How much you like him?

name: Aiden
dialog: Keitaro may not know your true feelings. If he doesn’t, then how can he be able to tell the difference between you as a lover and you as his best friend?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh! Oh! What did he say after you said that?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh no… Oh nonononono…

name: Aiden
dialog: Don’t just jump to conclusions! Getting no for an answer and getting no answer at all are two totally different things!

name: Aiden
dialog: T-There’s a perfectly good explanation for that, you see! How do I put this…? Uhh-

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh! I just finished doing some plumbing work!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, would you look at the time! I need to go do some electrical work before today’s activity starts!

name: Aiden
dialog: Seeyouguyslaterbye!

name: Aiden
dialog: I-It’s my pleasure to finally be a scoutmaster to all of you! Please take care of me!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hey, I’m still new to this so take it easy on me, Yoshi!

name: Aiden
dialog: Thanks, Yoshi!

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright, campers! Listen up! We’re going to start off with some warm-ups!

name: Aiden
dialog: We’ll do some stretching, followed by some sit-ups and push-ups.

name: Aiden
dialog: Everyone should pick a partner and pair up for this activity!

name: Aiden
dialog: You have five minutes to pick a partner and then we’ll get started!

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright, that concludes today’s activity!

name: Aiden
dialog: Great workout today, everyone!

name: Aiden
dialog: Why don’t you all head to the mess hall for lunch?

name: Aiden
dialog: I’ve cooked up something healthy and tasty to pair with today’s workout!

name: Aiden
dialog: I’ll see you all there~!

name: Aiden
dialog: Sorry for not telling you about this earlier, little chef. Keitaro didn’t want you to worry about him…

name: Aiden
dialog: Yeah… The little dude hasn’t been feeling well since lunchtime today. And it looks like his fever has gone way up higher too.

name: Aiden
dialog: He’s gonna need a ton of rest to get back to normal from this one.

name: Aiden
dialog: He must’ve caught some virus while he was stuck in the pit the other day… I guess a night outside with no protection will do that to you!

name: Aiden
dialog: Stress probably played a big role in it too…

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa, little bro! Don’t try and blame yourself for this!

name: Aiden
dialog: He probably could’ve avoided this had he just skipped the activity today!

name: Aiden
dialog: Anyways! Make sure he drinks this medicine when he wakes up.

name: Aiden
dialog: And please change out the towel on his forehead every five or ten minutes.

name: Aiden
dialog: I’ll leave him in your hands, but if he looks like he’s getting worse, don’t hesitate to get me or one of the other scoutmasters, alright little bro?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh and Hiro. Take it easy, okay? Keitaro is counting on you the most right now!

name: Aiden
dialog: Are we having a meeting about the camp’s bills again? Because I’ve already told y'all to cut down on the air-conditioning!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa!? Gramps, are you for real?! This is really great news!

name: Aiden
dialog: What made you change your mind? I was so sure that it was time for me to pack my stuff after this term ended!

name: Aiden
dialog: What? And all this time it sounded like this place was the worst-performing one… Just what the heck happened?!

name: Aiden
dialog: Right! And this place isn’t just our dream… It’s our home too!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whew!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa…! W-What are you dudes doing here? It’s late!

name: Aiden
dialog: O-Oh! Right! Well, there are some leftovers in the kitchen I can heat for you guys…!

name: Aiden
dialog: I-I’m good! Just a little worn out from all the chores. You know how hot it gets in that kitchen, after all! H-Hahaha…!!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa!

name: Aiden
dialog: I don’t think you should go in there right now, buddy!

name: Aiden
dialog: It’s uh…

name: Aiden
dialog: …slippery! That’s right! I still need to clean up the floor! H-Hahaha!!

name: Aiden
dialog: W-What? Of course not! Y-You poor dudes must be really hungry!

name: Aiden
dialog: Let me go get your food real quick! Stay right here and don’t follow me, got it?!

name: Aiden
dialog: Here ya go, guys! I’ve packed it up for you so you could eat back in your cabin!

name: Aiden
dialog: Now, go, go! It’s way late and I’ve gotta close the mess hall!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whew... That was freaking close…

name: Aiden
dialog: Yup! Coast is clear!

name: Aiden
dialog: Come on, Yoshi! It’s fun and you know it!

name: Aiden
dialog: Now where were we?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, hey there! What are you guys up to?

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, that’s really nice, you guys! But I think Hiro and I got this.

name: Aiden
dialog: Hmm... And I guess I’ve still got dinner to prep too!

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright, boys. I'll take you up on your offer!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, you guys can take care of the dishes, while I do some prepwork for tonight’s dinner~!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, just when I thought you were learning to relax, you’re running around doing everybody's chores again, Natsumi!

name: Aiden
dialog: Wow, Keitaro! Who'd have known? Guess you guys really are rubbing off on each other, huh?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oho~ So, that's what's been goin’ on between you two, eh~? No wonder you two are always stickin’ around each other.

name: Aiden
dialog: I always knew something clicked between you two. But then again, it's pretty normal to do that kind of stuff, anyway.

name: Aiden
dialog: And from the looks of it, I bet Natsumi here is the one who’s always in charge, if you know what I mean~!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa there! Why am I in the hot seat now? That kind of topic is off limits!

name: Aiden
dialog: Don’t be shy, Keitaro! We’re just having some fun, man-to-man talk!

name: Aiden
dialog: Plus, doing stuff like that can’t really be helped, haha!

name: Aiden
dialog: Natsumi's totally the perfect, nice guy type with a jock bod, and Keitaro's our adorable crowdpleaser, after all.

name: Aiden
dialog: You guys are a total match!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, yeah! I even heard you convinced Gramps and Yoshi into letting Taiga stay when he was gonna get kicked out last night.

name: Aiden
dialog: Eh? Did I say something wrong?

name: Aiden
dialog: Huh? Shouldn’t you be celebrating now that you’re gonna be staying here at camp with us? Your friends even proved Taiga was the one who framed you!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa. First off, I think you've done a lot for him already, Keitaro.

name: Aiden
dialog: I mean… you just got out of trouble yourself, right?

name: Aiden
dialog: Second, Taiga should spend some time thinking about what he’s done too.

name: Aiden
dialog: You know how that guy can be. If anyone tried to talk to him right now, he’d be too stubborn to admit anything and just lash out.

name: Aiden
dialog: But even if that’s the case, it doesn’t mean the guy won’t learn. I bet he just needs some more time and space to let things settle down right now.

name: Aiden
dialog: And then the last thing… you should learn to give yourself a break from all this too!

name: Aiden
dialog: You’ve done hella great already, Keitaro~! Pat yourself on the back and take some time to let things go back to normal!

name: Aiden
dialog: No problem, dude! I get that you’re the type of guy who just cares a lot about the people around you.

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, how’d our topic even get there? One minute we’re talking about getting it on, and the next we’re suddenly all serious and stuff!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hahaha! I guess my clumsy side’s rubbed off on Hiro a lot too!

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright, boys! I’m counting on you! I’ll just be here finishing my prepwork!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, well you two can go ahead! Hiro and I can take it from here.

name: Aiden
dialog: Oho~ Showering together now, eh?

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, thanks for all the help with the prepwork and cleanup, Keitaro and Natsumi!

name: Aiden
dialog: What’s up, Gramps? Are we in trouble?

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa!? Gramps, are you for real?! This is really great news!

name: Aiden
dialog: What made you change your mind? I was so sure that it was time for me to pack my stuff after this term ends!

name: Aiden
dialog: What? And all this time it sounded like this place was the worst-performing one… Just what the heck happened?!

name: Aiden
dialog: Right! And this place isn’t just our dream… It’s our home too!

name: Aiden
dialog: Can’t we cut down on the bills or something? Maybe we can save some money on water or power!

name: Aiden
dialog: And with fewer enrollees… we won’t even have the budget to pay our bills… We’ll run out of funds eventually and…

name: Aiden
dialog: Isn’t there anything we can do then? Don’t you have investor friends, Gramps?!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yeah..! If we don’t take this chance, we’ll be forced to close down anyway! So why not go all out now?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, and I could make some baked goods to sell! Everybody loves a good cookie or cupcake~

name: Aiden
dialog: What better way to wash out the bad taste of our old reputation than with sweets?

name: Aiden
dialog: Of course, Gramps! We’re your loyal scoutmasters, here to support you!

name: Aiden
dialog: W-Whoa!

name: Aiden
dialog: Meanwhile, I'll be hosting a bake sale. Anyone who's got skills in the kitchen can come see me!

name: Aiden
dialog: …And another batch done!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, hey you two, I didn’t realize you were here! Looks like you needed help with those boxes, huh little chef?

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, perfect timing! These cookies are our samples, made from a recipe that Hiro got from his mom!

name: Aiden
dialog: You can tell us anything that we need to improve!

name: Aiden
dialog: Here, come get a cookie!

name: Aiden
dialog: This recipe is pretty polished anyway, Hiro. I don’t think it could get any better than it is.

name: Aiden
dialog: We plan to pack half a dozen of these in each box and sell them like that.

name: Aiden
dialog: Way to use your noggin, Hiro! I’m sure the colorful, flavored cookies will be a huge hit!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, you sure got the little dude excited.

name: Aiden
dialog: And I didn’t know you gave them a cookie during yesterday’s activity, Taiga! Looks like you’re getting along with everyone now, eh?

name: Aiden
dialog: Even Yoshi told me that you two finally made up! Look at you being so mature! Hahaha!

name: Aiden
dialog: Haha, good! Just keep spreading positivity!

name: Aiden
dialog: Anyway, I better get started whipping up the different icing flavors. Hiro is so quick in the kitchen, it’s hard to keep up!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh? What’s up?

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh… well, I lent it to Yoshi yesterday…

name: Aiden
dialog: Aaaaand, I’m not sure if you boys would wanna borrow it… It was kinda full of videos the last time I checked.

name: Aiden
dialog: Trust me, you don’t wanna know.

name: Aiden
dialog: Anyway, I’m sure he’s done using it by now, so go ahead and ask him! Let him know I gave you guys permission to use it!

name: Aiden
dialog: You should see him with Yoichi somewhere around the camp fence!

name: Aiden
dialog: Thanks for the sales tips too! Seeya around!

name: Aiden
dialog: I-It’s my pleasure to finally be a scoutmaster to all of you! Please take care of me!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hey, I’m still new to this, so take it easy on me, Yoshi!

name: Aiden
dialog: Thanks, Yoshi!

name: Aiden
dialog: Alright, campers! Like Yoshi said, we’re gonna have our weekly physical activity!

name: Aiden
dialog: Our obstacle course has a lot of things to offer that will get your blood pumping.

name: Aiden
dialog: You can choose any activity you like as long as you finish the quota I prepared for each sport activity!

name: Aiden
dialog: You can do this alone or with a friend. Just approach me for any details you might need, alright?

name: Aiden
dialog: But before anything else, I want you guys to change into something appropriate for your activity.

name: Aiden
dialog: We’ve prepared some P.E. uniforms in the locker rooms for you to change into! If you’d rather participate in one of the swimming activities, make sure to grab your suit!

name: Aiden
dialog: That will be all!

name: Aiden
dialog: Hey Gramps! We’re here for the meeti-

name: Aiden
dialog: WHOA!

name: Aiden
dialog: Congrats, Yoshi! Looks like all your hard work finally paid off, huh?

name: Aiden
dialog: Sup, Gramps? Wanna join the group hug?

name: Aiden
dialog: What? And all this time it sounded like this place was the worst-performing one… Just what the heck happened?!

name: Aiden
dialog: Right! And this place isn’t just our dream… It’s our home too!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yoshi! What’s taking you so long? I’m ready!

name: Aiden
dialog: Yeah, Keitaro! What’s wrong with that?

name: Aiden
dialog: Yup! Hahaha!

name: Aiden
dialog: I didn’t know you two were active in that kind of stuff! Well, Yoichi, yeah, but Keitaro…

name: Aiden
dialog: Hahaha!!!

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, I think you guys came at just the right time! I just finished making some protein shakes~!

name: Aiden
dialog: Sure thing, buddy!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoa, whoa! Don’t drink it all…! That’s-

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, it does have a bunch of vitamins in it! It’s my post-workout drink!

name: Aiden
dialog: Well, it helps me rebuild my muscles after a long day of working out!

name: Aiden
dialog: And I should say, you’re pretty ripped too, buddy! Seeing you maintain your shape, I bet you’re trying to impress someone, huh?

name: Aiden
dialog: You’re pretty lucky to have a guy with such a good body! It really spices things up in bed~!

name: Aiden
dialog: Don’t be shy, Keitaro! Doing those kinds of things is normal!

name: Aiden
dialog: Well… I wouldn’t say I’m not~

name: Aiden
dialog: That’s confidential, bro~!

name: Aiden
dialog: Anyway, Yoichi! Are you feeling a little hotter now?

name: Aiden
dialog: Well… I kinda put something in that drink you gulped down a while ago…

name: Aiden
dialog: It's a little formula I brewed up to increase my libido, if you know what I mean.

name: Aiden
dialog: Hey, hey, hey! Not my fault that you drank all of that! You were just supposed to take a sip of it, after all!

name: Aiden
dialog: And I wouldn’t say it’s poison either! Just a very potent stimulant!

name: Aiden
dialog: Whoops! Speaking of which, looks like it’s kicking in now~

name: Aiden
dialog: Uh-oh! I almost forgot, Yoshi is waiting for me outside! See you guys tomorrow~!

name: Aiden
dialog: You can do it, Keitaro! Good luck~!

name: Aiden
dialog: Oh, there you are, buddy!

name: Aiden
dialog: I was looking for you back at the cabin! I didn’t expect to see you here up and well already!

name: Aiden
dialog: Aaah! That’s good to hear!  Why isn’t he with you, though?

name: Aiden
dialog: Uh-oh! Don’t tell me you two are still fighting?!

name: Aiden
dialog: Well… About that… I kinda came across Hiro yesterday while he was upset.

name: Aiden
dialog: Poor guy was so down in the dumps yesterday… He felt really unappreciated and ignored.

name: Aiden
dialog: Yeah! You and Natsumi actually cut us off mid-conversation, if you remember.

name: Aiden
dialog: But that’s over now, right? I’m glad to hear that you two have finally made up!

name: Aiden
dialog: All Hiro ever does is talk about you, you know! He’s obviously into you, buddy!

name: Aiden
dialog: I get why he’d ask you that. It’s frustrating to see you two holding back your feelings for each other like this.

name: Aiden
dialog: You should both just be honest with each other.

name: Aiden
dialog: Then tell me, Keitaro. What’s holding you back from telling Hiro how you feel?

name: Aiden
dialog: *pats Keitaro’s shoulder*

name: Aiden
dialog: I understand, buddy.

name: Aiden
dialog: Somehow, I knew this was why. And I totally get it too!

name: Aiden

name: Goro
dialog: Just drop by if you have any further inquiries. You are all dismissed.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* That Aiden…

name: Goro
dialog: Yoshinori, before you leave, a word? If I may?

name: Goro
dialog: You still seem just as dazed as you were at the beach.

name: Goro
dialog: I can’t ignore when one of my scoutmasters is feeling distressed. Tell me what’s on your mind.

name: Goro
dialog: Does it have something to do with that camera incident involving Mr. Nagame and Mr. Akatora?

name: Goro
dialog: Rumors spread quickly around the camp, Yoshinori. I overheard some of the scouts discussing it this morning.

name: Goro
dialog: And Aiden warned me about it as well.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* You still haven’t changed from before. You know all too well that you shouldn’t be burdening yourself with things you can’t handle on your own.

name: Goro
dialog: Anyway, I promised Aiden and Yuri to handle this calmly, unlike before.

name: Goro
dialog: But you should be aware of the risk that was involved in that scenario. Luckily, nobody got hurt seriously, so we can just let bygones be bygones.

name: Goro
dialog: But I am more concerned about your relationship with your scouts… specifically Mr. Akatora.

name: Goro
dialog: I thought things were going smoothly with him? How did the situation get this carried away?

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… Here’s a word of advice, Yoshinori. Take it from someone who has gone through the same thing and handled different kinds of scouts in the past.

name: Goro
dialog: Ask yourself… Don’t you think that having such a stigma of him is what makes him feel isolated from everyone else?

name: Goro
dialog: Try to put yourself in his shoes and view the world from his eyes, because that’s the only way you’ll know where his emotions and actions are coming from.

name: Goro
dialog: Mr. Akatora has always been a troubled scout, struggling to get along with others.

name: Goro
dialog: He misbehaves because his peers have decided that he is nothing more than a bully, and his counselors believe that he is difficult to handle, instead of trying to see past his problems.

name: Goro
dialog: Then maybe he doesn’t need any help.

name: Goro
dialog: I was cautious of Mr. Akatora after the incident with Mr. Nagame at the sportsfest, but to my surprise, he has slowly but surely been improving… Well, until yesterday…

name: Goro
dialog: What caused such hostility between the two of you?

name: Goro
dialog: And therefore, you made assumptions about the two scouts, leading yourself to believe that their relationship was bad.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* I can't blame you, even I made that mistake the first time I met them when I came back this term.

name: Goro
dialog: The only reason I'd think Mr. Akatora would push you away is because you might be forcing him to conform to your standards and turn him into what you perceive as the ideal scout.

name: Goro
dialog: I don't mean to be harsh or judgmental about the way you handle your scouts, but from how you were the past few days, it’s obvious you needed some advice.

name: Goro
dialog: Although, I should have stepped in and helped long before now instead of just observing.

name: Goro
dialog: In any case, I know your intentions are good… But I want you and Mr. Akatora to resolve your issues with each other.

name: Goro
dialog: The two of you need to come to an understanding, and as his scoutmaster and an authority figure, you are expected to be more patient and understanding with him.

name: Goro
dialog: Is that clear?

name: Goro
dialog: Good.

name: Goro
dialog: You don’t need to do everything alone, Yoshinori. I’m here to help you.

name: Goro
dialog: If you’re tired, you can go back.

name: Goro
dialog: Why would you boys go to these lengths to look for those troublemakers?

name: Goro
dialog: Not a troublemaker, you say?! Then explain that picture he took! None of this would have even happened if he had shown the slightest bit of moral restraint.

name: Goro
dialog: Even if he was innocent, he didn’t have to run away with that other boy and the dog!

name: Goro
dialog: And don’t get me started on him! The disrespect he showed me…

name: Goro
dialog: Hmph. We are indeed wasting our time just standing here talking. Let's move.

name: Goro
dialog: Yes, we are. This is a grave situation; we can’t afford to risk anyone’s safety.

name: Goro
dialog: And it is only natural that I assist with the search, as I am partly responsible for this.

name: Goro
dialog: What’s the progress of your pursuit?

name: Goro
dialog: While our team has searched all around the outskirts of Camp Buddy and the nearby forest.

name: Goro
dialog: The results are the same, unfortunately.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* Do you realize what you’ve done, boy?

name: Goro
dialog: All of us were up the entire night looking for you two! You had the whole camp worried!

name: Goro
dialog: What were you thinking, spending the night outside like this, without so much as a whisper to let us know?!

name: Goro
dialog: What?! A camper got sick because of you! How can you say that you had everything under control!?

name: Goro
dialog: Well?! Do you have anything to say for yourself?!

name: Goro
dialog: Fine. Both of you will report to my office immediately when we get back.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh*

name: Goro
dialog: Since it seems you don’t understand how serious the situation is, let me point this out again, boy.

name: Goro
dialog: You made fun of your supervisors with that photograph, and you kept a dangerous animal near the campsite.

name: Goro
dialog: This led to said animal almost attacking me! Then you ran away and brought one of your fellow scouts into your delinquency.

name: Goro
dialog: You obviously haven’t learned a thing! You refuse to acknowledge any figure of authority, even now!

name: Goro
dialog: I want you to take responsibility for your actions!

name: Goro
dialog: And to think that, after all of this, you still have the nerve to talk back to me! I haven’t heard you sincerely apologize even once!

name: Goro
dialog: I’m trying to be reasonable with you, boy, but you’re severely testing my patience.

name: Goro
dialog: Regardless of your reasoning, your behavior is unacceptable!

name: Goro
dialog: You’re leaving me no choice but to expel you and your friend from this camp.

name: Goro
dialog: No need.

name: Goro
dialog: Keep a close eye on that boy. I cannot afford him doing anything reckless again.

name: Goro
dialog: What do you want, Yoshinori…?

name: Goro
dialog: What?! You can’t be serious… Didn’t you see how he spoke to me earlier?!

name: Goro
dialog: It was of the utmost insubordination! That’s not to mention the mischief he pulled back at the beach!

name: Goro
dialog: What did you just say?!

name: Goro
dialog: Just a few hours ago you were silent, and now you’re trying to take the blame for him? What’s gotten into you?!

name: Goro
dialog: A man has his limits, Yoshinori. This is not some adoption agency. You can’t just accept his behavior because he has nowhere else to go!

name: Goro
dialog: Why are you letting him off the hook like that?! He deserves to be disciplined!

name: Goro
dialog: I haven’t heard you reprimand him even once!

name: Goro
dialog: I made you a scoutmaster so that you could be like me! Not so that you could go soft and forget what it means to discipline ill-mannered scouts!

name: Goro
dialog: Don’t you raise your voice at me!

name: Goro
dialog: Y-Yuri, w-when did you…?

name: Goro
dialog: I’ve tried to be patient with them, Yuri!

name: Goro
dialog: I just don’t understand why Yoshinori defends that boy so much!

name: Goro
dialog: I’m well aware of Yoshinori’s intentions with that boy… But we can’t just allow him to break the rules!

name: Goro
dialog: *mumbles*

name: Goro
dialog: That was such a long time ago… I’m not getting any younger, Yuri.

name: Goro
dialog: Very well. I’ll try and speak with Mr. Yukimura myself.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* Thank you, dear.

name: Goro
dialog: Ahem.

name: Goro
dialog: Settle down. I’m not here to argue with you or take your dog away.

name: Goro
dialog: Was that all true? What you said a while ago?

name: Goro
dialog: J-Just answer my question, boy.

name: Goro
dialog: Ugh… You’re giving me a headache…

name: Goro
dialog: I guess there’s no point asking you whether what you said before was true or not.

name: Goro
dialog: I don’t see any reason why you would lie about that to your dog, anyway.

name: Goro
dialog: I’m serious, boy. I’m already losing my patience with you again.

name: Goro
dialog: Cooperate with me, and I’ll be on my way.

name: Goro
dialog: Yoshinori mentioned that he was the one responsible for letting you keep that animal.

name: Goro
dialog: He also explained how much that dog means to you. It explains why you ran off looking for her at the beach like you did.

name: Goro
dialog: And judging from what I just heard, your actions back at the beach were just to cover for your friend.

name: Goro
dialog: It could’ve been resolved much earlier if you had just kept your aggressive attitude under control!

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh*

name: Goro
dialog: I have to accept that your rash actions were your own form of altruism.

name: Goro
dialog: N-Nevermind...

name: Goro
dialog: In short, I’m reconsidering your expulsion.

name: Goro
dialog: Also, I’m officially allowing you to keep your dog here under the condition that she stays just outside of camp grounds.

name: Goro
dialog: I do need you to give me your word that she will not be a danger to your fellow campers and that you will keep her under control at all times.

name: Goro
dialog: If you don’t meet these conditions, I’ll have no choice but to relocate her to a place where she won’t be a threat to anyone.

name: Goro
dialog: That’s enough of a compromise for you, isn’t it?

name: Goro
dialog: Do you accept these terms or not?

name: Goro
dialog: Good.

name: Goro
dialog: Don’t push your luck, boy. Just because I can excuse your misbehavior does not mean that I will overlook your friend’s actions as well.

name: Goro
dialog: Based on everything that's happened, my judgment remains the same. None of this would've happened if it weren't for that boy's photograph.

name: Goro
dialog: With that being said, I expect you to stand aside and allow me to expel Mr. Nagame.

name: Goro
dialog: With that being said, I expect you to stand aside and allow me to expel Mr. Nagame.{fast}

name: Goro
dialog: That boy himself confessed that he was responsible for the picture. Isn’t that enough validation?

name: Goro
dialog: That boy himself confessed that he was responsible for the picture. Isn’t that enough validation?

name: Goro
dialog: Merely telling me that your friend didn’t do it doesn’t prove anything either.

name: Goro
dialog: If you believe you have some evidence to prove that Mr. Nagame didn’t take that photograph, then you are welcome to show me.

name: Goro
dialog: But if you fail to do so, my decision will remain as is.

name: Goro
dialog: You should be thankful to your scoutmaster for changing my mind. If it weren’t for him, I wouldn’t even be here to talk about any of this with you.

name: Goro
dialog: Our conversation here is done.

name: Goro
dialog: Come in.

name: Goro
dialog: It doesn’t matter.

name: Goro
dialog: I fully understand why you responded so defensively a while ago, which leads me to why I’ve asked for you here.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ve just recently tried to see things from a different perspective. It’s why I took matters into my own hands and spoke with Mr. Yukimura himself.

name: Goro
dialog: He didn’t. In fact, I was able to see his true intentions myself with regards to the incident yesterday.

name: Goro
dialog: Let’s just say I heard enough to lift his expulsion, and allowed him to keep his dog under certain conditions as well.

name: Goro
dialog: As the head of the camp, I should have taken the time to understand the situation better. To listen to the campers and you.

name: Goro
dialog: So, I wanted to apologize for my presumption about you and Mr. Yukimura.

name: Goro
dialog: Which leads me to my other concern.

name: Goro
dialog: *hands over a paper to Yoshinori*

name: Goro
dialog: This is not for Mr. Yukimura, but rather for Mr. Nagame.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ve thought about this carefully, and I’ve reached the conclusion that this entire mess has branched out and escalated due to the photo that he took.

name: Goro
dialog: It’s only fair that we punish the one who started this whole mess.

name: Goro
dialog: The boy already confessed back at the beach, and I’ve already compromised with Mr. Yukimura enough.

name: Goro
dialog: Unless it’s proven that Mr. Nagame didn’t take the photo then, he will be expelled.

name: Goro
dialog: Is that clear?

name: Goro
dialog: Good. I want this form filed and on my desk tomorrow.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ll take your advice and allow him to recover first before breaking the news to him.

name: Goro
dialog: That will be all. You are dismissed.

name: Goro
dialog: Hey, I’m not that old…

name: Goro
dialog: What brings you here, Yoshinori?

name: Goro
dialog: You’re the scoutmaster here, are you not? You can take care of this matter on your own.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* Would you all stop using the word ‘old’ already?

name: Goro
dialog: What's the meaning of this? Did I not make it clear that no gadgets are allowed on this trip?

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… As long as it doesn’t become a distraction, then I guess it’s alright.

name: Goro
dialog: You don’t have to confess anything. I’ve already heard enough.

name: Goro
dialog: Enough! I don’t want to hear another word from you.

name: Goro
dialog: In my office.

name: Goro
dialog: NOW!!!

name: Goro
dialog: Let me deal with him from here, Mr. Nagame.

name: Goro
dialog: In the meantime, I'd like all of you to go back to your cabin.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* Yoshinori was right all along…

name: Goro
dialog: That must be them. Come in.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ve been speaking to Mr. Akatora here, and it’s clear to me now that you didn’t take the photo we accused you of taking.

name: Goro
dialog: You shouldn’t have taken the punishment onto yourself for everyone else, though.

name: Goro
dialog: I didn’t bring you here to give you a lecture. I want to let you know that my decision to expel you has been lifted.

name: Goro
dialog: I will instead be expelling Mr. Akatora. His reckless behavior this year, as well as his record from last year, proves that he’s unfit to be a camper here.

name: Goro
dialog: That’s right. He has already caused so much trouble at this camp this year. If he is allowed to stay here, he will only disrupt the camp further.

name: Goro
dialog: What are you saying, boy?

name: Goro
dialog: You do realize that if it weren’t for what he did, you wouldn’t have faced expulsion.

name: Goro
dialog: Why do you possibly think that he shouldn’t be expelled?

name: Goro
dialog: Do you seriously want this boy to stay here after all he’s done? He has caused so much trouble for you and everyone else.

name: Goro
dialog: You surprise me, Mr. Nagame. I wouldn’t expect you to defend and forgive this boy after everything he’s done to you.

name: Goro
dialog: Perhaps I was wrong about you, after all.

name: Goro
dialog: You really are a shining example of what a scout should be.

name: Goro
dialog: The same goes for you, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: This boy is proof that you have guided your scouts well, and that at least some of them have learned what it means to be a good camper.

name: Goro
dialog: I will respect both of your wishes, as I believe it’s only fitting that the one most affected by his mischief should decide his punishment.

name: Goro
dialog: Let me be clear, though - this is your last chance, Mr. Akatora.

name: Goro
dialog: If you wish to stay in this camp, I insist you apologize to Mr. Nagame right here.

name: Goro
dialog: Well? What will it be, boy?

name: Goro
dialog: Now, go back to your cabin and think about what you’ve done. Be thankful that Mr. Nagame here is kind enough to give you another chance.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ll be here watching you to make sure you don’t stir up any more trouble. You’re dismissed.

name: Goro
dialog: My previous scouts would have thought about nothing but revenge for the actions Mr. Akatora committed against you.

name: Goro
dialog: And the dedication your friends showed in standing up for you and never giving into pressure is admirable.

name: Goro
dialog: It’s been a very long time since we’ve seen something like that in this camp...

name: Goro
dialog: You truly remind me of how things used to be when I was still a scoutmaster myself.

name: Goro
dialog: I now see what Yoshinori here sees in you. He made the right decision to take you in.

name: Goro
dialog: Thank you for behaving so responsibly. You have my formal apology for the accusation I made against you and all the trouble that came with it.

name: Goro
dialog: In addition, be sure to thank your friends. If they hadn't pursued this, I would have never known what really happened.

name: Goro
dialog: Their dedication to you as their friend is quite commendable.

dialog: Then tell me… Just how do you plan to carry out this fundraising campaign?

name: Goro
dialog: Y-You’ve got to be kidding me! Should we really stoop so low?! It’s humiliating to go door to door just to beg!

name: Goro
dialog: But hiring someone to produce new flyers… that would be even more expensive! We’d just be sinking money into something without a guaranteed pay-off…

name: Goro
dialog: I’m still not sure…

name: Goro
dialog: All of these are time-consuming tasks, and I don’t know if I can manage to organize them all alone…

name: Goro
dialog: Y-Yuri-!

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem*

name: Goro
dialog: I still don’t know how you’ll be managing all these different activities… Do we even have enough manpower for all of them?

name: Goro
dialog: Perhaps we should consider taking in some volunteers.

name: Goro
dialog: Alright, I’ll be focusing on scouting potential investors while you’re all busy!

name: Goro
dialog: Alright, Yoshinori. I’m counting on you. You’re dismissed!

name: Goro
dialog: You’ve really grown to be such a dependable leader, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: …And lastly, the permits that need to be brought to city hall have already been prepared.

name: Goro
dialog: The only thing I need to do is ask the mayor to sign them.

name: Goro
dialog: Either way, that should give us what we need to go around town posting posters and handing out flyers.

name: Goro
dialog: *ahem* Anyway, I will be travelling to town today, and—

name: Goro
dialog: Of course. What do you need?

name: Goro
dialog: Alright, I’ll be sure to pick some up while I’m out.

name: Goro
dialog: I thought you already got groceries yesterday?

name: Goro
dialog: Alright, fine. What do you need?

name: Goro
dialog: This is quite the list…

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* Fine.

name: Goro
dialog: I’m going all out anyway. Might as well, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: Understood. Anything else?

name: Goro
dialog: It's fine, you’re busy too. Just stay on your schedule and continue with your tasks.

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem* if that’s all, then I think it's best if I head off now.

name: Goro
dialog: All of you should go ahead and continue with your designated activities.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* I probably should’ve let Yoshinori join me. This list is long.

name: Goro
dialog: Ah, good morning, Mr. Nagame, Mr. Akatora. Are you two heading for your activity now?

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… I see.

name: Goro
dialog: Well, I suppose you two are free and have no obligations today…

name: Goro
dialog: I do have some errands to run, would you boys care to help me out then?

name: Goro
dialog: Well, I need to visit city hall to collect some permits, and make a trip to the grocery store to pick up some supplies for your scoutmasters.

name: Goro
dialog: You two can help me finish my shopping faster so I can attend my other appointments in time.

name: Goro
dialog: I assume you two are both ready too, so let’s get going?

name: Goro
dialog: Excellent, now follow me.

name: Goro
dialog: You boys coming?

name: Goro
dialog: Yes. That's why I asked you boys to join me.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* I’ve explained to your scoutmasters multiple times about being prepared and planning ahead, but sometimes the lessons don’t sink in.

name: Goro
dialog: Oh well, lucky for them, the grocery store is along the way to city hall…

name: Goro
dialog: As long as these errands don’t make me late for my meeting, then it’s fine.

name: Goro
dialog: Oh, the first reason is simple—we are applying for a permit to post information about the camp around town, as well as for door-to-door solicitation.

name: Goro
dialog: Of course! If you don’t require permits, then just anyone can go around town posting whatever they want, or harassing people in their homes.

name: Goro
dialog: We don’t want Camp Buddy to give that impression to our potential recruits.

name: Goro
dialog: Well, you’re correct that it is a time-consuming task, but it’s an important one. And don’t underestimate the power of doing something in person.

name: Goro
dialog: People respect you much more when you’re willing to meet them face to face.

name: Goro
dialog: Besides, I need the signature of the mayor anyway, and while I’m meeting him I want to discuss a sponsorship from the city.

name: Goro
dialog: There’s no guarantee, but I think it's worth a try. People might surprise you!

name: Goro
dialog: Besides, this is the least I can do—your scoutmasters are doing an excellent job of making sure you all have a great experience at Camp Buddy.

name: Goro
dialog: I don’t want to interrupt their progress, so it’s best that I handle these other responsibilities.

name: Goro
dialog: It’s not that I don’t want to, I just think that your scoutmasters can do a better job interacting with you, the newer generation, than I ever could.

name: Goro
dialog: I’m pretty sure most of the scouts still find me intimidating, so I prefer to watch over behind the scenes and provide guidance as needed.

name: Goro
dialog: And besides, the role of president has many obligations to fill anyway!

name: Goro
dialog: Heh, you have a way with words, Mr. Nagame. I can definitely see now what Yoshinori saw in you.

name: Goro
dialog: That’s true, Mr. Akatora. I’m well aware of your situation and developments this term. You had a rough start, but I’m glad to see that things have worked out for you.

name: Goro
dialog: Everyone has low points in life, what’s important is how you grow out of them. It’s part of the journey to becoming a better person.

name: Goro
dialog: I know Mr. Nagame and Yoshinori had some contribution to your change, but believe it or not, it’s always been in your own hands. And other people can only guide you to it.

name: Goro
dialog: If you don’t mind, I’d like to know more details as to how everything unfolded.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ve only been able to judge your situation based on Yoshinori’s account and my own observations. I would very much like to hear your side.

name: Goro
dialog: Most definitely. Don’t worry, we have time. It’s still quite a way ahead.

name: Goro
dialog: Alright, my meeting is soon, and I need us to get through this quickly.

name: Goro
dialog: We have quite a few items on the list, so let’s split up and make this a quick trip.

name: Goro
dialog: Are you sure? They’ll be heavy.

name: Goro
dialog: Alright. Take a cart with you and call me if you need any help.

name: Goro
dialog: Mr. Akatora, you go to the hardware department and get the lube for the cart.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ll go and collect the ink and paper. We’ll meet at the cash register in fifteen minutes.

name: Goro
dialog: Is that clear?

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… that salesperson said the ink should be right here… next to the spray paints…

name: Goro
dialog: Hey! What do you think you’re doing?

name: Goro
dialog: You can't be spraying that indoors! And are you going to pay for it?

name: Goro
dialog: That's not an excuse to open sealed goods and vandalize the property!

name: Goro
dialog: The cans have a color code on them.

name: Goro
dialog: G-Gah!

name: Goro
dialog: H-Hey…!

name: Goro
dialog: G-Give me that! You’re getting paint everywhere!

name: Goro
dialog: Don’t tell me you weren’t going to pay for those…

name: Goro
dialog: Hold it right there.

name: Goro
dialog: If you’re planning to leave this mess behind, AND not pay for those other cans in your jacket, you’re going to get in a lot of trouble.

name: Goro
dialog: This place has surveillance. I’m sure a clumsy shoplifter like you won’t get away.

name: Goro
dialog: A piece? Is that some kind of graffiti?

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* You’re not making this any easier for yourself, boy.

name: Goro
dialog: Do you realize that painting property without permission is considered vandalism, which is a punishable crime?

name: Goro
dialog: Art…? Passion?

name: Goro
dialog: It still doesn’t excuse you for trying to steal. If I hadn’t caught you, you’d find yourself behind bars.

name: Goro
dialog: Did you just say camping?

name: Goro
dialog: I see. That is very interesting.

name: Goro
dialog: Here’s some cash. Take the spray paints and pay for them.

name: Goro
dialog: I have a daughter that has the same passion for art. And if she were here, she would’ve scolded me for negatively judging your medium.

name: Goro
dialog: And I think you are working on a good cause.

name: Goro
dialog: You did say you were painting on an abandoned building. I'm sure painting a mural there won't cause trouble.

name: Goro
dialog: Besides, I’m quite fond of fine art and literature as well.

name: Goro
dialog: Here’s my business card.

name: Goro
dialog: If you are interested, we'd love to have a creative scout join next year. Your artistic talents would be welcomed.

name: Goro
dialog: It's alright. I can tell from the way you're speaking that your passion is genuine.

name: Goro
dialog: But you should know that stealing is unforgivable!  Don't ever attempt to do it again.

name: Goro
dialog: Good.

name: Goro
dialog: I-I'm glad to have helped. Now run along.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* I can’t believe I let myself get distracted by that. I should get the ink and paper now.

name: Goro
dialog: W-What the— Are you okay…?

name: Goro
dialog: Sorry to interrupt but we are kind of in a hurry. Can you please check our items out now?

name: Goro
dialog: The staff in this establishment are really… friendly…

name: Goro
dialog: Yes, we are from Camp Buddy.

name: Goro
dialog: Well, I do not deny the rumors from the past, but Camp Buddy right now definitely has changed for the better.

name: Goro
dialog: Yes. We’re actually hoping to get more recruits next year by doing fundraising and improving our facilities.

name: Goro
dialog: We’d be happy to have you next term. Here’s our business card.

name: Goro
dialog: Here you go.

name: Goro
dialog: Well, that took longer than expected. I didn’t think we’d be caught up in the supermarket like that.

name: Goro
dialog: Perhaps the two of you can return the groceries to the camp for me? I need to proceed to my meetings right away, and I don’t want the ingredients to spoil.

name: Goro
dialog: I know there’s a lot and they’re heavy. Are you two sure you can manage?

name: Goro
dialog: Good. I’m trusting you boys to be responsible and return straight to camp, alright? No stops or detours.

name: Goro
dialog: Please visit Yoshinori as soon as you get there and let him know that I’m at my meetings – I’ll call him within the hour to confirm that you’re both safe.

name: Goro
dialog: Is that understood?

name: Goro
dialog: Good. Now, off you go. Let’s not waste any more time.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ll see you boys back at camp soon. Thank you again!

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… The permits are prepared for Yoshinori tomorrow…

name: Goro
dialog: Now for the broken cabins... We seem to have all the supplies we need...

name: Goro
dialog: All reports have been updated too... It looks like the last thing on this checklist is to try and look for volunteers to help with the fundraising...

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm? Come in!

name: Goro
dialog: Oh, Felix, correct? What can I do for you?

name: Goro
dialog: What is it?

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm? Haven't the scoutmasters explained everything? We're attempting to raise awareness as well as funds for the camp.

name: Goro
dialog: At the moment, we don’t, but we are trying to find one. I actually spoke with the city mayor today about a sponsorship, but there's no guarantee it will get approved.

name: Goro
dialog: For now, the current activities and promotions will help keep us afloat until I can find a sponsor.

name: Goro
dialog: That's a huge part of it, yes.

name: Goro
dialog: Of course. I'm glad to hear a scout like you taking interest in the welfare of the camp.  Do you need anything else?

name: Goro
dialog: What an interesting boy… Now, where was I?

name: Goro
dialog: Oh yes, the reports… Let’s see…

name: Goro
dialog: A phone call this late? What could this be about?

name: Goro
dialog: Hello? Yes, this is Goro Nomoru with Camp Buddy.

name: Goro
dialog: Ah! Yes, I remember you.

name: Goro
dialog: What can I do for you?

name: Goro
dialog: Oh I see...! Where did you hear about the fundraiser?

name: Goro
dialog: Your timing is impeccable, and it's just what we're looking for.

name: Goro
dialog: Yes, you can come by tomorrow.

name: Goro
dialog: Excellent! We’ll see you then!

name: Goro
dialog: Alright, we have gathered here today to discuss the camp’s future!

name: Goro
dialog: We’re all aware of the camp’s current situation. We have to make some changes around here if we want to keep this place open, and we need to make them fast.

name: Goro
dialog: The main problem is with the camp’s finances. With no sponsors to back us up, we are barely holding this place together with the funds we have in reserve.

name: Goro
dialog: Cutting down on expenses won’t solve this situation. We’re bound to close down if we don’t get a new investor.

name: Goro
dialog: Precisely. If we settle for fewer, half-hearted activities, campers will only lose interest.

name: Goro
dialog: That’s right. We’ll be bankrupt.

name: Goro
dialog: In addition, persuading an investor might be out of the question right now, considering our reputation and the recent shutdown of our two other branches.

name: Goro
dialog: That is the only option we have given the circumstances.

name: Goro
dialog: But then again, based on this year’s statistics, the amount of enrollees has dropped significantly.

name: Goro
dialog: How can we possibly turn that around?

name: Goro
dialog: That is true, dear. Although, I believe it’s a risk worth taking.

name: Goro
dialog: You can’t be serious, Yoshinori. Everyone in town has heard the rumors about the camp.

name: Goro
dialog: They’ll laugh in our faces when we ask them for help, and I can’t blame them!

dialog: This was a bad idea… I shouldn’t have dragged you all into this as well.

dialog: Oh, good morning, scouts – need anything here?

name: Goro
dialog: Oh, she just went to fetch some printing paper from the storage shed. She’ll be here shortly.

name: Goro
dialog: Ah, so you two will be the ones designing the poster then?

name: Goro
dialog: That’s great to hear! I know you two will be very helpful.

name: Goro
dialog: Based on what I’ve seen you do, you’re quite the artist, Mr. Springfield.

name: Goro
dialog: And I see Mr. Nagame is assisting you with this activity. It’s nice to see you putting your photography talents to more… productive use today.

name: Goro
dialog: I’m sure both you and Mr. Springfield will complement each other nicely in this activity.

name: Goro
dialog: Oh, speaking of your camera, that does remind me – I heard my daughter gave you a welcoming gift when you first joined the camp…

name: Goro
dialog: Have you been keeping up with your entries recently?

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… Impressive.

name: Goro
dialog: I can see just how much thought you’ve put in to create this layout…

name: Goro
dialog: Alright, since this department seems all ready for the day’s activity, I’ll take my leave for now. I have yet to check on the progress of the other groups.

name: Goro
dialog: If you’ll excuse me…

name: Goro
dialog: …So our goal is to raise enough funds to maintain the camp for another term. There are various activities that I’m sure you can volunteer in.

name: Goro
dialog: We’ll have to ask you to wear it again while on the campgrounds.

name: Goro
dialog: Mr. Moreno here told us that he ran into you two after our errands yesterday.

name: Goro
dialog: He was informed of our ongoing fundraising campaign and gave me a call last night to offer his help.

name: Goro
dialog: Conveniently, we are currently lacking manpower to expedite the tasks around here, which is why I didn’t hesitate to accept him as a volunteer.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ll be filing all your volunteer paperwork here, Mr. Moreno, so you don’t have to worry about it. It’ll be much easier too since you’re a previous scout.

name: Goro
dialog: In the meantime, Yoshinori will guide you to where you can help. Is that understood?

name: Goro
dialog: Uhh… Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: I just received a complaint about one of your scouts… ermmm… gluing a poster on someone’s car…

name: Goro
dialog: Well, luckily the person said that it’s not a big deal, and he can easily remove the glue. But he was kind enough to let us know about it.

name: Goro
dialog: Alright, thank you, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* Do you all really have to keep calling me that? How many times do I have to say that I’m not that old…

name: Goro
dialog: So far, it looks like we’ll get a lot of attention with this route. I’m hopeful that we’ll attract many new recruits this way.

name: Goro
dialog: Good work. What about today’s plans?

name: Goro
dialog: Is that so? I’d like to hear it then.

name: Goro
dialog: Pretend I’m a total stranger and convince me of why I should donate or give my support to Camp Buddy.

name: Goro
dialog: Of course! You have to be ready to make improvisations! You’ll certainly be encountering a variety of different people to persuade.

name: Goro
dialog: What’s the matter?

name: Goro
dialog: That’s what I meant about doing improv. The second buddy law states that “A buddy must always be prepared for anything,” after all.

name: Goro
dialog: It seems like you need to work on your confidence. I’m worried about your actual performance when facing a total stranger.

name: Goro
dialog: You may as well do some test scenarios before you leave. That way you’ll be better prepared for anyone you meet.

name: Goro
dialog: Excellent. I’ll check back on you after I’ve assessed the other activities. I expect to see progress then. Understand?

name: Goro
dialog: As for you two, I expect you two to practice as well. Don’t make your scoutmaster do all the work!

name: Goro
dialog: And Mr. Nagame…

name: Goro
dialog: I know this is off topic, but my daughter mentioned that she gave you a welcome gift when you first arrived here.

name: Goro
dialog: I see. And how has that been coming along?

name: Goro
dialog: You knew about it, Yoshinori?

name: Goro
dialog: Oh, I see. Then I’d love to read it as we—

name: Goro
dialog: Heh… Wild as ever. Seeing you so ready for this activity is a truly remarkable sight, Mr. Yukimura.

name: Goro
dialog: I won’t stall you anymore. I have to check on everyone else’s progress, after all.

name: Goro
dialog: Good morning. Is everything going well here?

name: Goro
dialog: I just thought I’d come and check on your progress. How are things going here?

name: Goro
dialog: I asked you a question. And don’t call me Gramps!

name: Goro
dialog: I… I’m not that old, you know.

name: Goro
dialog: Good. And those two are helping you out?

name: Goro
dialog: I see. Do you have some ready that I can try?

name: Goro
dialog: I’m just assessing the product! And would you stop calling me Gramps, already?!

name: Goro
dialog: Oh, and Keitaro. I didn’t realize you were helping out here as well.

name: Goro
dialog: You’re being helpful as always, Keitaro. Excellent work.

name: Goro
dialog: I know this is off-topic, but my daughter mentioned that she gave you a welcome gift when you first arrived here.

name: Goro
dialog: I see. And how has that been coming along?

name: Goro
dialog: Be careful when handling knives, Mr. Akiba.

name: Goro
dialog: Hmph. You should be a more vigilant scoutmaster by now, Aiden. You must supervise them at all times to avoid accidents like this!

name: Goro
dialog: Ehem… Anyways, I’ll be on my way. I have to check on everyone else’s progress, after all.

name: Goro
dialog: And, Scoutmaster Aiden? While I know it can get quite hot in the kitchen, I won’t tolerate such revealing attire. Change. Now.

name: Goro
dialog: Yuri here spent all night fixing this poster up. But I have to say, you both did a great job as well.

name: Goro
dialog: I never thought we could have a poster so well made by one of Camp Buddy’s very own scouts. I’m sure this will draw many new campers, just like we need!

name: Goro
dialog: Great work, Mr. Springfield and Mr. Nagame.

name: Goro
dialog: Ah, right…!

name: Goro
dialog: Well, if it’s not too much trouble… I was wondering if you two could make a hand-drawn version of this poster for me.

name: Goro
dialog: Something like an 'original copy' of it, at least. I would definitely love to see it hanging in this office along with all the camp’s other mementos.

name: Goro
dialog: I know it may be a bit imposing of me to ask for this… but I can at least cover your printing task while you two are busy with my request.

name: Goro
dialog: What do you say, Hunter? Do you think you’re up for this job?

name: Goro
dialog: Impressive, I didn't expect it to be finished so quickly!

name: Goro
dialog: Oh my, this is outstanding, indeed! I love the way your colors blend in with the way you've inked the lines, Hunter!

name: Goro
dialog: This must definitely be framed as a staple of Camp Buddy’s image!

name: Goro
dialog: You really outdid yourself this time, Mr. Springfield! This painting is an honest work after your own brilliant heart~

name: Goro
dialog: The first ever poster for Camp Buddy made by a Camp Buddy scout!

name: Goro
dialog: Good job, you two! I’ll make sure to put your names right under this masterpiece’s frame!

name: Goro
dialog: There’s nothing to be embarrassed about. I understand what you’re going through.

name: Goro
dialog: And, as your scoutmasters, we’re here to provide guidance and help you out as much as we can!

name: Goro
dialog: That’s why we’ve prepared something that will give your passion the boost it needs.

name: Goro
dialog: Mr. Springfield, I would like you to have this…

name: Goro
dialog: A printed application form for the art school I enrolled Yuri in years before.

name: Goro
dialog: Oh, it was fairly easy, really… The main reason I enrolled my daughter in that art establishment was because I had connections with the director of the school.

name: Goro
dialog: Yuri told me about your dilemma, and I told myself I would help you achieve your dream.

name: Goro
dialog: So, I gave my old friend a call - showed him the brochure and sketch of the poster you created…

name: Goro
dialog: And he said you’re more than qualified to enroll!

name: Goro
dialog: Luckily, there are still a few slots available. All you have to do is to fill up this application form, and you’re one step away from becoming an official student of the arts!

name: Goro
dialog: Of course, this is all without considering what your parents’ opinions are regarding this matter.

name: Goro
dialog: I think it’s best that we convince your parents that you are indeed meant to enter this kind of institution.

name: Goro
dialog: However, there’s no one else here who will be able do that except for you.

name: Goro
dialog: I’m not pressuring you to fill this up immediately, of course. Please take the time to persuade your parents first.

name: Goro
dialog: The telephone is always available for family matters, alright?

name: Goro
dialog: Like I said, I know talent when I see it, Mr. Springfield! And anyone can see your passion for art is inspiring as well.

name: Goro
dialog: It’s the least I could do after you created such a beautiful piece for me.

name: Goro
dialog: Hehe! Still determined to assist us, I see! That’s the motivation I look for in my scouts!

name: Goro
dialog: Save the compliments for later, Yuri! For now, let’s get back to work.

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… I suppose you’ve all trained enough for your activity.

name: Goro
dialog: Very well. Once you do, you have my permission to go into town and begin promoting Camp Buddy.

name: Goro

dialog: Mr. Nagame. I believe this belongs to you.

name: Goro
dialog: I knew it. You left camp grounds again without my permission.

name: Goro
dialog: What kind of a scoutmaster are you?

name: Goro
dialog: Haven’t you learned your lesson already?

name: Goro
dialog: In my office. Now, Yoshinori!

name: Goro
dialog: Enough! You had your chance!

name: Goro
dialog: If it wasn't for Yuri backing you up, I would have already gotten rid of you a long time ago.

name: Goro
dialog: And then I find out you went outside with the campers yesterday- without any proper permission from me?

name: Goro
dialog: You're always \

name: Goro
dialog: You told me Springfield’s batch was going to be the last one and yet you bring in two more?!

name: Goro
dialog: Are you out of your mind?!

name: Goro
dialog: I don’t know if I can trust you again, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: You’ve always neglected everything I ordered you to do.

name: Goro
dialog: Don’t you realize how much trouble you’ve caused with last year’s incident?

name: Goro
dialog: It was such an embarrassment.

name: Goro
dialog: And based on your recent actions, it seems to me that you want to screw things up all over again!

name: Goro
dialog: You still won’t listen to me?!

name: Goro
dialog: I’ve already given you this last chance. But if you’re not going to listen to me, I’ll be forced to close this camp down for good!

name: Goro
dialog: What are you all doing?!

name: Goro
dialog: Hmph...

name: Goro
dialog: So you’re Keitaro Nagame, am I right?

name: Goro
dialog: Are you stirring up some trouble with those three?

name: Goro
dialog: Then why are you pretending to be friends with them?

name: Goro
dialog: Don’t lie to me!

name: Goro
dialog: How come you're calling them your friends despite what they've done to you?

name: Goro
dialog: Big words, but your actions do not follow.

name: Goro
dialog: I know someone who's as stubborn as you.

name: Goro
dialog: There are just some things you can't change, boy.

name: Goro
dialog: Tell me exactly… Why did you join this camp?

name: Goro
dialog: Tell me exactly… Why did you join this camp?{fast}

name: Goro
dialog: Can’t answer my question, I see…

name: Goro
dialog: If you have no real purpose while you're here, then this place must have really lost its meaning.

name: Goro
dialog: This camp was meant to create greater things! Things that one will forever carry with him...

name: Goro
dialog: It’s more than just puny memories or friends that fleet by like nothing more than dust in the wind!

name: Goro
dialog: Stop! I have heard enough to know how well you understand the essence of this place.

name: Goro
dialog: Now go ahead. I don’t want to see you getting in trouble with your so-called friends ever again.

name: Goro
dialog: Tch! Memories, huh?

name: Goro
dialog: Is that what you saw in him…?

name: Goro
dialog: What’s going on here?! I heard screaming!

name: Goro
dialog: W-What the…?!

name: Goro
dialog: What’s the matter with all of you? You all look like you’ve seen a ghost!

name: Goro
dialog: Scary stories, huh? And who is responsible for this?

name: Goro
dialog: You thought that it was a great idea to tell those kinds of stories at this time of the night?

name: Goro
dialog: What if the other scouts think that someone got hurt here?!

name: Goro
dialog: Hmph. Very well then…

name: Goro
dialog: Just don’t scream like that again! I don’t want any more false alarms! And please, go to bed already! It’s late!

name: Goro
dialog: I’ve gathered you all here today to inform you of my conclusion, regarding today’s event.

name: Goro
dialog: And I’m pleased to announce that this event truly was successful, and exceeded all my expectations.

name: Goro
dialog: What I saw today was the opposite of what happened at last year’s event.

name: Goro
dialog: It was obvious how carefully and thoroughly everything was planned.

name: Goro
dialog: The obstacle course was very well constructed, and it was highly interactive without compromising safety.

name: Goro
dialog: I also noticed the first-aid booth on site. Not to mention the well-thought-out meal for the exhausted campers afterwards.

name: Goro
dialog: Most importantly, I saw how each of the campers worked together as a team to achieve a common goal.

name: Goro
dialog: This truly exemplifies what the scouts have learned within the past few days.

name: Goro
dialog: The new recruits of this batch have even been getting along exceptionally well with our older recruits.

name: Goro
dialog: Did you just call me Gramps?!

name: Goro
dialog: You don’t need to thank me. You were the one who made this possible.

name: Goro
dialog: Heh. This honestly seems way too hard to believe.

name: Goro
dialog: I almost thought that you’d bribed those boys into putting up a good show for me.

name: Goro
dialog: Hehe… I can’t disagree with that.

name: Goro
dialog: Don’t you have work to do in the mess hall?

name: Goro
dialog: Wait. Stay here, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: Congratulations.

name: Goro
dialog: I wanted to bring up the small situation that occurred earlier.

name: Goro
dialog: We both saw that argument between the first two competing groups.

name: Goro
dialog: I was already expecting another mess to occur again this year.

name: Goro
dialog: And I wanted to see how these ‘new scouts’ would handle that kind of situation.

name: Goro
dialog: I am truly surprised at how that one boy handled the situation.

name: Goro
dialog: Yes. We all saw how his friends and even his enemies listened to him.

name: Goro
dialog: Everyone looked at him with so much respect.

name: Goro
dialog: He had the passion you once had, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: I’m just glad to see that same passion rising back in you as well.

name: Goro
dialog: However, don’t think for a second that what you have achieved today is enough to fix the damaged name of this camp.

name: Goro
dialog: I told you. It’s not enough.

name: Goro
dialog: But it’s a good start.

name: Goro
dialog: I will extend my stay here at Camp Buddy to watch over you. I want to see for myself how you plan to redeem the camp’s reputation.

name: Goro
dialog: I’m counting on you to keep your eye on those two, considering the tension between them.

dialog: We can’t let a few bad eggs bring the camp down again. Understood?

dialog: And for those who lean more into creative activities, just follow me!

name: Yuri
dialog: Oh, Hunter! I thought I’d be seeing you soon!

name: Yuri
dialog: Have you thought about what badge you wanted to earn?

name: Yuri
dialog: Oh! That’s an excellent idea!

name: Yuri
dialog: I’ve got some art materials here that you can use.

name: Yuri
dialog: It’s art! There are no rules! Just draw whatever you like! Art is best expressed through the strokes of one’s heart, the hues of every emotion~

name: Yuri
dialog: Is there anything in particular you wanted to draw?

name: Yuri
dialog: Oooh, what is it? I might be able to help you expressing it.

name: Yuri
dialog: D’awww~ That’s adorable! Does this 'something' happen to be a 'someone'?

name: Yuri
dialog: KYAAAAAAAAAAA~ My little cinnamon roll is developing a crush!~

name: Yuri
dialog: No need to explain, Hunter~ I know exactly what you need!

name: Yuri
dialog: Now, run along and transfer ‘his’ beautiful face onto this sketchpad of yours!

name: Yuri
dialog: Tootle-loo~

name: Yuri
dialog: Of course you do! The less you wear, the faster you can swim! Isn’t that how it works?

name: Yuri
dialog: Ooh~! Look what we have here~! You lovebirds really can't be apart from each other for a minute, can you?

name: Yuri
dialog: I thought Keitaro here is supposed to be working for his photography badge?

name: Yuri
dialog: Hngh! You’re 'using' him?!

name: Yuri
dialog: Of course! You can’t swim properly if you’re going to overdress yourself in those jammers!

name: Yuri
dialog: Ahem, as for you two… how’s the progress so far?

name: Yuri
dialog: Ooh~! Can I see?!

name: Yuri
dialog: Oh, wow! The angle, expression, and lighting are really good here, Keitaro! I’m impressed!

name: Yuri
dialog: This picture really speaks a thousand words! You’ve really captured Hunter’s calming and soothing expression!

name: Yuri
dialog: Have you shown this to Hunter, Keitaro?

name: Yuri
dialog: Keitaro, dear, why don’t you head over to Scoutmaster Yoshi?

name: Yuri
dialog: Show him this photo and tell him that I approved of it. You’ve already earned your photography badge with this!

name: Yuri
dialog: What’s wrong, sweetie? Why won’t you show Keitaro your drawing?

name: Yuri
dialog: I agree~! This is really well made! Hunter, you've got such a bright future ahead of you in art!

name: Yuri
dialog: Hunter, dear… Why would you think that way?

name: Yuri
dialog: Think about it, Hunter. If you were able to show this to us, why wouldn’t you be able to show it to Keitaro?

name: Yuri
dialog: If you really see Keitaro as a friend, shouldn’t you believe in him more?

name: Yuri
dialog: Unless... you actually believe he’s no different from someone who would think of you the way you're so scared of being thought of...

name: Yuri
dialog: There's your answer then~!

name: Yuri
dialog: There’s no reason to hesitate when you have nothing but good intentions, especially if it’s for someone you value.

name: Yuri
dialog: Now, run along and give Keitaro this gift you worked so hard to make.

name: Yuri
dialog: That boy just needs a little encouragement! Nothing will change if we let him think it’s okay to stay inside his bubble!

name: Yuri
dialog: Besides, it’s adorable to witness someone as precious as Hunter discover his path of pure infatuation!

name: Yuri
dialog: Oh, nothing~!

name: Yuri
dialog: Anyway, Natsumi! Don’t think I forgot why I brought you here! Go get changed!

name: Yuri
dialog: I’m not going to let you work on that activity if I can’t see more skin on you!

name: Yuri
dialog: We're sorry we had to wake all of you up this early!

name: Yuri
dialog: I know I’m excited! I will get to see all of you half-na-

dialog: Wow! It’s been a while since I last saw you wear that uniform, Dad.

name: Yuri
dialog: Dad, you’re being way too strict… We already talked about this.

name: Yuri
