dialog: You guys will behold the most stunning, most gag-worthy, most fabulous makeshift campsite with my expert eye for aesthetics~!

name: Eduard
dialog: What? Shouldn’t we be like, doing shelter first? It’s so hot and these UV rays are really bad for my skin!

name: Eduard
dialog: But my skin! It’s gonna get sunburnt even with my SPF 2,000 sunscreen!

name: Eduard
dialog: Though, a tan might be a good idea, since it’s been trending on Instaglam lately.

name: Eduard
dialog: But still! I don’t wanna get a painful sunburn!

name: Eduard
dialog: And eww, I am not gonna risk getting a splinter just to make an LOL message. I’ll definitely break a fingernail! Or two!

name: Eduard
dialog: That’s like, the worst thing that could ever happen to me.

name: Eduard
dialog: UGH! Shouldn’t we be like, completing this dumb task list instead of chit-chatting? As if we’re actually gonna starve or thirst to death out here…

name: Eduard
dialog: This is just a lame simulation, anyway! But if I ruined my manicure? That’s as real as it gets!

name: Eduard
dialog: Oh. My. God. Are you all seriously my competition here?

name: Eduard
dialog: Like, is this it? ‘Cuz you people have no fashion sense at all~!

name: Eduard
dialog: Well, I’m just here to say that if you all think you’re gonna win a runway challenge against a supermodel like me, then you can kiss your chances goodbye~!

name: Eduard
dialog: Yass~! I’m serving you all the colors of the rainbow with my razzle-bedazzled, glitterrific leg skins~!

name: Eduard
dialog: Workin’ it~! Slayin’ it on the runway~!

name: Eduard
dialog: Come on, camp daddies~! Let’s get sickening~!

name: Eduard
dialog: HMPH! I would’ve won for sure if the judges actually knew anything about true fashion! No one understands me here!

name: Eduard
dialog: I don’t know why I even bothered!

name: Eduard
dialog: But I gotta be careful making my way through all this gunk and moss! It’s getting my premium swimsuit all dirty!

name: Eduard
dialog: And… seaweed is just, ugh, disgusting too... Can’t we look for something… prettier?

name: Eduard
dialog: Isn’t this like, supposed to be a vacation? Why are we being forced into some activity?!

name: Eduard
dialog: Ooh~! Did you just say theatre~? Don’t mind if I own that stage with my charisma, uniqueness, nerve, and talent!

name: Eduard
dialog: Ugh… I can’t believe this happened again.

name: Eduard
dialog: Come on, Lee! Let’s just go earn our badges. I’m pretty sure Taiga went ahead to do his anyway!

name: Eduard
dialog: Oh, it’s you-

name: Eduard
dialog: And Taiga?! I’m shook!

name: Eduard
dialog: Awww, you’re so sweet to check up on me, Taiga!

name: Eduard
dialog: Well, of course~ I came for the fashion badge. I slayed. I conquered!

name: Eduard
dialog: When I explained to that scoutmaster lady the intricacies of my bea-u-ti-ful swimsuit, she basically handed me the badge!

name: Eduard
dialog: What about you, Taiga? Surely you’ve already earned a badge!

name: Eduard
dialog: Wait! Let me guess – you’re helping this brunette earn his, since he can’t do it himself, right?

name: Eduard
dialog: Together? You two? Seriously?

name: Eduard
dialog: I never thought I’d see the day you would willingly work as a team!

name: Eduard
dialog: Guess times are changing, huh?

name: Eduard
dialog: Sooo… You guys are doing photography, huh? You came to the perfect place, then~!

name: Eduard
dialog: Since I just finished my activity, I was planning on setting up an aesthetic summer lounge. Brunette here still owes me a photoshoot, after all~

name: Eduard
dialog: For starters, I’ll be lying on my super glamourous float!

name: Eduard
dialog: Then I’ll have a fruit tart and tropical smoothie at my side, while I bathe in the sun wearing my designer sunglasses and Loose Butt-on Sunday hat~!

name: Eduard
dialog: Well, no… Just the float.

name: Eduard
dialog: But hey! I can dream of being the queen I deserve to be!

name: Eduard
dialog: Yeah! That’s the one~! Aww, you notice even the little things I do, Taiga!

name: Eduard
dialog: I have a problem though…

name: Eduard
dialog: It’s still deflated and like, a total pain too… I’ve been trying to blow it up for the past twenty minutes, and it just won’t inflate!

name: Eduard
dialog: I know, but like, there wasn’t any room left once I filled up my makeup bag!

name: Eduard
dialog: Hmm, alright, but be careful! I know you can’t afford to replace it!

name: Eduard
dialog: Oh. My. God. STOP! You’re just spraying spit everywhere! Eww, that is DISGUSTING!

name: Eduard
dialog: Ugh. You’re so bad at this, I can’t even.

name: Eduard
dialog: *gasp* Taiga, my savior! It’ll be perfect!

name: Eduard
dialog: Bless, Taiga, you’re an expert at this!

name: Eduard
dialog: Looking good so far, Taiga~! Keep it up!

name: Eduard
dialog: My gosh! Look at my fabulous flamingo really coming to life thanks to Taiga’s lungs!

name: Eduard
dialog: Fwah, don’t listen to brunette! Keep on blowing, Taiga~! Make it as bloated as you can~!

name: Eduard
dialog: It was all worth it, Taiga~! You can seal it up now!

name: Eduard
dialog: Yes, it’s perfect, Taiga~! I can’t wait to ride it and get my glam shots!

name: Eduard
dialog: Yasss~ Now I know where I can find a strong pair of lungs on a handsome bod too~

name: Eduard
dialog: Slaaayyy~! Look how it fits me perfectly! I’m so fabulous!

name: Eduard
dialog: What was that, Taiga?

name: Eduard
dialog: Alright, then I’m off to take my fabulous dip~!

name: Eduard
dialog: Tootle-loo~~~

name: Eduard
dialog: Yeah, it’s too bad! It’s been a while since I was able to have a beach paradise! I was so ready to put on my mermaid fantasy couture!

name: Eduard
dialog: Ughh… It’s only like… 7:00 AM…

name: Eduard
dialog: Ugh, I hope not! These scoutmasters don’t know the meaning of vacation!

name: Eduard
dialog: What did you do this time, brunette?!

name: Eduard
dialog: Liar. You definitely know something, at least.

name: Eduard
dialog: *sigh* I wish he’d just tell us what’s bothering him though… He’s been in a mood way more often lately!

name: Eduard
dialog: Like, yeah~ Talking about problems was never an option with Taiga.

name: Eduard
dialog: Well, we’re his friends too, you know? He should let us help him some too!

name: Eduard
dialog: Oh well, I guess let’s just get dressed. Who knows, maybe today’s announcement will distract him.

name: Eduard
dialog: Yeah, let’s go. I’m done hearing these dweebs fawn over this trip. We are NOT getting left behind here.

name: Eduard
dialog: Ugh… Can you believe we have to pack all our stuff just when we’re getting comfy in this paradise?

name: Eduard
dialog: Ah, Taiga! We’ll bring our bags to the gathering area, okay?

name: Eduard
dialog: You really did it this time, brunette! Taiga wouldn't stay mad for this long if you hadn't done something!

name: Eduard
dialog: Hmm… Well I can’t think of anyone else who can piss him off like that.

name: Eduard
dialog: Unless there’s something you’re not telling us.

name: Eduard
dialog: *gasp* Spill the tea! What did that scoutmaster say?!

name: Eduard
dialog: Ugh, fine! And I thought we were becoming hashtag besties!

name: Eduard
dialog: W-What? Really?! Look at you, being useful! Tell us what you’ve deduced, genius!

name: Eduard
dialog: OMG, Lee! What the hell, I thought you were being serious?! Why would Taiga be mad about that all day?!

name: Eduard
dialog: Come on, Keitaro, I thought you were our friend! Maybe we can help Taiga out too!

name: Eduard
dialog: As if we have any other choice. Everybody else here literally hates us.

name: Eduard
dialog: And besides, Lee and I have talked about it, and we guess you’re not as bad as we thought.

name: Eduard
dialog: Plus, you always compliment me. So, hey, I’ll take that any day!

name: Eduard
dialog: Okay, now spill the tea! Why is Taiga so moody today?

name: Eduard
dialog: Oh… Him…

name: Eduard
dialog: Well… Kinda yes and a no…

name: Eduard
dialog: He was our roommate last year. We stayed in the same cabin… Him, Taiga, Lee and I…

name: Eduard
dialog: But other than that, we never had the chance to get close to him.

name: Eduard
dialog: All I know is that Taiga hates it whenever we try to talk about him. Last year was pretty traumatizing for everyone.

name: Eduard
dialog: Then let’s change the topic before Taiga finds out we’re talking about this.

name: Eduard
dialog: Yasss~! Another perfect spot to have a photoshoot~!

name: Eduard
dialog: Looks like I can add ‘Nymph Goddess’ to my model portfolio~

name: Eduard
dialog: You can stop your monologue now, Lee. They’re gone.

name: Eduard
dialog: Even I wasn’t listening. No one’s listening.

name: Eduard
dialog: We’re coming, Taiga!

name: Eduard
dialog: Can you believe how much of a hassle this is?! We had to take this tent down and assemble it again in just one morning?!

name: Eduard
dialog: OMG. That’s a fabulous idea! I’ve been DYING for a freshwater detox after those days at the beach!

name: Eduard
dialog: Even my sweat is already salty.

name: Eduard
dialog: NOT interested, Lee. But you’re welcome to join me, either way~

name: Eduard
dialog: W-Wait, what?! S-Snails? Slugs? Worms???!!!

name: Eduard
dialog: W-Wait! I changed my mind! I wanna go back to the beach!!!!!

name: Eduard
dialog: Yeah, it’s too bad! It’s been a while since I was able to have a beach paradise! I didn’t even get a chance to try on my mermaid fantasy couture!

name: Eduard
dialog: Ugh, you’ve gotta be freaking kidding me! That’s two days in a row they’ve messed with my beauty sleep!

name: Eduard
dialog: Oh sure, Taiga~ That would be lovel-

name: Eduard
dialog: Wait w-whaaattt…?

name: Eduard
dialog: Uhh… yeah, sure…

name: Eduard
dialog: Psst. Lee!

name: Eduard
dialog: D-Did you notice something different about Taiga today?

name: Eduard
dialog: I don’t know… He kinda feels fluffy today for some reason…

name: Eduard

dialog: Ugh… You're hopeless… I mean Taiga is a little nicer today!

name: Eduard
dialog: Yeah, I know right? He’s not cranky like he usually is in the mornings.

dialog: He helped us pack our stuff, he’s smiling often, and he even complimented my makeup today, which, by the way, he never does…

dialog: What do you think happened yesterday when we left him with Keitaro?

dialog: L-Lee!!

dialog: SAY WHAT?!

dialog: Okay, I don’t know what kind of magical fruit, spell, or potion you gave to Taiga, but I am 100 percent sure this is not the same Taiga that we know and love.

name: Eduard
dialog: I cannot BELIEVE that he’s gone full circle in one night! That is just impossible!

name: Eduard
dialog: REALLY?!

name: Eduard
dialog: W-Well, no… This reminds me of how you were when we first met… Which feels like forever ago.

name: Eduard
dialog: I swear, it seems like you've really brainwashed Taiga, Keitaro!

name: Eduard
dialog: Whaaaat? Is that where you two ran off to yesterday?

name: Eduard
dialog: Huh? Did you two go swimming or something?

name: Eduard
dialog: Ummm… excuse me?! We’re right here! How dare you talk badly about Taiga out in the open like that!

name: Eduard

name: Eduard
dialog: Eugh! The nerve!

name: Eduard
dialog: B-But they shouldn’t be going around spreading lies like that!

name: Eduard
dialog: Gee… I’m having a hard time processing all of this…

name: Eduard
dialog: This is just way too sudden, Lee! I mean, don’t get me wrong, I’m super happy we finally have a friendly Taiga again, but like, it’s so out of nowhere!

name: Eduard
dialog: I guess when you put it that way… I’m not as grossed out by Keitaro as I used to be either.

name: Eduard
dialog: *sigh* That’s true.…

name: Eduard
dialog: Eugh… I can’t wait to go back to Camp Buddy to just process all of this.

name: Eduard

dialog: W-What do you mean…?

dialog: I’m sure we can be good friends again, like we used to be!

dialog: I-I promise I won’t cause trouble!

dialog: Oh sure! I’m just gonna get changed before heading over. You guys can go ahead!

dialog: Y-Yeah…! Thanks again, Keitaro!
